|  |
| --- |
| Frequently Asked Questions  Common questions about WhatsApp Calling |

|  |
| --- |
| ❓ Can I make WhatsApp calls from a desktop browser?  Yes. When configuring staff user settings, you can set the **Default Channel for WhatsApp Calls** to **Web App**, which allows calls to be handled directly from the CRM browser interface. |

|  |
| --- |
| ❓ Do I need customer permission before making a call?  Yes. WhatsApp requires **explicit customer approval** before your business can initiate an outbound call. Inbound calls from customers do not require prior permission. |

|  |
| --- |
| ❓ How long does call permission last?  Temporary permission lasts **7 calendar days (168 hours)**. Permanent permission does not expire. If the customer does not respond to a request, it expires after **7 days**. |

|  |
| --- |
| ❓ How many permission requests can I send to the same customer?  **1 request every 24 hours**, maximum **2 requests within a 7-day period**. These limits reset when any connected call is made between your business and the user. |

|  |
| --- |
| ❓ Is WhatsApp Calling available in my country?  WhatsApp Calling is available in most countries. It is currently **not supported** in the United States, Canada, Turkey, Egypt, Vietnam, and Nigeria. |

|  |
| --- |
| ❓ What happens if I miss an inbound WhatsApp call?  If a call goes unanswered, the customer can request a callback if you have enabled **Allow People to Request Callback for Missed Calls**. The missed call is also logged in the customer's conversation. |

|  |
| --- |
| ❓ Can multiple team members receive the same inbound call?  Yes. In **Ring WhatsApp Calls To**, you can assign a **primary user** who rings first and add additional team members as backup. If the primary user does not answer, the call routes to the next assigned user. |

|  |
| --- |
| ❓ Can a customer revoke call permission?  Yes. Customers can revoke permission at any time by opening the WhatsApp chat, tapping the **business profile name**, going to **Business Calling Permissions**, and disabling call access. |

|  |
| --- |
| ❓ What is a call disposition and why should I use it?  A call disposition is an **outcome tag** you add after a call — for example, *Resolved*, *Follow-up Required*, or *No Answer*. It keeps records accurate and makes follow-ups easier to track. |

|  |
| --- |
| ❓ What happens after 4 consecutive unanswered calls?  After **2 unanswered calls**, WhatsApp sends the user a system message prompting them to reconsider. After **4 unanswered calls**, call permission is **automatically revoked** by WhatsApp. |

|  |
| --- |
| ❓What happens if permission is auto-revoked?  If a customer does not answer 4 consecutive outbound calls, WhatsApp automatically revokes calling permission. You will need to request permission again to place future calls. |

title_en: Getting Started with Client App Builder: Build Custom Web and Mobile Apps with AI
source_md:
Client App Builder lets you create personalized, branded web portals and Android mobile apps using AI, without writing code.

Simply describe your business and the experience you want to create. AI helps plan your app, design its pages, connect existing HighLevel features, and build a working experience that you can preview, customize, and publish.

Whether you're building a learning portal, coaching platform, membership experience, or branded mobile app, Client App Builder helps you bring your ideas to life using the HighLevel tools and data you already have.

Availability: Client App Builder is available under Labs at the sub-account level.

## In This Article

1. What is Client App Builder?
2. How to enable Client App Builder
3. Creating your first app
4. Choosing your starting point
5. Customizing your app with AI
6. Connecting HighLevel features
7. Using Custom Objects in your app
8. Previewing and publishing your web app
9. Building and publishing Android apps
10. Managing your apps
11. Building with external AI tools (MCP)
12. Current limitations
13. Frequently asked questions

---

## 1. What Is Client App Builder?

Client App Builder is an AI-powered application builder that helps you create custom experiences for your clients and members.

Unlike traditional website builders, where you manually arrange every element, Client App Builder lets you describe what you want in natural language.

AI helps generate the design, pages, navigation, and supported functionality for your app.

### What can you build?

Web Apps

Create fully customized, browser-based Client Portals where members can access courses, join communities, manage appointments, browse shared files, and interact with your business.

Mobile Apps

Create branded Android apps with personalized navigation, layouts, colors, and native mobile capabilities. Generate an installable Android APK directly from the builder.

### How does it work?

Client App Builder follows a simple process:

1. Describe: Tell AI about your business and the experience you want.
2. Personalize: Answer setup questions and select your branding and design preferences.
3. Build: AI creates your app's pages, screens, and supported functionality.
4. Customize: Refine your app through conversations or available visual customization tools.
5. Preview: Explore your app before publishing.
6. Publish: Launch your web app or generate an installable Android app.

Your apps use your existing HighLevel Client Portal infrastructure, including member accounts, courses, communities, and supported CRM data.

## 2. How to Enable Client App Builder

Client App Builder is currently available through Labs.

### Step 1: Enable the feature

1. Open your HighLevel account.
2. Navigate to Labs.
3. Find Client App Builder.
4. Enable the feature for your sub-account.

![Labs - Client App Builder toggle](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084618562/original/dXNS3LX70fP_CweD6v8S5H9cNNXyezEKwA.jpeg?1793372240)

### Step 2: Open Client App Builder

Once enabled, open Memberships → Client App Builder.

Depending on your account's navigation experience, Client App Builder may also appear under Client Apps → Client App Builder.

![Client Apps menu - Client App Builder](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084618567/original/g-g40JXf7xXUlVVgzNFw15fbreIfg-tv0A.jpeg?1793372241)

Note: Client App Builder operates at the sub-account level. Apps created in one sub-account are not automatically available in another.

## 3. Creating Your First App

When you open Client App Builder, you'll see a prompt box where you can describe what you want to create.

You can start with a detailed description or choose one of the suggested ideas, such as appointment booking, events, or an agency client portal.

![Client App Builder home screen](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084618561/original/2Gq72NjDRGQaQAxGMf6-5L35XW6_1nMMkw.jpeg?1793372240)

### Step 1: Describe your app

For example:

"Create a member portal for my fitness studio. Members should be able to browse and purchase courses, join our community, book appointments, and access resources. Use a clean, modern design with our brand colors."

The more context you provide about your business, audience, and desired functionality, the more tailored your initial app can be.

![Describing your app](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084618570/original/kQU7dteaVab2ueXCMg_anM8-gWBW72CalA.jpeg?1793372241)

### Step 2: Choose Web or Mobile

Select the type of app you want to build:

- Web: A browser-based Client Portal experience.
- Mobile: A branded Android mobile application.

AI may suggest an app type based on your prompt, but you can change it before creating the app.

Important: Once an app has been created, you cannot switch it between Web and Mobile. To use the other format, create a separate app.

![Choosing Web or Mobile and a starting point](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084618568/original/E41OefINvMV9-vGtXu6u-0iU_LjUXDtfDw.jpeg?1793372241)

### Step 3: Answer the setup questions

AI may ask questions about your business, app name, audience, required features, and who should be able to access the app.

These questions help tailor the generated experience to your needs.

![Setup questions](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084618566/original/b5r-RiP7DYaRf5mfkUChhHmbKWRUitjMVQ.jpeg?1793372241)

### Step 4: Choose your design

Depending on your app type and starting point, you can choose from suggested design systems, colors, fonts, and existing brand boards.

For supported web experiences, you can explore additional design systems and attach images to guide the visual direction.

![Design choices - colour palette and fonts](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084618563/original/25Wil6xccz5xYS0IL8j3FWmJ10v_6L81MQ.jpeg?1793372240)

### Step 5: Review and build

For supported web builds, AI presents a plan before generating the app.

![Reviewing the build plan](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084618572/original/4GQxwN3tOklEXJ2MhRqkG0F6-o83oy7cpw.jpeg?1793372241)

You can:

- Approve & build: Continue with the proposed plan.
- Refine: Request changes before building.
- Reject: Decline the proposed plan.

Once the build starts, you can follow its progress and access the preview when it's ready.

![Build progress](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084618565/original/4TmXrvrp0rnKz-i9HwX9Fd1E9UPTDzwotQ.jpeg?1793372241)

## 4. Choosing Your Starting Point

Client App Builder provides two ways to create an app.

### Option A: Describe It Instead (Vibe Coding)

Choose this option when you want AI to create a custom experience from your description.

AI generates pages, layouts, and navigation based on your business requirements and design preferences.

This is ideal when you want a distinctive experience rather than a standard Client Portal layout.

For example:

"Build a coaching portal with a personalized welcome dashboard, upcoming sessions, available programs, and a member community."

For supported web apps, you can also use visual editing, AI-suggested next steps, and page-building prompts to continue developing your experience.

### Option B: ClientPortal Standard

Choose this option when you want to start with the familiar HighLevel Client Portal experience and customize its appearance and navigation.

You can personalize supported built-in pages, adjust branding, and configure layouts without rebuilding the entire experience from scratch.

For standard web apps, available starting features include dashboards, products, lessons, communities, and invoices. Mobile functionality may differ.

![ClientPortal standard starting point](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084618564/original/Et9Cdngfqw19y7U7PT27kLm7gMa9k_SOaQ.jpeg?1793372241)

Which should you choose?

Choose Describe It Instead for a more custom AI-generated experience. Choose ClientPortal Standard when you want to retain the familiar portal structure while personalizing its design and navigation.

## 5. Customizing Your App with AI

Your first build is only the beginning.

Client App Builder lets you continue refining your experience through natural-language conversations.

### Make changes through chat

Use the message box to request updates such as:

- "Make the homepage more modern and minimal."
- "Move Courses to the top of the navigation."
- "Add a page for upcoming workshops."
- "Change the primary color to match my brand."
- "Make the course cards more prominent."

Follow-up requests generally preserve your existing design unless you specifically request a redesign.

![Refining your app through chat](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084618569/original/YOFiepzwBuGLJxXaAk65JUroPgCcDEe3kQ.jpeg?1793372241)

### Use visual editing

For web apps created with Describe It Instead, you can select elements directly in the preview using Visual edits.

Select the elements you want to modify, then describe the change.

You can select up to 20 elements in a single visual-edit request.

### Build missing pages

If your generated web app includes a link to a page that hasn't been built yet, you may see a Build this page option.

Use it to prepare a request for AI to generate the missing page.

### Customize layouts and themes

For ClientPortal Standard apps, the Customizer provides additional controls after the preview is ready.

Depending on your app type, you can customize:

- Brand colors, fonts, logos, and app identity.
- Navigation items, icons, and ordering.
- Default pages and opening screens.
- Mobile bottom tabs, header styles, and account placement.
- Custom navigation links and supported pages.

For mobile apps, you can also configure whether the app initially opens in Light or Dark mode.

![Layout customizer - Navigation](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084618583/original/L76Yk2DmTZ5VyYhVjgYu8ZBJv6IeWzFezQ.jpeg?1793372242)

![Theme customizer](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084618575/original/Fow214H6OEVoC3p1HohfrpLTaJOJ74UWQw.jpeg?1793372241)

Note: The Layout and Theme Customizer is available for ClientPortal Standard apps. Apps created using Describe It Instead are primarily customized through AI prompts and supported editing tools.

## 6. Connecting HighLevel Features

One of the biggest advantages of Client App Builder is that your app can use existing HighLevel functionality.

You don't need to recreate your membership infrastructure or maintain separate member accounts.

### Supported features include:

Courses

Let members browse courses, purchase available content, access lessons, track learning progress, and join supported live sessions.

Communities

Provide access to community groups, feeds, invitations, and supported discovery experiences.

Appointments

Allow members to access appointment-related experiences through supported Client Portal functionality.

Shared Files

Make resources and files available to members through your app.

Member Accounts

Use existing Client Portal authentication, including sign-in, sign-up, and password recovery.

CRM Data

Use supported CRM information and Custom Objects to create interactive, data-driven member experiences.

These features operate through HighLevel's existing systems, helping keep your member experience connected to your business.

## 7. Using Custom Objects in Your App

Custom Objects let you go beyond displaying information by allowing members to submit and interact with records stored in your HighLevel CRM.

For example, you could build a portal where members submit coaching applications, property inquiries, or service requests.

### How Custom Objects work

1. Describe the information you want members to submit or manage.
2. If the request requires stored CRM data, AI asks whether you want to use Custom Objects.
3. AI proposes a data structure, including fields, dropdown options, and supported relationships.
4. Review the proposed structure, sample records, and member visibility.
5. Approve the plan or request changes.
6. AI creates the approved objects and connected app experience.

![Proposed Custom Object structure](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084618587/original/TTb7SQJTLT5wwsAkAERMroXtq1Ik_40aag.jpeg?1793372244)

### Member visibility

Depending on your configuration, members can be allowed to view:

- Their own records.
- Records associated with their company.
- All records in read-only mode.

![Who sees what - member visibility](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084618574/original/Pdl4IbuzsXcHj9lvo24DJbFE3emi6f5B7Q.jpeg?1793372241)

### Payments and records

Supported web experiences can also include payment actions using HighLevel invoices when a payment provider is connected.

Custom Objects support up to three objects per change, subject to the CRM's overall limit of ten Custom Objects per sub-account.

Important: Custom Objects are supported in web and mobile experiences, but some capabilities, including record-based payments and media attachments, are currently web-only.

## 8. Previewing and Publishing Your Web App

### Preview your app

Client App Builder provides a live preview so you can explore the experience as you build it.

For web apps, preview controls include:

- Desktop, tablet, and mobile viewport sizes.
- Back and forward navigation.
- Reload.
- Open in a new tab.
- Copy preview URL.

![Web app preview](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084618584/original/X3p0xgnWadd3EkuSJAC_3OZjunbBRAvBXw.jpeg?1793372243)

If your preview has been inactive for an extended period, it may pause to conserve resources. Return to the builder to resume it.

Published apps are not affected by an idle preview.

### Publish your web app

When you're satisfied with your app:

1. Open the publishing controls.
2. Choose an available address on app.clientclub.net.
3. Review any warnings about linked pages that haven't been built.
4. Build missing pages or choose to publish with those pages incomplete.
5. Publish your app.

![Publish dialog - app address and custom domains](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084618571/original/zPxYrla0C9EqnhgD2_k-WqguQmDY6nRr-w.jpeg?1793372241)

You can publish additional changes later or unpublish the app when needed.

### Connect a custom domain

You can also connect your own domain to a published web app.

Client App Builder provides a guided domain connection process, with manual DNS configuration available when needed.

Up to 10 custom domains can be connected to a web app.

Note: You cannot use a domain that is already assigned as your sub-account's active Client Portal domain.

## 9. Building and Publishing Android Apps

Client App Builder also supports branded Android mobile applications.

### Customize your mobile experience

Depending on your starting point, you can configure supported mobile features such as:

- App name, branding, colors, and fonts.
- Bottom navigation tabs and header layout.
- Opening screen after sign-in.
- Community and course navigation.
- Custom pages and external modules.
- Device capabilities such as camera and photo access.

New members can sign up using a join code.

### Preview your mobile app

The builder displays your mobile experience inside a phone frame, allowing you to inspect the design and navigation before generating an installable app.

### Generate your Android APK

When you're ready:

1. Open your mobile app's publishing controls.
2. Provide the required app identity and branding assets.
3. Start the Android APK build.
4. Monitor the build status.
5. Download the signed APK when it's ready.

![Android APK publishing](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084618576/original/7BAdh1WGFouePjHSfhka5c-zAWvqqdRK_A.jpeg?1793372241)

A typical APK build takes approximately 15–25 minutes.

![Android APK assets and Build signed APK](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084618573/original/TxhiNXNevtBuRTUc8202Un0kFn8oFHcX6g.jpeg?1793372241)

### Required Android assets

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Asset | Requirement |
| App name | 1–30 characters |
| App icon | PNG, 1024 × 1024 pixels, up to 5 MB |
| Splash screen | PNG, 1080 × 1920 pixels, up to 5 MB |
| Firebase configuration | Optional google-services.json, up to 5 MB, matching the package ID |

### Important mobile publishing limitations

Currently, Client App Builder supports downloading Android APKs, not direct publishing to Google Play or the Apple App Store.

Only one signed APK can be generated per app at this time.

For ClientPortal Standard mobile apps, supported design and configuration updates can be published to installed apps. For apps built using Describe It Instead, new AI-generated screens require a new APK, which is not currently supported.

Plan and test your Android experience carefully before generating your signed APK.

iOS app generation is not currently available.

## 10. Managing Your Apps

Client App Builder provides a project dashboard where you can access and manage your apps.

From the home screen, you can view recent projects or open All projects.

Available management options include:

- Search for existing apps.
- View recent and starred projects.
- Star or unstar an app.
- Rename an app.
- Delete an app.
- Identify web and mobile projects and their status.

![Project options - Star, Rename, Delete](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084618578/original/LfHw2SLSm_fc4eYuzvwLVBzrQo5wA9_Kjg.jpeg?1793372241)

### App limits

You can create up to 5 apps per sub-account, combining web and mobile projects.

If you've reached the limit, you'll need to delete an existing app before creating another.

Important: Deleting an app is permanent from the user interface. Review your decision carefully before confirming.

### Who can access your apps?

Access depends on your HighLevel sub-account role.

Admins can view, edit, and delete apps created within the sub-account.

Standard users can create apps and manage the apps they own, but cannot see other users' apps.

Users who have access to open an app can also access its publishing controls.

## 11. Building with External AI Tools (MCP)

For advanced users, Client App Builder also supports building web apps through compatible external AI development tools using HighLevel's Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration.

Supported setup options include Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor, and VS Code.

### How it works

1. Open the Build from your editor section in Client App Builder.
2. Choose your preferred supported AI tool.
3. Follow the displayed MCP connection instructions.
4. Sign in to HighLevel.
5. Select the sub-account you want to work with.
6. Approve the requested access.

![Build from your editor (MCP)](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084618577/original/t_r224hcaWwQno1nwk_h6S6mV3rXTKGa_w.jpeg?1793372241)

Once connected, supported tools can help create apps, initiate builds, check progress, answer setup questions, and edit app files.

Important: MCP access does not currently support publishing or unpublishing apps, managing secrets, or building mobile apps in production.

## 12. Current Limitations

Client App Builder continues to evolve. Keep the following limitations in mind when planning your app.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Capability | Current support |
| Web app creation | Supported |
| Android app creation | Supported |
| iOS app creation | Not yet available |
| Google Play / App Store publishing | Not yet available |
| Custom web domains | Supported, up to 10 |
| Apps per sub-account | 5 |
| AI-generated Custom Objects | Supported, subject to CRM limits |
| Ready-made industry templates | Coming soon |
| Web app duplication | Not currently available |
| Web version history and restore | Not currently available |
| Custom server-side code and databases | Not supported |
| Third-party npm package installation | Not supported |
| Custom payment checkout | Not supported; supported payments use HighLevel invoices |
| Desktop apps and PWA generation | Not yet available |
| Builder interface language | English |

Client App Builder is designed to build experiences on top of supported HighLevel capabilities. It is not a general-purpose backend development environment.

## 13. Frequently Asked Questions

### Do I need coding experience to use Client App Builder?

No. You can describe the experience you want in natural language, and AI helps build it. You can continue refining your app through conversations and available customization controls.

### Can I use my existing HighLevel courses and communities?

Yes. Client App Builder integrates with supported Client Portal features, including courses, communities, shared files, appointments, and member accounts.

### Can I create both web and mobile apps?

Yes. You can create both app types within the same sub-account, subject to the combined limit of five apps. Each app must be created as either Web or Mobile.

### Can I convert a web app into a mobile app later?

No. The app type cannot be changed after creation. You must create a separate app for the other platform.

### Can I use my own domain?

Yes, for web apps. You can connect up to ten custom domains per app, provided they meet the domain requirements.

### Can I publish an app to the Apple App Store or Google Play?

Not currently. Android APK generation is supported, but direct app-store publishing and iOS app generation are not yet available.

### Can I make changes after publishing?

Yes, you can continue editing your projects. Web apps can be republished with updates.

For mobile apps, update behavior depends on the starting point. ClientPortal Standard supports publishing certain changes to installed apps, while new AI-generated screens in Describe It Instead require an APK rebuild, which is not yet available.

### Can members submit information through my app?

Yes. Custom Objects allow you to create supported forms and record-based experiences that store information in your HighLevel CRM.

### Can I add payments to my app?

Supported web experiences can use HighLevel invoice-based payment actions. Custom shopping carts, coupons, and independent checkout systems are not currently supported.

### Can I use an external AI coding tool?

Yes. Supported MCP integrations allow compatible external AI tools to work with web app projects. Publishing must still be completed through Client App Builder.

### What happens if an AI build stops or fails?

You can review the available build status or error details and send another prompt to continue or fix the issue.

If a build is interrupted, the builder provides an option to continue through a new message. Mobile build checks may also identify the affected file and location.

### Why is my preview taking time to load?

A preview may pause after a period of inactivity. When you return, the builder can restart the preview environment. This does not affect your published app.

### Can I restore a deleted app?

Deleted apps cannot currently be restored through the Client App Builder interface. Make sure you no longer need an app before deleting it.

---

## Start Building with Client App Builder

Whether you're creating a custom member portal or launching a branded Android experience, Client App Builder gives you a way to bring your ideas to life using AI and the HighLevel tools you already use.

Enable Client App Builder in Labs, describe your app, and start building.

title_en: How to Sell Gift Cards
source_md:
HighLevel Gift Cards let you sell prepaid balances your customers can buy for themselves or send to others. You can sell via a dedicated checkout link, embed, QR code, or existing checkouts like Funnels, Forms, Stores, Websites, Payment Links, Invoices, and Calendars.

This article walks you through each selling method, what customers experience, and best practices for smooth delivery and redemption.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [Overview of Selling Gift Cards](#Overview-of-Selling-Gift-Cards)
  - [Key Benefits of Selling Gift Cards](#Key-Benefits-of-Selling-Gift-Cards)
  - [Prerequisites](#Prerequisites)
  - [Test Mode vs Live Mode](#Test-Mode-vs-Live-Mode)
  - [Supported Channels](#Supported-Channels)
  - [Selling Gift Cards Using the Dedicated Checkout Link](#Selling-Gift-Cards-Using-the-Dedicated-Checkout-Link)
    - [How to Access the Dedicated Checkout Link to Sell Gift Cards](#How-to-Access-the-Dedicated-Checkout-Link-to-Sell-Gift-Cards)
    - [How to Access the 'Test' Link to Sell 'Test' Gift Cards](#How-to-Access-the-'Test'-Link-to-Sell-'Test'-Gift-Cards)
    - [Customer Experience in the Dedicated Checkout Link](#Customer-Experience-in-the-Dedicated-Checkout-Link)
  - [Selling Gift Cards Using the Embed Code](#Selling-Gift-Cards-Using-the-Embed-Code)
  - [Selling Gift Cards Using QR Codes](#Selling-Gift-Cards-Using-QR-Codes)
  - [Selling Gift Cards Through Existing Checkouts](#Selling-Gift-Cards-Through-Existing-Checkouts)
    - [Selling Through Forms](#Selling-Through-Forms)
    - [Selling Through Funnels](#Selling-Through-Funnels)
    - [Selling Through Stores](#Selling-Through-Stores)
    - [Selling Through Payment Links](#Selling-Through-Payment-Links)
    - [Selling Through Invoices](#Selling-Through-Invoices)
    - [Selling Through Calendars](#Selling-Through-Calendars)
  - [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
  - [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **Overview of Selling Gift Cards**

Selling Gift Cards is the process of offering a **prepaid balance** as a product in HighLevel. You can sell a gift card through its own checkout or by adding it to your existing selling workflows (Funnels, Forms, Stores, Websites, Payment Links, Invoices, and Calendars). This allows you to sell gift cards wherever your customers already buy!

When a customer completes a purchase, HighLevel creates a **Gift Card Order** and delivers the gift card based on the delivery option selected at checkout (immediate or scheduled). Each Gift Card includes:

- A **dedicated checkout link**
- An **embed code**
- A **QR code**
- The ability to be **added to any checkout that supports product selection**

---

## **Key Benefits of Selling Gift Cards**

- **Multiple Sales Channels**: Sell via a dedicated link, embed, QR code, or existing checkouts for maximum reach.
- **Gifting Built In**: "Myself or Someone Else" flows make it simple to buy for others with scheduled delivery.
- **Safe Testing & Rollout**: Separate Test and Live links help you validate pricing, denominations, and flows without affecting real balances.
- **Immediate Cash Flow:** Collect revenue before redemption occurs.
- **Brand-Aligned Design**: Upload custom artwork and choose gradients to create gift cards that match your branding.

---

## **Prerequisites**

Confirm these items to ensure a smooth launch process! Before you can sell gift cards, make sure you have:

- **At least one Gift Card Product is****created and active**  
    
  - Before selling gift cards, you must first create and activate at least one gift card. This can be done within **Payments → Gift Cards → Create Gift Card.**
  - [For a detailed overview of the process to create a gift card, click here](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006980-getting-started-with-gift-cards#How-to-Create-a-Gift-Card-Product)
- **A c****onnected payment method**  
    
  - You must have a payment method setup in order to collect payments when selling gift cards.
  - [For a detailed overview on how to set up payments, click here](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48000981400)

---

## **Test Mode vs Live Mode**

**Test Mode** is a safe sandbox with separate checkout links and payment keys. Use it to simulate purchases, validate pricing/taxes, check inventory behavior, preview delivery messages, and test redemption. **Live Mode** is for real transactions.

Gift cards purchased in:

- **Test Mode** → redeemable only in test mode checkouts
- **Live Mode** → redeemable only in live mode checkouts

```
Tip: Send (issuing without payment) is Live mode only. Click here to learn how to send Gift Cards
```

---

## **Supported Channels**

See every surface where Gift Cards can be sold and click the links below to jump directly to the setup steps for each. Choose one or combine multiple sales channels to match your strategy!

- **[Dedicated Checkout Link](#Selling-Gift-Cards-Using-the-Dedicated-Checkout-Link):** a standalone page for each Gift Card product.
- **[Embed Code:](#Selling-Gift-Cards-Using-the-Embed-Code)** place the checkout directly on a website page.
- **[QR Code](#Selling-Gift-Cards-Using-QR-Codes):** ideal for in‑person or print; opens the dedicated checkout link.
- **[Existing Checkouts:](#Selling-Gift-Cards-Through-Existing-Checkouts)** add the Gift Card as a product to:

  - **[Forms](#Selling-Through-Forms)**
  - **[Funnels](#Selling-Through-Funnels)**
  - **[Stores](#Selling-Through-Stores)**
  - **[Payment Links](#Selling-Through-Payment-Links)**
  - **[Invoices](#Selling-Through-Invoices)**
  - **[Calendars](#Selling-Through-Calendars)**

---

## **Selling Gift Cards Using the Dedicated Checkout Link**

[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/XmoUhsKCJC4?&wmode=opaque)

The dedicated checkout link is a standalone purchase page that comes with every Gift Card product. It’s the fastest way to start selling, perfect for sharing in emails, SMS, social posts, or as a button on your website, without building a funnel or form. Each Gift Card Product has its own unique checkout link in both Test and Live modes.

### **How to Access the Dedicated Checkout Link to Sell Gift Cards**

Use these steps to grab the Live Dedicated Checkout Link you can share with customers right away.

#### **Step 1:** Navigate to Gift Cards

In the left menu, click the **Payments**tab. Then in the top ribbon, click **Gift Cards** to open the Gift Cards dashboard.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058977592/original/eP0yWOj1qpmOaDM-0WZz-YPmnfqvaXVybg.jpeg?1763747983)

#### **Step 2:**Choose a Gift Card

Locate your card you would like to open the Dedicated Checkout Link for. On the Gift Card tile, click **Sell**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058977614/original/65Td6F0agjaG9GXPY62YyBie9Egu0tDalQ.png?1763748029)

#### **Step 3:** Copy Dedicated Checkout Link

Click the **Copy** icon to copy the **Live Mode****Checkout Link** to your clipboard. Share this link with your customers so they can purchase the gift card

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058977676/original/o5iXB--uasIRnRZHwdG6EiTOwbuXRU2dLA.png?1763748129)

### **How to Access the 'Test' Link to Sell 'Test' Gift Cards**

Use these steps to copy a Test link for internal QA without affecting real balances.

#### **Step 1:** Navigate to Gift Cards

In the left menu, click the **Payments**tab. Then in the top ribbon, click **Gift Cards** to open the Gift Cards dashboard.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058977733/original/MS_bB5EHGbrFT8UDNJfZf4_hushhkmAlHw.jpeg?1763748200)

#### **Step 2:**Choose a Gift Card

Locate your card you would like to open the Dedicated Checkout Link for. On the Gift Card tile, click **Sell**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058977614/original/65Td6F0agjaG9GXPY62YyBie9Egu0tDalQ.png?1763748029)

#### **Step 3:**Click Test Mode Checkout Link

Click **Test Mode Checkout Link**in the upper-right corner to open the Test Mode Checkout Link. This link can be used for internal testing!

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058977794/original/rYnO7Pjg20JGgPZPKKgUyaRa1ecIxU1VrA.png?1763748294)

### **Customer Experience in the Dedicated Checkout Link**

This summary describes the flow that buyers will go through when purchasing a gift card using the Dedicated Purchase Link.

#### **Step 1:**Select a Denomination

The buyer selects one of the available values (e.g., $10, $25, $50, $100).

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058977928/original/tiP8dlvbirStiiXPosVIaqrs1QC9xafnVg.png?1763748657)

#### **Step 2:**Select Who the Gift Card is For

#### 

The buyer chooses who the gift card is for by selecting **Myself** or **Someone Else**

- **If the gift is for someone else:** the checkout collects the recipient’s name and email, plus the sender’s name and email.  
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058978830/original/yOrGVrvZooPsYcUVH0tLGOaHWvJZrNFZIA.png?1763749017)
- **If the gift is for myself:** the checkout collects the buyers name and email.  
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058978851/original/CZfTI7nI7yD7bY37nc-fsHGBGoTULdvTAQ.png?1763749066)

#### **Step 3:** Add Delivery Date

Choose **Deliver Now** (immediate) or **Schedule for later** and pick a **date** (and time, if shown).

Add an optional **message** for the recipient.

```
Important: Scheduled gift cards are only sent later but if the code is accessed and used on any checkout for redemption, it will allow to be redeemed
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058979342/original/Cp-5d275rL4S6_ei-aYCN3xsEslF3dCWvQ.png?1763750155)

**Step 4:** Complete Payment & Confirmation

The buyer selects an available **payment method** and clicks **Pay**.

Once payment is confirmed, the buyer is able to download the gift card from this screen.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058980015/original/Sxdvl_RTquSqEKn9PvWXlH0AQTPjMaDEIA.png?1763751144)

**Step 5:** Delivery

If buying for someone else, the recipient receives the gift card via email at the chosen time (immediate or at a scheduled date)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058979378/original/somg39aFUZOM0TAqnT9yroV05yNshhrgEQ.png?1763750271)

---

## **Selling Gift Cards Using the Embed Code**

[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/yn\_QMp6MV4k?&wmode=opaque)

Add the dedicated checkout to any external webpage without custom development! Once embedded, customers can browse gift cards and complete purchases without leaving your website. This code can be embedded into:

- WordPress websites
- HTML landing pages
- Blog pages
- Custom portals
- Link-in-bio pages

Follow the steps below to embed the dedicated gift card checkout directly onto any external webpage:

#### **Step 1:** Navigate to Gift Cards

In the left menu, click the **Payments**tab. Then in the top ribbon, click **Gift Cards** to open the Gift Cards dashboard.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058894091/original/e6bHr0noS5eCDtJiwd8HQdUawymLnoiSyA.jpeg?1763677096)

#### **Step 2:**Click Sell

Locate your card you would like to find the Embed Code for. On the Gift Card tile, click **Sell**.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058894118/original/haCSRs-4UdxbPT4uJ_THBCDT3B15NOBxIA.png?1763677185)**

#### **Step 3:**Copy the Embed Code

Click the **Copy**button to copy the embed code. Use this code to embed the dedicated gift card checkout directly onto any external webpage

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058894124/original/huqnF2TdNqzdQjHxPQWWmSaUiUHvjBjafg.png?1763677230)

---

## **Selling Gift Cards Using QR Codes**

[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/WQuCKWmkHNc?&wmode=opaque)

QR codes make in-person and offline selling easy. Scanning the code opens your same dedicated checkout link. This is perfect for in-store displays, print campaigns or on any medium that’s not clickable. To access this QR Code, follow the steps below:

#### **Step 1:** Navigate to Gift Cards

In the left menu, click the **Payments**tab. Then in the top ribbon, click **Gift Cards** to open the Gift Cards dashboard.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058893858/original/oLyafhbXGZQ_w3KAnNJcRuRZnyQVLtS7Eg.png?1763676221)

#### **Step 2:**Open QR Code

Locate your card you would like to find the QR Code for. On the Gift Card tile, click **QR Code**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058893884/original/cnQr4AIek9CDsNMEMRBUe9QHS7vScHSfdA.png?1763676331)

#### **Step 3:** Share QR Code

#### 

From here you are able to download and share the QR Code!

- Click **Download** to save the QR image. This file can then be used in print media and other campaigns!  
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058893913/original/Bj8Y3gzVnJI4iH8q0Y2XKqbSfK3gvP8j7Q.png?1763676488)
- Click **Share,**then from the dropdown select **Copy** to copy the QR Code link. This link can then be shared!  
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058893979/original/F8aL2Hz57m42F1BGPcLnbsaq83WHvCOvWw.png?1763676695)

---

## **Selling Gift Cards Through Existing Checkouts**

[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/TB1AFd5CrfM?&wmode=opaque)

Gift Cards can be sold as a product on all supported checkouts. This option gives you full flexibility to bundle gift cards along with your other items. Adding a Gift Card Product is supported in the following channels:

- Forms
- Funnels
- Store
- Payment Links
- Websites
- Invoices
- Calendars (if the calendar supports products)

Follow the steps below to learn how to sell gift cards on each supported checkout channel!

### **Selling Through Forms**

Use the Payment Element in Forms to sell Gift Cards in lead capture and lightweight checkout scenarios.

Collect payment and sell a gift card in a single form submission

#### **Step 1:** Open or Create a Form

Navigate to **Sites → Forms**and either open an existing form or create a new form.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058894265/original/niwLmGsc4K_kgpOYblVYKVovmsHfcvyA-A.png?1763677829)

#### **Step 2:**Add Sell Products Element

#### 

Locate the **Sell****Products**element under **Payments**and drag the element to your form.

#### **Step 3:** Choose the Gift Card Product

Click on the **Sell Products**element to open the element settings. From here, click **Add Product**and select your gift card from the list.

Once the gift card has been added as a product, click the blue **Save**button to save your changes.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058894313/original/gzhNEhCxSjiesVLBmAu-cEG-yFFE8ZXC2g.png?1763678047)

### 

### **Selling Through Funnels**

Offer gift cards on one-step or two-step order forms within a funnel. Customers buying through a funnel will receive the gift card automatically after successful payment!

```
Tip: If you add gift cards to a test-mode funnel, customers will receive test gift cards only.
```

#### **Step 1:** Open Your Funnel

Navigate to **Sites → Funnels**and either open an existing funnel or create a new funnel.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058980587/original/EfUWr_6t_BcvXgaemnfwRwDHjbRpTNo2Yg.png?1763752272)

#### **Step 2:**Add the Form Element

Locate the **Form**element and drag the element into your page.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058980688/original/lCPm9wksAi11NQa76EzvCKHDpznxkUAx5A.png?1763752558)

#### **Step 3:** Select Form

Click on the Form element and use the dropdown to select the form you previously set up for purchasing gift cards. If you do not have a form for the gift card, click on the link to create a new form. [For more information on creating a form to purchase gift cards, click here.](#Selling-Through-Forms)

Once the form has been added and all edits have been completed, publish your funnel.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058980708/original/fXsBBpDOj3PHVdF98tNsizK--5gNH8mOpA.png?1763752621)

### **Selling Through Stores**

Display gift cards in your online storefront so customers can browse and buy like any other product.

#### **Step 1:**Open or Create a Store

Navigate to **Sites → Stores**and either open an existing store or create a new store.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058894377/original/oSZvcGDcpl0azoBEop1yRrCqNNj3tb7wmg.png?1763678278)

#### **Step 2:** Navigate to Products

From the store page, navigate to the **Products**tab.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058894445/original/1bbab-r4vul0hIQyoK4Kme5awfGjNglnrA.png?1763678494)

#### **Step 3:**Add to Store

Click the **Checkbox** next to the gift card you would like to add to the store. Then click **Bulk Actions**and from the dropdown, select **Include in this store.**

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058894457/original/XQcKVvR7omxOSvcyEGL94F8hXaapW6jsRg.png?1763678553)

#### **Step 4:** Preview

Customers can browse and purchase gift cards like any other item!

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058894577/original/3GhZP_WqLngr27n2oyPVFpyOH7UHo9UmmA.png?1763678948)

### **Selling Through Payment Links**

Payment Links are fast to create and easy to share, making them great for email or chat.

#### **Step 1:** Create New Payment Link

Navigate to **Payments → Payment Links**and create a new Payment Link.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058894733/original/dsEuT-0ww0q-SL_8e-zklVtjfWaT8ycD1g.png?1763679443)

#### **Step 2:** Add Gift Card as a Product

Click **Select a Product** and from the dropdown, choose the gift card you would like to add. Once the gift card has been added, click the blue **Save**button.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058894771/original/KJmCFiha-F7tZMcmqMpGkvbmrFtjzeqbrg.png?1763679539)

#### **Step 3:** Share Payment Link

Click the **Copy/Send**button to get the new shareable payment link that you have created. You can now share this payment link with customers!

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058894840/original/1Os03D7wm-z4yCYq2WtWpHUPWJglAPPxxw.png?1763679762)

### **Selling Through Invoices**

Add Gift Cards to invoices for customers who prefer invoicing and accounts payable workflows. When the invoice is paid, a Gift Card Order is created automatically.

#### **Step 1:**Open or Create an Invoice

Navigate to **Payments → Invoices & Estimates**and open and existing or create a new Invoice.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058949476/original/F-jihcoyZieeJlQNb8iT598-1c2O6JwLJw.png?1763731750)

#### **Step 2:**Add Gift Card as Product

Under **Add Products,**select the gift card(s) you would like to be included in the invoice. Once all details and products have been added, click **Send**to send the invoice to a customer.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058958390/original/r0mk-2yAMPJRZpmYQdwKYQsfzfDUAaO3hA.png?1763736233)

#### **Step 3:** Delivery Upon Payment

Once invoice is paid, the gift card is delivered to the buyer!

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058959079/original/fzxIetCYMzN7KF5YigouZDgpQWX3mHehXA.png?1763736501)**

### **Selling Through Calendars**

If your calendar supports product-based payments, you can add your Gift Card Product to the appointment flow. In order to sell gift cards through the calendar flow, you must first create a form. [Click here for details on how to create a form to sell gift cards.](#Selling-Through-Forms)

#### **Step 1:** Open Calendar Settings

Navigate to **Calendar Settings** and click **Edit**on the calendar you would like to add Gift Cards to.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058980869/original/E4q6SEcEfUV6LjWhFBv0LvipUZMEHhSpcA.png?1763753034)

#### **Step 2:**Select the Form

Under the **Forms & Payments**tab, use the **Select Form** dropdown to select the form you previously set up for purchasing gift cards.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058981059/original/RKlw06t0B66P5DtAhhIZfvZIrcY9BHxRMQ.png?1763753325)

#### **Step 3:** Enable Payments

Under **Payments,**toggle on **Accept Payments.**Once these edits are completed, click **Save.**

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155058981119/original/I1qpKxolUOOnxcFLzR6LjMPGfeaWM3Xmgg.png?1763753385)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I sell the same gift card through multiple channels simultaneously?**

Yes. A gift card can be sold via its link, QR, embed, and through any existing checkout. Inventory will keep on depleting as more sales happen for the gift card.

**Q: What happens if a Gift Card Product is deactivated?**

Its Sell flow stops working — the checkout link becomes invalid, and it cannot be purchased from Stores but rest of the checkouts where it is already added continue to operate sales and the products have to be manually removed from such checkouts when the card is deactivated.

**Q: Can I sell gift card products through all payment providers?**

Yes. Gift card can be sold through any of your default checkout payment providers. However redemption on all types of products and scenarios can only be done in case of Stripe, NMI, Authorize.net and Square.

**Q: Can customers use one gift card to buy another gift card?**

No. Gift cards can’t be used to purchase more gift cards.

---

- [Getting Started with Gift Cards](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006980)
- [How to Send Gift Cards](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006987-how-to-send-gift-cards)
- [How to Track Gift Card Performance (Analytics & Metric Tracking)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006981-how-to-track-gift-card-performance-analytics-metric-tracking-)

title_en: How to Use AI Verification for Branded Mobile Apps
source_md:
Branded App AI Review Automation makes it faster and easier to prepare your Branded Mobile App for submission in HighLevel. Instead of waiting up to five days for a manual review, you can receive automated feedback on your app details in seconds.

The updated Branded Mobile App Builder helps you configure branding, enter app information, resolve verification issues, and submit your app through a guided process. This reduces avoidable submission errors and helps move your app toward publication faster.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Branded App AI Review Automation?](#What-is-Branded-App-AI-Review-Automation?)
- [Branded Mobile App Builder Overview](#Branded-Mobile-App-Builder-Overview)
- [Branding Requirements](#Branding-Requirements)
- [App Setup Details](#App-Setup-Details)
- [AI Verification Checks](#AI-Verification-Checks)
- [Understanding Verification Results](#Understanding-Verification-Results)
- [How to Set Up and Verify Your Branded Mobile App](#How-to-Set-Up-and-Verify-Your-Branded-Mobile-App)
  - [Step 1: Open the Branded Mobile App Builder](#Step-1%3A-Open-the-Branded-Mobile-App-Builder)
  - [Step 2: Configure Your App Branding](#Step-2%3A-Configure-Your-App-Branding)
  - [Step 3: Complete Personal Information](#Step-3%3A-Complete-Personal-Information)
  - [Step 4: Configure App Details](#Step-4%3A-Configure-App-Details)
  - [Step 5: Complete Development Details](#Step-5%3A-Complete-Development-Details)
  - [Step 6: Review AI Verification Results](#Step-6%3A-Review-AI-Verification-Results)
  - [Step 7: Re-run Verification](#Step-7%3A-Re-run-Verification)
  - [Step 8: Submit Your Branded Mobile App](#Step-8%3A-Submit-Your-Branded-Mobile-App)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **What is Branded App AI Review Automation?**

Branded App AI Review Automation is an automated verification process built into HighLevel's Branded Mobile App Builder. It checks required app information before submission, helping identify missing details, inaccessible URLs, credential issues, and other problems that could delay the app publishing process.

Previously, app details underwent a manual review that could take up to five days. With AI-powered verification, users receive results in seconds and can correct flagged issues immediately.

The new **Verification** tab displays the results of each check, identifies issues requiring attention, and provides direct actions to resolve them. Once all required checks pass, the app can be submitted for the next stage of the app-building and store setup process.

After submission, HighLevel uses its automated system, Pilot, to streamline store setup without requiring the previous manual review.

```
Note: AI verification takes place before app submission. Apple and Google maintain their own app review processes, and passing HighLevel's checks does not guarantee approval by either store.
```

---

## **Branded Mobile App Builder Overview**

The Branded Mobile App Builder provides a centralized workspace for preparing and submitting your app. Its guided interface helps you track progress, complete required information, and understand what happens between purchasing the app and making it available to users.

Navigate to **Sites → Client Portal → Branded Mobile App** in your HighLevel sub-account to access the builder.

The interface contains four main tabs:

- **Overview:** Displays your app's launch progress and the steps remaining before publication.
- **Branding:** Lets you upload and configure app icons, carousel images, and the Play Store banner.
- **App setup:** Collects personal information, app details, and developer account information.
- **Verification:** Runs automated checks and highlights issues that must be resolved before submission.

The Overview page also displays the overall app launch journey:

1. **Payment received:** Confirms successful payment for the Branded Mobile App.
2. **Add your branding and details:** Requires you to complete the information needed to build and submit your app.
3. **We're building your app:** Indicates that HighLevel is building the app and preparing its submission to the app stores.
4. **Store review:** Indicates that the app has reached the Apple or Google review stage.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083702919/original/1OS3PJpLTBaxvSy9Zha7h2xJNMu11_uRoQ.png?1792443858)

**Note:** The **Book a call with our team** option is available to eligible agency users who need assistance with the setup process. It is not part of the automated verification requirements.

---

## **Branding Requirements**

Your app's branding determines how it appears on mobile devices and in app store listings. Providing images in the required dimensions and formats helps ensure your branding displays consistently and can pass the applicable verification checks.

Open the **Branding** tab to configure the following assets.

### **App Icon**

The app icon represents your brand on iOS and Android devices.

Upload an icon that meets these requirements:

- **Dimensions:** 1024 × 1024 pixels
- **File format:** PNG
- **Usage:** Default app icon for iOS and Android devices

Click **Upload Icon** to select your image.

### **Carousel**

Carousel images appear during the app's signup or sign-in experience. They help introduce users to your brand and highlight important features.

The displayed upload requirements are:

- **Dimensions:** 600 × 800 pixels
- **File format:** PNG

For each carousel item, you can configure an image and title. The interface displays a 50-character counter for each title.

You can also rearrange carousel items using their drag handles or remove items using the **X** icon.

The updated branding experience uses a more compatible image format to provide consistent carousel appearance across supported devices.

### **Play Store Banner**

The Play Store banner helps showcase your app in its Google Play listing.

The displayed requirements are:

- **Dimensions:** 1024 × 500 pixels
- **File formats:** PNG or JPG

Click the upload area or drag a supported image into it.

The mobile preview on the right side of the Branding page helps you review how your app branding appears on a device.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083702929/original/RBlzdtQ8mTurt2gvUN9j-aEEzQxyIxCFCw.png?1792443894)**

---

## **App Setup Details**

App setup collects the business, app listing, and developer information required to prepare your Branded Mobile App. Completing these details accurately helps the automated verification process validate your submission and reduces the likelihood of corrections later.

The **App setup** tab contains three stages:

1. Personal Information
2. App Details
3. Development Details

### **1. Personal Information**

Personal Information identifies the contact responsible for the app and provides users with a way to access support.

Complete the following fields:

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Full name | Name of the person responsible for the app submission. |
| Phone number | Contact phone number, including the appropriate country code. |
| Email | Primary contact email address. |
| Support Email | Support email address, if different from the primary email. |
| Support URL | Web address where users can access app support. |
| Address | Contact or business address associated with the app. |

Fields marked with a red asterisk (\*) are required.

Make sure the Support URL is publicly accessible and loads correctly. An inaccessible support page can cause verification to fail.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083702944/original/JpMyWop5ZNM4OplkeQpY2XH5Sxaz6QrrGw.png?1792443926)**

### **2. App Details**

App Details define how users discover and understand your app in the app stores.

Provide the following information:

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| App Name | The name displayed for your Branded Mobile App. |
| Terms and Conditions URL | Publicly accessible page containing your app's terms and conditions. |
| Privacy Policy URL | Publicly accessible page describing how user information is handled. |
| App Distribution Countries | Countries or regions where your app should be available. |
| App Short Description | Brief summary of your app's purpose and functionality. |
| App Description | Detailed explanation of your app and its features. |

The interface displays these character limits:

- **App Name:** Up to 30 characters, using letters, numbers, and spaces.
- **App Short Description:** Up to 80 characters.
- **App Description:** Up to 4,000 characters.

Select the countries where you want your app to be available. You can also deselect countries or regions where you do not want the app distributed.

When entering your legal page URLs, make sure the pages load successfully and contain appropriate content. Automated verification can review legal pages in different languages.

The verification process may flag specific content in legal pages. For example, the provided interface shows a Terms and Conditions page flagged for payment-related terminology. Follow the displayed error message to determine what needs correction.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083702958/original/v2iKcazU-emVv4uTorkSRIEq2g7tJZRHBQ.png?1792443951)**

### **3. Development Details**

Development Details connect the information needed for Apple and Google app publishing. The updated process reduces setup friction by removing the requirement to provide Apple and Google account passwords.

Complete the applicable fields under **Google Developer Credentials** and **Apple Developer Credentials**.

**Google Developer Credentials**

- **Google Developer Email:** Email address associated with your Google Play developer account.
- **Google Developer Account Name:** Name of the Google Play developer account.

**Apple Developer Credentials**

- **Apple Developer Email:** Email address associated with your Apple Developer account.
- **Apple Developer Account Name:** Name of your Apple Developer account.
- **App Store Connect Key ID:** Identifier associated with the required App Store Connect key.
- **App Store Connect Key File:** Key file uploaded for the App Store Connect integration.
- **DUNS Number:** Business identifier requested for the developer account.

**Add Account Admin**

The **Add account admin** area lets you provide the required account access for HighLevel's app specialist.

Click **Add Admin** and follow the provided instructions to grant the necessary access to App Store Connect and Google Play.

The interface also provides tutorial links beside certain Apple credential fields and a **Learn more** link for administrator access.

**Important:** Developer account information and appropriate administrator access remain necessary even though Apple and Google account passwords are no longer required.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083702978/original/7bTUfdOkQnMfyiPcn6s5vGxzEViqhdUHOA.png?1792443989)**

---

## **AI Verification Checks**

AI verification reviews the information supplied during app setup and highlights issues that require correction before submission. Understanding these results helps you address problems immediately rather than waiting for a separate manual review.

Open the **Verification** tab to view the pre-submission checklist.

The verification page checks the following information:

| Verification check | What it evaluates |
| --- | --- |
| Privacy policy URL | Whether the submitted privacy policy page meets applicable validation requirements. |
| Terms and conditions URL | Whether the legal page is accessible and its content passes the automated checks. |
| Support URL | Whether the submitted support page loads successfully. |
| Carousel images | Whether the configured carousel images pass verification. |
| App descriptions | Whether the submitted app descriptions pass verification. |
| App Store Connect credentials | Whether the supplied Apple developer connection information passes verification. |
| Add account admin | Whether the required account administrator access passes verification. |

### **Understanding Verification Results**

The Verification page displays the status of each check.

- **Green checkmark — Verified:** The information has passed the corresponding verification check.
- **Red X — Failed:** The information requires attention before submission.
- **Remaining count:** Indicates how many checks still need to be resolved.

Failed checks display an explanation of the problem and a **Fix** button that takes you to the relevant configuration area.

For example:

- A Terms and Conditions URL may fail because its content includes restricted payment-related terminology identified by the checker.
- A Support URL may fail because the page could not be loaded successfully.

After correcting the issues, use **Re-check** to run the automated checks again.

The **Submit for review** button remains unavailable while required verification issues are outstanding.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083702993/original/FPeH_x931XYlSij7XU2tybaKK6m3YRPvqQ.png?1792444025)**

---

## **How to Set Up and Verify Your Branded Mobile App**

Completing each stage in the correct order ensures your branding, app information, and developer credentials are available for automated verification. Reviewing the results and resolving outstanding issues before submission helps avoid unnecessary delays in the app publishing process.

### **Step 1: Open the Branded Mobile App Builder**

1. Log in to your HighLevel sub-account.
2. Navigate to **Sites → Client Portal → Branded Mobile App**.
3. Open the **Overview** tab.
4. Review the launch progress and confirm that payment has been received.
5. Proceed to **Branding** to begin configuring your app.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083703069/original/3qdSjAfJWSyoYNBWl7IppN5gSuHKjOhxRQ.png?1792444149)

### **Step 2: Configure Your App Branding**

3. Add your **Carousel** images and their titles.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083703073/original/bEoBpuKSeDANiB9WpoOLnp11HhL0qdblqQ.png?1792444166)

### **Step 3: Complete Personal Information**

1. Open the **App setup** tab.
2. Select **Personal Information**.
3. Enter your full name, phone number, and email address.
4. Provide a Support Email if applicable.
5. Enter your publicly accessible **Support URL**.
6. Provide your address.
7. Click **Save & Continue**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083703084/original/hlk46SDDshYHO5yOd9BnzuQAB6atVxKZbQ.png?1792444185)

### **Step 4: Configure App Details**

1. Select **App Details**.
2. Enter your app name.
3. Provide your **Terms and Conditions URL**.
4. Provide your **Privacy Policy URL**.
5. Select your **App Distribution Countries**.
6. Enter an **App Short Description**.
7. Complete the full **App Description**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083703089/original/kLnfjzQM25Dh9ncC6ln4u4ya7iFqkvOukQ.png?1792444209)

Make sure your descriptions comply with the displayed character limits and accurately represent your app's functionality.

### **Step 5: Complete Development Details**

1. Select **Development Details**.
2. Enter your Google Developer Email and Account Name.
3. Enter your Apple Developer Email and Account Name.
4. Provide the required **App Store Connect Key ID**.
5. Upload your **App Store Connect Key File**.
6. Enter your **DUNS Number**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083703099/original/nMrVZx8FjbgOWbJ9mHKQ9AC-ikfb8t9C8g.png?1792444253)

You do not need to provide Apple or Google account passwords as part of the updated process.

### **Step 6: Review AI Verification Results**

1. Open the **Verification** tab.
2. Review the automated checklist.
3. Identify any items marked with a red X.
4. Read the error message for each failed check.
5. Click **Fix** beside an issue to navigate to the relevant field.
6. Update the information causing the failure.
7. Save your changes.
8. Return to **Verification**.

### **Step 7: Re-run Verification**

1. On the Verification page, click **Re-check**.
2. Wait for the automated checks to complete.
3. Review the updated verification results.
4. Repeat the correction and re-check process if issues remain.
5. Confirm that all required checks show successful results.

AI verification is designed to provide results in seconds, although actual completion time may vary.

### **Step 8: Submit Your Branded Mobile App**

1. Confirm that all required verification checks have passed.
2. Review your branding and app details for accuracy.
3. Click **Submit for review** once the button becomes available.
4. Follow any final submission prompts displayed in the interface.

After submission, HighLevel's automated Pilot system handles the store setup workflow without the previous manual pre-submission review.

Your app will still need to go through the applicable Apple and Google store review processes before becoming publicly available.

```
Important: Review all submitted details carefully. The existing Branded Mobile App documentation states that changes cannot be made after submission, so make sure your information is accurate before proceeding.
```

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: How long does AI verification take?**

AI verification is designed to complete in seconds. This replaces the previous manual review process, which could take up to five working days. Actual verification times may vary.

**Q: Does passing AI verification guarantee that my app will be approved by Apple or Google?**

No. AI verification checks your submission before it enters the app store publishing process. Apple and Google perform their own reviews and may request changes or reject an app based on their guidelines.

**Q: What should I do if my Terms and Conditions URL fails verification?**

Read the error message displayed beside the failed check. The automated review may identify specific content that requires attention. Use **Fix** to locate the relevant URL field, review the linked page, make appropriate corrections, and run **Re-check**. Ensure any changes to legal content remain accurate and compliant with applicable requirements.

**Q: Why is my Support URL failing verification even though I entered a valid-looking link?**

The page may be unavailable, restricted, or failing to load correctly. Open the URL in a browser and confirm it can be accessed without requiring a login. Correct the URL or page availability issue, then run verification again.

**Q: Do I need to share my Apple or Google developer account password?**

No. The updated process does not require Apple or Google account passwords. You must still provide the requested developer account information and grant the appropriate administrator access.

**Q: Can the AI verify legal pages written in languages other than English?**

Yes. The release supports AI verification of privacy policies, terms and conditions, and support page content in multiple languages.

**Q: What happens if the Submit for review button is disabled?**

Check the Verification page for outstanding issues. The button remains unavailable when required checks have not passed. Resolve the flagged items and click **Re-check** to update the results.

**Q: Can I modify my app details after submitting the app?**

The existing Branded Mobile App setup documentation warns that submitted details cannot be changed afterward. Carefully review all information before submission and contact the appropriate support team if changes are needed later.

**Q: Do I still need to schedule a manual review appointment?**

The release replaces the previous manual pre-submission review with automated AI verification and removes the requirement to provide Apple and Google account passwords. Complete the developer administrator access steps shown in your current setup interface. Any account-specific access requests should be followed as displayed.
