Launch polished, data‑driven broadcasts in minutes with HighLevel’s Email Campaign Agent (Beta). This AI‑guided builder streamlines copywriting, subject‑line testing, audience targeting, and sending‑domain setup so you can send smarter campaigns—faster. Use it to generate on‑brand content with Ask AI, run A/B tests, target Segments or Smart Lists, and verify a dedicated sending domain for stronger deliverability.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Email Campaign Agent?](#%E2%80%8B%E2%80%8BWhat-is-Email-Campaign-Agent?)
- [Key Benefits of Email Campaign Agent](#Key-Benefits-of-Email-Campaign-Agent)
- [On‑Brand Email Copy with Ask AI](#On%E2%80%91Brand-Email-Copy-with-Ask-AI)
- [Subject Line A/B Testing](#Subject-Line-A/B-Testing)
- [Audience Targeting Options](#Audience-Targeting-Options)
- [How To Setup Email Campaign Agent](#How-To-Setup-Email-Campaign-Agent)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Email Campaign Agent?**

Email Campaign Agent is an **Ask AI–powered flow** you access by **prompting Ask AI** with phrases like “Create an email campaign” or “Email to promote my product.” Ask AI then launches a guided, step‑by‑step builder that assembles your campaign—on‑brand copy, subject‑line tests, audience selection, and sending‑domain checks—directly inside the Campaign Builder.

---

## **Key Benefits of Email Campaign Agent**

A focused overview of why teams use this tool and how it accelerates results. Use these benefits to align on value, set expectations, and help stakeholders understand what improves deliverability and engagement.

- **On‑brand copy**: Draft complete emails with Ask AI and your Brand Voice to reduce blank‑page time while staying consistent.
- **Faster experimentation**: Generate multiple subject lines and run a built‑in A/B test to improve opens and clicks.
- **Accurate targeting**: Pick from dynamic **Segments**, **Smart Lists**, tags, or pre‑built segments to reach the right audience.
- **Deliverability safeguards**: Guided setup for a **dedicated sending domain** with auto‑configure or manual DNS, plus **Default Headers** for DMARC alignment fallback.
- **Clear performance tracking**: View results in the **All‑in‑One Dashboard for Email Marketing** and related statistics pages.

---

## **On‑Brand Email Copy with Ask AI**

- This capability uses Content AI and your Brand Voice to convert a short brief into complete email copy. You can fine‑tune tone and intent, regenerate, or edit directly—so AI speeds you up without locking you in.
- Launch Ask AI from the campaign draft to generate body copy based on your prompt and tone.
- Connect your **Brand Voice** in Brand Boards to keep output consistent across emails, funnels, and social. ([Create Emails with Content AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001236751-how-to-create-emails-using-content-ai-), [Brand Voice in Brand Boards](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005085-brand-voice-in-brand-boards), [Brand Voice in Content AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005308-brand-voice-integration-in-content-ai))

---

## **Subject Line A/B Testing**

Split testing removes guesswork from subject‑line performance. Define the number of variations, test duration, and winning metric; the winner sends to the remainder automatically.

- Test **up to 6 variations**; require **at least 10 contacts per variation** and **40 contacts total**.
- Choose winner by **Unique Open Rate** or **Unique Click Rate**.
- A/B testing is supported only for **Send Now** and **Schedule** delivery—not **Batch** or **RSS Schedule**.

---

## **Audience Targeting Options**

Selecting the right audience is as important as the message. Email Campaign Agent supports multiple targeting methods so you can balance speed with precision.

• **Segments (campaign builder)** – Real‑time, logic‑based groups built from engagement, tags, and fields; evaluated dynamically and reusable across campaigns.

• **Pre‑Built Segments** – One‑click picks like “Engaged last 7/30/60 days” or “Interacted with last 5 campaigns.” These snapshot at creation/scheduling time.

• **Smart Lists (Contacts → Smart Lists)** – Dynamic CRM views that update at **send time**; new matches are included and non‑matches are excluded.

• **Tags** – Use existing tags or add on the Send/Schedule page to organize audiences and automate downstream.

---

## **How To Setup Email Campaign Agent**

A concise, step-by-step path to launch a campaign using **Ask AI**. You’ll start by **prompting Ask AI** (not hunting menus), then follow a guided flow that can handle domain setup, copy generation, A/B testing, audience selection, and scheduling—so everything lands in the **Campaign Builder** ready to send.

1. Open **Ask AI** and prompt it to create your campaign  
     
   Example prompts: **“Create an email campaign”**, **“Email to promote my product.”**  
     
   Ask AI will recognize the task and start the **Email Campaign Agent** guided flow in the builder.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055865684/original/GhABF39GlQZSJz2ohpnv5RxXcnK_F_-EZg.gif?1760361925)
2. Review dedicated sending domain check (optional to skip)  
     
   The flow first checks if a **dedicated sending domain** is set up.  
     
   You can **complete the guided domain setup now** (recommended for deliverability) or **skip** and finish later.  
     
   If setup is needed, you’ll be shown the required DNS records (auto-configure where supported; manual copy/paste otherwise).
3. Answer Ask AI’s brief questions  
     
   Provide your **name of Campaign**, **offer/topic**, **audience intent**, and **tone**.  
     
   Ask AI builds a refined prompt, uses the information to **generate the email body**, and **pre-fills scheduling details**.  
     
   *![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055865975/original/OhqzyckIxgWjmfobdPB0K8WlNMn95HAxBA.png?1760362117)*
4. Connect your brand kit for consistent styling (Optional)   
     
   Ask AI can **link to your Brand Board/Brand Voice** so the copy and formatting match your brand guidelines.  
     
   You can adjust tone or regenerate content as needed.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055866337/original/44n13CfpO1m7t0Z195G8cFS8pbROwBd6Dg.png?1760362267)
5. Enable subject-line A/B testing (recommended)  
     
   Turn on **Subject Line Test** to generate multiple titles  
     
   Choose number of variations (up to **6**), sample size, test duration, and the winning metric (Unique Opens or Unique Clicks).  
     
   There is an Option to use "Default settings"  
     
   *![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055866707/original/bipPguyNfZs41pG0KLnTOH7BWTFBov-zQg.png?1760362433)*
6. Choose your audience  
     
   Use **Pre-Built Segments**, **Tags**, or **Smart Lists** to target recipients now.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055867139/original/UuzCsDVgtEjpT0IFSNFRvaJKn6kybmSZkQ.png?1760362503)
7. Review and confirm the Ask AI summary  
     
   Ask AI displays a quick summary card with your Campaign name, **Description**, **Goal**, **Audience** and **Send** status.  
     
   You’ll be prompted: **“Does this look correct? (Yes/No/Edit)”**.  
     
   Choose **Yes** to let the agent create the campaign and post **“All set! I’ve created the campaign.”** with a **Review & schedule here** link that opens the campaign in the **Campaign Builder**.   
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055868234/original/d33bu5tRZFwCP9pafmqnSfeOoZm5ou35KA.png?1760362839)
8. Launch and monitor results  
     
   Click **Launch Campaign** when ready.  
     
   After send, track engagement in your email dashboards; follow up as needed (e.g., resend to unopens where applicable).  
     
   *![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055868095/original/IPls_sed467cBFOzgXXdPYGcz8n5N_OmoQ.png?1760362744)*  
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055868118/original/i8EbKBqdDJQwg0KgvdVRgD_vpF5J-YtJeA.png?1760362756)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I edit the AI‑written content before sending?**  
Yes. You can freely edit, re‑generate, and format the output from Ask AI prior to launch.

**Q: How many subject‑line variations can I test, and what are the rules?**  
Up to **6** variations; minimum **10 contacts per variation** and **40 total** contacts. A/B tests support **Send Now** and **Schedule**only (not Batch/RSS).

**Q: Do Smart Lists or Segments update after I schedule?**  
**Smart Lists** are evaluated at **send time** and update dynamically; **Pre‑Built Segments** snapshot at create/schedule; **Segments** in the builder are dynamic by design.

**Q: Where do I see results after I send?**  
Use **Marketing → Emails → Statistics** (All‑in‑One Email Dashboard) for unified metrics across Campaigns, Workflows, and Bulk Actions.

**Q: I’m using SMTP instead of LC Email/Mailgun—why are some stats missing?**  
SMTP integrations typically only show **opens** and **clicks**; **delivered/bounced** require Mailgun/LC Email. ([Troubleshooting Email Statistics](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001208601-troubleshooting-email-statistics))

**Q: Can I resend to contacts who didn’t open my email?**  
Yes, **Resend to Unopened** is supported for **RSS** and **Batch** scheduled campaigns (as well as Send Now).

**Q: Which delivery methods can I use with campaigns?**  
Choose **Send Now**, **Schedule**, **Batch Schedule**, or **RSS Schedule** depending on your goal and list size.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [How to Build Recipient Segments in Email Campaigns](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005485/)
- [Getting Started With Smart Lists](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001062094-how-to-create-manage-smart-lists)
- [Guide to Pre‑Built Contact Segments](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000003439-guide-to-pre-built-contact-segments)
- [How to Create Emails Using Content AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001236751-how-to-create-emails-using-content-ai-)
- [How to Set Up A/B Testing for Your Email Campaigns](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001230348-how-to-set-up-a-b-testing-for-your-email-campaigns)
- [How to Set Up a Dedicated Sending Domain](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001226115-dedicated-email-sending-domains-overview-setup)

title_en: Marketing Messages API for WhatsApp (MM Lite)
source_md:
MM Lite helps businesses improve WhatsApp marketing performance in HighLevel by using Meta’s optimized delivery system for eligible marketing messages. It is designed for teams that send promotions, offers, and re-engagement campaigns at scale while keeping messages timely and relevant. This article explains what MM Lite is, how it works, when to use it, and how to enable it in your WhatsApp settings.

```
IMPORTANT: MM Lite (Marketing Messages Lite) is Meta's advanced system for sending WhatsApp marketing messages more effectively. Instead of broadcasting to everyone, it prioritizes users who are most likely to engage — improving delivery rates and campaign results.

If you're using LeadConnector for WhatsApp automation, MM Lite is the upgrade that takes your marketing from basic broadcasting to intelligent, performance-driven messaging.

⚠️ Why this matters now: Meta has introduced stricter messaging limits to reduce spam. Delivery now depends on quality and engagement — MM Lite is designed to help you succeed in this new environment.
```

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is MM Lite?](#What-is-MM-Lite?)
- [Key Benefits of MM Lite](#Key-Benefits-of-MM-Lite)
- [When To Use MM Lite](#When-To-Use-MM-Lite)
- [Prerequisites To Enable MM Lite](#Prerequisites-To-Enable-MM-Lite)
- [What Happens Next?](#What-Happens-Next?)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#%E2%80%8BFrequently-Asked-Questions%C2%A0)

---

## **What is MM Lite?**

Marketing Messages Lite, or MM Lite, is Meta’s optimized delivery system for eligible WhatsApp marketing messages in HighLevel. It helps businesses send promotional WhatsApp messages more efficiently by prioritizing delivery to contacts who are more likely to engage. MM Lite is designed for marketing use cases, while standard WhatsApp messaging continues to support conversations, support, and other non-marketing communication types.

MM Lite helps businesses improve WhatsApp marketing performance without rebuilding existing templates, workflows, or campaigns. Once enabled, eligible marketing messages can use optimized delivery logic while your existing WhatsApp setup continues to work as expected.

---

## **Key Benefits of MM Lite**

MM Lite is useful for businesses that send WhatsApp marketing messages at scale and want better control over delivery timing, audience engagement, and campaign efficiency. These benefits help protect the customer experience while supporting stronger marketing outcomes.

- **Optimized Delivery:** MM Lite helps prioritize eligible WhatsApp marketing messages for contacts who are more likely to engage.
- **Improved Marketing Efficiency:** Marketing campaigns can be sent with smarter delivery logic instead of relying only on broad message distribution.
- **Time-Based Messaging:** Time-to-Live, or TTL, helps prevent outdated marketing messages from being delivered after they are no longer relevant.
- **No Template Rebuild Required:** Existing approved WhatsApp templates can continue to work after MM Lite is enabled.
- **Workflow Continuity:** Existing workflows, automations, and campaigns continue running without disruption after activation.
- **Marketing-Focused Sending:** MM Lite is designed for marketing messages, while standard WhatsApp messaging remains available for support, conversations, and other applicable message types.

---

## **When To Use MM Lite**

MM Lite is best suited for promotional WhatsApp messaging where timing, engagement, and audience quality matter. Understanding when MM Lite applies helps you choose the right sending approach for each type of customer communication.

Use MM Lite for eligible WhatsApp marketing messages, such as:

- Promotions
- Offers
- Re-engagement campaigns
- Campaign broadcasts
- Marketing follow-ups
- Product or service announcements

Continue using standard WhatsApp messaging for non-marketing use cases, such as:

- Customer support conversations
- Service conversations
- Transactional or utility updates
- Authentication messages
- Free-form replies within an active customer service window

WhatsApp messages are categorized into Marketing, Utility, Authentication, and Service message types, and each category can follow different pricing and sending behavior. For pricing and category details, review the [WhatsApp Pricing, Billing, and Rebilling Guide.](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001428-whatsapp-pricing-billing-and-rebilling-guide)

---

## **Prerequisites To Enable MM Lite**

MM Lite requires the correct WhatsApp and Meta account access before activation. Confirming these prerequisites helps avoid setup delays and ensures the upgrade can be approved from the correct business account.

Before enabling MM Lite, make sure you have:

- An active WhatsApp setup in HighLevel.
- Access to the connected Facebook Business Manager.
- A WhatsApp Business Account linked to the correct business portfolio.
- Permission to approve business-level access requests.
- Approved WhatsApp marketing templates if you plan to send template-based marketing campaigns.

Approved WhatsApp templates are required before users can send template-based outbound WhatsApp messages. Templates are created from **Settings → WhatsApp → Templates** and submitted to Meta for approval.

---

**How to Upgrade to MM Lite**

Upgrading to MM Lite in LeadConnector is quick and doesn’t disrupt your existing campaigns. Follow these steps:

[동영상](https://watchclueso.com/embed/ae83k9boxlxthvns)

1. Access Your Sub-Account

- Log in to your  sub-account
- Navigate to Settings → WhatsApp

2. Enable MM Lite

- On the dashboard, you’ll see a banner prompting you to enable MM Lite
- Click “Enable MM Lite” to begin the process

3. Redirect to WhatsApp Account Page

- You’ll be redirected to your WhatsApp account interface
- Go to the “Request” tab

4. Review the Request

- Click on “Review Request”  
     
  **![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155067122956/original/eVnr0Ju6ugeVUEpM53lmogDc8nHpRPmlyw.png?1773752179)**
- You’ll see a prompt related to improving ROI with Marketing Messages API  
     
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155067123021/original/TMLowifhj4FnUdCMw8pxvbVhLuXeIVeHGQ.png?1773752220)
- Click “Continue”

5. Approve Access

- A new screen will display: “Review LeadConnector’s access request”  
     
  **![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155067123042/original/uGII2S730g3qA02uoorVSmi34NEjH2kEPw.png?1773752237)**

- Click “Finish” to approve   
    
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155067123089/original/9Kg8QWvcLOjor2gcv6YAz87x9V8SYCn3kw.png?1773752280)

Once these steps are completed:

- MM Lite will be successfully enabled for your account  
     
  ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155067124379/original/ZC_GlB9LMZ8rhMee1sgj7BTCwtxnHDyr9w.png?1773752896)
- Your existing templates, workflows, and campaigns will continue to work without interruption

---

## **What Happens Next?**

After activation:

- Your marketing messages will start using optimized delivery logic
- Campaign performance may gradually improve as the system learns and adapts
- You can continue running campaigns as usual just with better efficiency

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: What is Marketing Messages Lite (MM Lite)?**  
MM Lite is Meta’s enhanced messaging system designed to improve the delivery of WhatsApp marketing messages. It uses intelligent optimization to help messages reach users who are more likely to engage, resulting in stronger campaign performance.

**Q: How is MM Lite different from the WhatsApp Cloud API?**  
The traditional WhatsApp Cloud API sends messages without the same marketing delivery optimization. MM Lite helps improve marketing performance by:

- Prioritizing users with higher engagement potential
- Optimizing delivery timing
- Improving overall campaign performance

**Q: Will upgrading to MM Lite affect my existing campaigns?**  
No. Upgrading through LeadConnector does not disrupt your current WhatsApp setup. Existing templates remain unchanged, automations and workflows continue running, and campaigns are not impacted.

**Q: Do I need technical knowledge to enable MM Lite?**  
No. The upgrade process does not require coding, API changes, or technical expertise. It can be completed through the guided setup flow.

**Q: Can I still use WhatsApp for customer support after upgrading?**  
Yes. MM Lite is designed specifically for marketing messages. You can continue using standard WhatsApp messaging for:

- Customer conversations
- Support queries
- Transactional messages
- Service-related communication

**Q: Will MM Lite improve my message delivery rates?**  
MM Lite is designed to improve delivery performance for eligible WhatsApp marketing messages. Results may vary depending on your audience, message quality, engagement history, and use case.

**Q: What is Time-to-Live (TTL), and why is it important?**  
TTL defines how long a message remains eligible for delivery. If a message becomes irrelevant, such as an expired offer, it will not be delivered after the defined delivery window. This helps maintain a better user experience.

**Q: How does MM Lite help prevent spamming users?**  
MM Lite uses engagement signals and frequency controls to optimize message delivery. This helps reduce over-messaging, prevent user fatigue, and support more relevant communication.

**Q: Do I need access to Facebook Business Manager for the upgrade?**  
Yes. Access to your Facebook Business Manager is required to approve permissions and complete the MM Lite upgrade.

**Q: Can I track conversions and campaign performance with MM Lite?**  
Yes. MM Lite can work with tools such as Meta Pixel and Conversions API to help track conversions, measure ROI, and optimize future campaigns.

**Q: Is MM Lite suitable for all types of messages?**  
No. MM Lite is designed for marketing use cases, such as promotions, offers, and campaign broadcasts. For transactional, utility, authentication, or service-related messages, continue using standard WhatsApp messaging.

**Q: How long does it take to see results after enabling MM Lite?**  
You may start seeing results within a few campaigns. As the system gathers engagement data, performance and delivery may continue to improve over time.

**Q: Does MM Lite support all types of marketing messaging?**  
Yes. MM Lite supports multiple marketing message use cases, including:

- 1:1 marketing conversations, such as personalized outreach and offers
- Bulk campaigns, such as broadcast promotions and announcements
- Workflow automation, such as drip campaigns, follow-ups, and lead nurturing

This allows you to manage eligible WhatsApp marketing communication within HighLevel.

title_en: Manage Service Appointments in the Appointment Modal
source_md:
Manage Service bookings more efficiently with the Appointment modal. Review booking details, edit and duplicate appointments, generate reschedule links, create blocked slots, and view assigned resources. You can also review intake forms attached during Service booking creation.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What Is the Appointment Modal for Service Appointments?](#What-is-the-Appointment-Modal-for-Service-Appointments?)
- [Key Benefits of Managing Service Appointments](#Key-Benefits-of-Managing-Service-Appointments)
- [How to Access the Appointment Modal](#How-to-Access-the-Appointment-Modal-for-Service-Appointments)
- [View a Submitted Service Booking Form](#View-a-Submitted-Service-Booking-Form)
- [Generate and Copy a Reschedule Link](#Generate-and-Copy-a-Reschedule-Link)
- [Edit Service Appointments](#Edit-Service-Appointments)
- [Duplicate Service Appointments](#Duplicate-Service-Appointments)
- [Blocked Slots on Your Service Calendar](#Blocked-Slots-on-Your-Service-Calendar)
- [Show Resource in Appointment Modal](#Show-Resource-in-Appointment-Modal)
- [Use Custom Values in Service Notifications](#Use-Custom-Values-in-Service-Notifications??)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What Is the Appointment Modal for Service Appointments?**

The Appointment modal is the side panel where admins and staff review and take action on a single Service booking. It centralizes essential tasks such as editing details, rescheduling, duplicating appointments, and reviewing submitted booking forms so teams can maintain accurate calendars with less back-and-forth.

---

## **Key Benefits of Managing Service Appointments**

Managing appointment details from one place helps staff respond to scheduling changes and review customer information without navigating through multiple screens.

- **Speed:** Edit and reschedule Service appointments without leaving the page.
- **Control:** Block unavailable time from the booking workflow.
- **Scalability:** Duplicate bookings for repeat or similar clients.
- **Form visibility:** Review intake form submissions attached when Service bookings were created.

---

## **How to Access the Appointment Modal for Service Appointments**

Opening a Service appointment displays its Booking Details side panel, where you can review information and use the available appointment actions.

1. Go to **Calendars → Calendar View** (or **Appointment List View**) and select **Services**.

![Calendars menu showing how to open Calendar View for Service appointments](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084556058/original/zErCmaHPv9E13YsTKVPiqadVflmHq1jKCA.png?1793336761)

2. Click an appointment to open **Booking Details** in the side panel (the Appointment modal).

![Booking Details side panel for a selected Service appointment](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084555959/original/1epvOS5fDj6Apcxo5C3BKaHzm3IqvaZPfg.png?1793336589)

---

## **View a Submitted Service Booking Form**

When a form is attached while creating a Service booking, its submitted responses can be reviewed from Booking Details. This allows your team to access customer intake information alongside the saved appointment.

1. Go to **Calendars → Calendar View** and select **Services**.
2. Select the saved Service appointment to open **Booking Details**.
3. Click the form icon in the booking details panel to open **Form submission**.
4. Review the submitted answers.

![Service Booking Details displaying the attached form submission and customer responses](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084553858/original/jwzTo6uFUfoK6vCGKnz0RGyd4owWinuOnw.png?1793330343)

**Important:** A form must be attached during booking creation. You cannot attach a form to an existing booking or edit its submitted form afterward.

---

## **Generate and Copy a Reschedule Link**

Use the appointment's reschedule link when you want the customer to choose a new time themselves. You can generate the link directly from an existing Service appointment and share it through your preferred communication channel.

1. Open the **Service appointment**.
2. Click **Appointment Actions**.
3. Select **Generate Reschedule Link**.
4. After the link is generated, click **Copy Link**.
5. Share the link with the customer.

The customer can open the shared link and use the existing rescheduling flow to choose a new appointment time.

---

## **Edit Service Appointments**

Editing options depend on whether payment has been collected. Unpaid appointments allow more changes, while paid appointments restrict structural edits to protect the existing booking and payment details.

### **Edit Unpaid Appointments**

Users can modify unpaid Service appointments directly from the edit screen without canceling or rebooking. This makes it easier to handle last-minute requests, corrections, or changes.

Supported changes include:

- Add or remove **Services**.
- Add or remove **Add-Ons**.
- Change **Staff** or **Service Variants**.
- Change the **Location**, appointment title, date/time, timezone, or coupon codes.

To edit an unpaid Service appointment:

1. Select the appointment you want to edit, then click the **pencil** icon to open the editor.

![Edit button in the Service appointment modal](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084556126/original/ehVF_-mdtnkjbXODYYkJKwYRRXpPdQRSCw.png?1793336850)

2. Adjust the applicable services, add-ons, staff/variant, location, title, date/time, timezone, or coupon codes, then click **Save**.

![Edit unpaid Service appointment screen showing available appointment fields](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064119010/original/cCZClATqPysQRMMvk3_aaIk4G2Zyp2Rz3A.png?1770140560)

### **Enhanced Support for Paid Appointments**

Paid appointments remain locked for structural changes, such as changing the service or staff. You can duplicate an appointment to create a new booking, adjust its details, and rebook without starting from scratch.

The edit screen displays a message explaining which details can and cannot be changed.

---

## **Duplicate Service Appointments**

Duplicating a booking helps you quickly create a repeat or similar Service appointment by carrying over the existing details instead of entering them again.

The **Duplicate Appointment** button is available in the Appointment modal. Open the appointment you want to duplicate, then select the **Duplicate** icon. Review and adjust the copied details before completing the new booking.

![Duplicate Service appointment control in the Booking Details panel](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084556112/original/TXsLc-VzgsiiA8MegMSxunyd9O9uuWgccA.png?1793336819)

---

## **Blocked Slots on Your Service Calendar**

Blocked slots let you mark time as unavailable, keeping your calendar accurate and helping prevent accidental bookings.

To create a blocked slot:

1. Click **New Booking** in your calendar.

![New Booking action for creating a blocked slot](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084556055/original/-NchWUgfUri2SCT2HoB26Kg3KftdwR17Nw.png?1793336753)

2. Switch **Event Type** to **Blocked Slot**.

![Event Type selector with Blocked Slot selected](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064119381/original/n-Jf9wQYrMhdQ3LjBKzuXe086l_HvNeZ3A.png?1770140952)

3. Select the date/time, title, and staff, then click **Block Time**.

![Blocked Slot form showing time and staff options](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064119444/original/pDXeA17Ua3DUSRqDP4QlULzoxoP9hSjA1A.png?1770141018)

---

## **Show Resource in Appointment Modal**

The Appointment modal displays the resource assigned to a Service booking. Seeing the booked resource helps your team understand which person or resource has been reserved and avoid confusion about allocation.

![Resource information displayed in a Service appointment modal](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084556032/original/UP_E_3nf6D2nGX2iWGRgznoQIArc0CRvTw.png?1793336724)

---

## **Use Custom Values in Service Notifications**

Custom values let you include relevant booking details in customer confirmations, reminders, and other notifications without entering the information manually each time.

Two custom values are available for calendar notifications:

- **Service Booking Price**
- **Meeting Location Name** (short label instead of the full address)

To use these values:

1. Go to **Calendars → Calendar Settings → Notifications**.
2. Open the notification template (confirmation, reminder, etc.).
3. Insert **Service Booking Price** or **Meeting Location Name** from the merge field picker.
4. Save and test the notification.

![Service notification template showing available custom values](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064119604/original/B80PfHsuKgrj_7P9Hq56wv6Aop-IiAMHLQ.png?1770141210)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I change the staff or service after payment is collected?**

Structural edits (services, add-ons, staff/variant, coupon, title, location) are locked on paid bookings. Reschedule the date/time or use **Duplicate Appointment** to rebook with changes.

**Q: What carries over when I duplicate an appointment?**

Contact, services, add-ons, staff/resource, meeting location, and notes typically carry over. Adjust anything needed before booking the copy.

**Q: Does rescheduling a paid appointment change the existing order or payment?**

No. The payment remains associated with the original booking.

**Q: Can I attach a form to a Service appointment after it has been created?**

No. Forms can only be attached during booking creation. If a form was attached, you can review its submitted responses from **Booking Details**, but you cannot add or edit a form afterward.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [Attach Forms to In-App Service and Rental Bookings](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009518-attach-forms-to-in-app-service-and-rental-bookings)
- [How To Create Service Calendars](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001159)
- [Calendar View for Rentals](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006641)
- [Troubleshooting Tool for Calendar](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003358)
- [Payments Tab in Calendars](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006098)

title_en: HighLevel Mobile App Experience
source_md:
Mobile App

# HighLevel Mobile App Experience

A ground-up rebuild that transforms your phone into a business command center with lightning-fast navigation, role-aware dashboards, true-black Dark Mode, and an AI assistant.

What You'll Learn

The redesigned HighLevel Mobile App delivers a modern interface, streamlined App Drawer, role-based homepage, Universal Search, and the Ask AI assistant to help you communicate, sell, and analyze faster than ever.

This article covers the key benefits, navigation structure, homepage widgets, AI capabilities, and step-by-step setup instructions for enabling the experience in your agency and subaccounts.

Labs Feature

This feature is available through HighLevel Labs. Enable it in **Agency Settings → Labs → Subaccounts** and select which subaccounts should access the new mobile experience. Test in your agency subaccount before rolling out to clients.

## Key Benefits of the Mobile App

The redesigned mobile experience combines speed, intelligence, and role-aware design to streamline every aspect of business management on the go.

**Unified Command Center** — Critical tasks, messages, revenue, and appointments surface instantly on the homepage, giving you a complete snapshot of your day.

**Faster Workflows** — Universal Search, Quick Actions, and drag-to-reorder Pinned Apps reduce taps and accelerate common tasks.

**Ask AI on the Go** — Draft social posts, update CRM records, and generate images without leaving the chat interface.

**Battery-Saving Dark Mode** — True-black design optimized for OLED screens extends device battery life during extended use.

**SaaS Tier Enforcement** — Features shown match each account's subscription level, maintaining consistency between mobile and web platforms.

## The New Homepage – Mission Control

Role-aware widgets and charts provide every user with a personalized snapshot of critical business metrics and quick access to frequently used modules.

Component 1

Four Key Widgets

Tasks Due, Opportunity Pipeline Value, Unread Messages, and Today's Appointments provide at-a-glance insight into daily priorities.

Component 2

Pinned Apps

Choose up to four favorite modules and reorder them via drag-and-drop for instant access to your most-used tools.

Component 3

Quick Actions

Eight one-tap shortcuts enable rapid creation of contacts, opportunities, tasks, and messages directly from the homepage.

Component 4

Revenue Chart

A six-month line graph displays collected revenue trends, helping you monitor financial performance at a glance.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077955202/original/7372rkiNx6Jea-XwL1EY8J-VrHH-vnGlZw.png?1786242615)

## Universal Search

Search across Conversations, Contacts, and Opportunities from a single search bar. The system remembers your last five queries and opens results in context, enabling you to jump directly into action. Additional modules will be added in Q4 2025 as part of the ongoing roadmap.

Pro Tip

Universal Search is context-aware and lightning fast, making it ideal for quickly locating specific conversations or contact records while on calls or in meetings.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077955184/original/CihZFOZKfFpUBH-adLeZRf4csehzKwBmhg.png?1786242491)

## App Drawer

The App Drawer replaces the previous left-hand navigation with a four-column grid that organizes every module into logical categories. Global icons for Notifications and Settings are always visible in the top-right corner.

Category 1

Insights & Productivity

Dashboard, Reports, Tasks, and analytics tools grouped for data-driven decision making.

Category 2

Communication

Conversations, Email, SMS, and messaging channels for client and team communication.

Category 3

Sales & Operations

Contacts, Opportunities, Pipelines, Payments, and Invoices for revenue-driving activities.

Category 4

Marketing & Growth

Campaigns, Social Planner, Sites, Funnels, and automation tools for client acquisition and engagement.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077955189/original/rXc9no1k66i_xRRJ12v2IgNZdXg8nSXGFw.png?1786242527)

AI-Powered Mobile

Put a Business Assistant in Your Pocket

Ask AI brings draft generation, record creation, and image editing to every mobile user—no desktop required.

## Ask AI

Your AI coworker travels with you, enabling content creation, CRM updates, and image generation directly from the mobile app. Chat History stores every session for easy reference.

**Draft Content** — Generate social posts, emails, and ad copy in seconds without switching apps.

**Create or Edit Records** — Update contacts, opportunities, and other CRM records through conversational commands.

**Generate and Edit Images** — Create branded visuals and modify existing images directly on mobile.

**Chat History** — Access all past AI conversations for reference or continuation of previous sessions.

Note

Ask AI follows your existing AI usage limits and subscription tier. No separate mobile fee applies.

### Start a New Ask AI Chat Using Mobile Shortcuts

You can start a new Ask AI conversation directly from your mobile app icon, the Quick Actions card, or Universal Search. Each shortcut opens a blank chat instead of returning to your previous conversation.

#### How to Start a New Ask AI Chat

Option 1

From the App Icon

1. Long-press the app icon on your phone's home screen.
2. Tap **New Ask AI Chat**.
3. Enter your question in the new conversation.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084799075/original/ldTk4DhdACy6cUpndjE4mLWe4D99jLP3qQ.png?1793689908)

Option 2

From Quick Actions

1. Open the mobile app.
2. Locate the **Quick Actions** card.
3. Tap **New Ask AI Chat**.
4. Enter your question in the new conversation.  
     
    ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084799442/original/vr3s-Hwd402JF-pq2Sl5FPaNoVsxzcufbQ.png?1793690148)

Option 3

From Universal Search

1. Open **Universal Search** in the mobile app.
2. Search for **New Ask AI Chat**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084799655/original/GFXkvDfDWnDStbI9kOPwsX1_rLW8G5Eezg.png?1793690301)
3. Select the shortcut to open a blank conversation.
4. Enter your question.

#### How the Shortcut Works

**Start a Blank Chat** — Each time you select **New Ask AI Chat**, Ask AI opens a new, empty conversation.

**Keep Conversations Separate** — The shortcut does not reopen your previous conversation.

**Switch Without Stacking Screens** — If Ask AI is already open, the shortcut switches to a new chat without stacking another screen.

**Access Based on Eligibility** — The shortcut appears only for users and accounts with access to Ask AI.

Availability

This feature is available in mobile app version **4.27.0 and later** for the **HighLevel**, **LeadConnector**, and **white-label mobile apps**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077955192/original/LHfi1pHg6vaPCFJSSjq0FyFSwWPXsY0PUA.png?1786242558)

## SaaS Configurator Enforcement

The mobile app enforces SaaS Configurator tiers, hiding modules and features that a user's subscription level does not allow. This maintains perfect consistency between mobile and web platforms, ensuring clients see only the tools included in their plan.

Note

If certain modules are missing from the App Drawer, verify the account's subscription tier and user role permissions in the web dashboard.

## Core Enhancements

Performance, design, and security improvements throughout the app create a smoother, more efficient mobile experience.

**Faster Load Times** — Improved app performance delivers ultra-smooth transitions between screens and modules.

**True-Black Dark Mode** — OLED-optimized design extends battery life during extended use and reduces eye strain in low-light environments.

**Streamlined Top-Bar Navigation** — The previous left-hand menu is replaced by a modern top bar that keeps global controls accessible without consuming screen space.

**Role-Based Access** — Data visibility and module access respect user roles, keeping sensitive information secure and interfaces clutter-free.

## How to Set Up the Mobile App Experience

Enable the redesigned mobile experience in three quick steps.

Step 1

Update the Mobile App

Download the latest version of the HighLevel Mobile App from the Apple App Store or Google Play Store.

Step 2

Enable the Experience in Labs

Navigate to **Agency Settings → Labs → Subaccounts**.

Toggle on **"A New Mobile App Experience"**.

Select the subaccounts where you want to enable the redesigned interface.

Step 3

Explore the App

Open the mobile app on your device and explore the new homepage, Universal Search, App Drawer, and Ask AI features.

Pro Tip

Test the experience first in your agency subaccount before rolling it out to client subaccounts to familiarize yourself with the interface and capabilities.

White-Label Apps

Agencies using white-label mobile app builds should request a new binary after enabling the Labs toggle to ensure the redesigned experience appears in their branded apps.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Will my clients automatically see the new design?

No. You control rollout by enabling the toggle per subaccount in Labs. The experience remains opt-in until you activate it for specific subaccounts.

Q: Which operating systems are supported?

Both iOS and Android are supported. Update to the latest store version from the Apple App Store or Google Play to access the redesigned experience.

Q: Can I customize homepage widgets?

Widget customization is not available yet. This capability is planned for Q4 2025 as part of the product roadmap.

Q: Does Ask AI cost extra?

Ask AI follows your existing AI usage limits and subscription tier. No separate mobile fee applies.

Q: Why don't I see certain modules in the App Drawer?

SaaS Configurator and user role permissions determine module visibility. Check the account's subscription tier and user permissions in the web dashboard to verify access.

Q: Is Dark Mode automatic?

The app follows your device's system theme by default. You can also toggle Dark Mode manually in the app's Settings.

Q: Will Universal Search include Payments and Calendars?

Those modules will be added to Universal Search later in 2025 as part of the ongoing "Coming Soon" roadmap.

Q: Do I need to reinstall my white-label mobile app?

Agencies using white-label builds should request a new binary after enabling the Labs toggle to ensure the redesigned experience appears in their branded apps.

title_en: Online Booking Page in Field Services
source_md:
Your online booking page is how customers find your services, check that you cover their address, pick a time and book or send a request, any time of day, without calling your office. This article walks through what customers see at each step, what you need to set up first, and how to share the page.

```
Note: Field Services is currently in private beta and is available to selected accounts. Features and screens may change as we improve them.
```

## In this article

- [What is the online booking page?](#what)
- [Before you share your booking page](#before)
- [What customers see, step by step](#flow)
- [Instant booking or booking request](#request)
- [Payment on the booking page](#payment)
- [Share your booking page](#share)
- [Tips for a page that converts](#tips)
- [Frequently asked questions](#faq)
- [Related articles](#related)

---

## What is the online booking page?

The online booking page is a branded, customer-facing page for your business. Customers can:

- Browse your services and add-ons.
- Check that you serve their address.
- Pick a time that works for them.
- Enter their details and pay, or send a request for your team to review.

It works on desktop, tablet and mobile, and every service also has its own direct booking link. You control how it looks in the [Booking Page Editor in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009387), and how it behaves in [Field Services Settings: Online Booking](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009385).

![Online booking page showing services grouped by category](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084192645/original/SSIploy9Uk36Ko2ahaCNAxlgCzhuOeH3IQ.jpg)

---

## Before you share your booking page

The page is built from the rest of your Field Services setup. Check these first so customers see a page that works:

| Set up | Why it matters | Learn more |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Services** | Only services appear on the page, and a service with no staff assigned cannot be booked online. | [Services and Add-ons in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009373) |
| **Staff** | Open times come from staff working hours, assigned services and service areas. | [Staff in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009372) |
| **Service areas** | Customers are checked against your coverage before they pick a time. | [Service Areas in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009371) |
| **Booking rules and payments** | Decide how customers pick a time, whether they book instantly or send a request, and how they pay. | [Field Services Settings: Online Booking](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009385) |
| **Look and wording** | Add your logo, colors and the text customers see at every step. | [Booking Page Editor in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009387) |

---

## What customers see, step by step

### 1. Browse your services

Customers land on your catalog. Services are grouped by category, with a search box and filters to help them find what they need. The top bar shows their service address and their cart.

### 2. Check the address

Before booking, customers enter the address where the service is needed, or use their current location. The page checks it against your service areas and tells them straight away whether you cover it.

![Address check confirming the address is covered](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084192662/original/vaLvupffAvWFQj9HB0nRLN5cWT0Ieml5cw.jpg)

If the address is outside your service areas, what happens next depends on your **Bookings outside service areas** policy:

- **Block booking:** Customers cannot book that address.
- **Allow booking with review:** Customers can still book, and your team reviews the booking. They see the message you wrote for them.

![Address check for an address outside the service areas](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084192683/original/y8cgnuLXNN4dnj5Y9xrcYnPef8vUoGl3Mw.jpg)

See [Service Areas in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009371) to set this policy.

### 3. Choose a service

The service page shows the details, price and any options or add-ons. Customers add what they want to their booking.

![Service details page](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084192699/original/Q18ERytytcH8Qrwut5-EMnlRc4RkRCzUmQ.jpg)

### 4. Review the cart

Customers can book more than one service in the same visit. The cart shows each service with an order summary of the subtotal, taxes and fees, and the total. They can edit or remove a service, or add another, before choosing a time.

![Cart with order summary](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084192707/original/4Q1R2Cc-EM35YsiKn622XAf0hhGVogbpxA.jpg)

### 5. Pick a time

Customers choose a date and then a time. Open times are grouped by morning, afternoon and evening, and the time zone is shown. Depending on your booking rules, customers pick an exact time, a time window, or just a date. See [Field Services Settings: Online Booking](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009385).

![Pick a time with a calendar and open times](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084192716/original/a6cUxdoNxHP5l8qXzr7a6Ze1DGUahntVdA.jpg)

### 6. Enter details and confirm

Customers enter their contact details and the service address, add any notes for your team, and complete the payment step you set up. Then they confirm the booking.

![Details and payment step](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084192733/original/3IWvAjBZJsBwFMRem34MDw94gyzMkvpxVA.jpg)

### 7. Confirmation

After booking, customers see a confirmation page with the message you wrote. You can also send confirmation and reminder messages. See [Notifications in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009384).

---

## Instant booking or booking request

You choose what happens when a customer submits the page, in **Field Services Settings > Online booking > Booking rules**.

| Mode | What the customer does | What your team does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Instant booking** | Picks an open time and the visit is booked straight away. | Sees the visit on the schedule. See [Schedule in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009379). |
| **Booking request** | Sends a request without picking a confirmed time. | Reviews the request, then schedules the visit. See [Requests in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009375). |

With instant booking, you can also let customers send a request when no times are open, so they are not turned away.

---

## Payment on the booking page

Payment options are set in **Field Services Settings > Online booking > Payments**: pay online, pay in-person, or card on file only. If you have not connected a payment provider yet, choose **Pay in-person** so customers can still complete a booking. See [Field Services Settings: Online Booking](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009385).

---

## Share your booking page

- **Whole page:** Use the **Booking page link** in the booking page editor, or click **View booking page** to open it. Click the arrow next to it to share the link.
- **One service:** Open **Services & staff > Services**, then use **Share booking link** on a service to send customers straight to it.

```
Note: If you change your booking page link, links you have already shared will stop working.
```

Add the link to your website, Google Business Profile, email signature and social profiles. See [AI Receptionist and Google Organic Booking in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009388) for Google organic booking.

---

## Tips for a page that converts

- **Test it yourself.** Open the page, book a service for a real address in your area, then try an address outside it.
- **Keep descriptions short.** Customers decide faster with a clear name, price and duration.
- **Use add-ons.** Offer useful extras on the service page so customers can add them in one click.
- **Preview on mobile.** Most customers book from a phone, so check the mobile preview in the editor.

---

## Frequently asked questions

**Why do customers see no available times?**  
Check that at least one staff member is assigned to the service, serves the customer's service area and has working hours in the days shown. Also review your minimum notice and booking window in Booking rules.

**Why can't a customer book their address?**  
The address is outside all your service areas and your policy is set to **Block booking**, or the area has no staff assigned. See [Service Areas in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009371).

**Why is a service missing from the page?**  
A service must have at least one staff member assigned to be bookable online. See [Services and Add-ons in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009373).

**Can customers book more than one service at once?**  
Yes. They can add several services to the cart and book them together.

**Do customers get a confirmation?**  
They see a confirmation page after booking, and you can turn on email, SMS or WhatsApp notifications. See [Notifications in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009384).

**Can I use my own branding?**  
Yes. Add your logo, colors, fonts and wording in the booking page editor. See [Booking Page Editor in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009387).

---

## Related articles

- [Field Services Settings: Online Booking](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009385)
- [Booking Page Editor in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009387)
- [Services and Add-ons in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009373)
- [Service Areas in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009371)
- [Requests in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009375)
- [Notifications in Field Services](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009384)

title_en: App Marketplace - Earnings Dashboard
source_md:
Marketplace Earnings Dashboard gives agencies a clear view of app installs, revenue, costs, and profit across the App Marketplace. This article explains what the dashboard shows, how to use its filters and analysis views, and how to review app and sub-account performance more effectively.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Marketplace Earnings Dashboard?](#What-is-Marketplace-Earnings-Dashboard?)
- [Key Benefits of Marketplace Earnings Dashboard](#Key-Benefits-of-Marketplace-Earnings-Dashboard)
- [How To Navigate the Marketplace Earnings Dashboard](#How-To-Navigate-the-Marketplace-Earnings-Dashboard)
- [Filters and Time Period](#Filters-and-Time-Period)
- [Revenue, Cost, and Profit Chart](#Revenue,-Cost,-and-Profit-Chart)
- [App Analysis](#App-Analysis)
- [Sub-Account Analysis](#Sub-Account-Analysis)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Marketplace Earnings Dashboard?**

The Marketplace Earnings Dashboard gives agencies a centralized view of Marketplace app performance inside HighLevel. It brings together financial reporting and adoption data so you can measure how apps are being used across sub-accounts, how much revenue they generate, what they cost, and how much profit they produce over time.

You can use this dashboard to monitor overall app performance, compare results across apps or sub-accounts, and review trends using date filters and analysis views. This helps agencies move from manual tracking to a more data-driven way of managing app value.

---

## **Key Benefits of Marketplace Earnings Dashboard**

- **Centralized visibility**: View app installs, revenue, cost, and profit from one dashboard in your agency account.
- **Better decision-making**: Use trend data and app performance insights to evaluate which apps deliver the most value.
- **Sub-account insights**: Understand which sub-accounts contribute the most revenue and where app adoption is strongest.
- **Simplified reporting**: Reduce manual tracking by using built-in filters, charts, tables, and export options.
- **ROI awareness**: Compare revenue and cost to identify profitable apps and underperforming installs.

---

## **How To Navigate the Marketplace Earnings Dashboard**

1. Log in to your HighLevel **Agency** account.
2. Go to **App Marketplace**.
3. Click the **Earnings** tab.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/7vpXlXZIDCciQ6SzFRzl+/Screen+Shot+2026-03-25+at+17.42.30.png)
4. Check out the **summary cards** data:

   - **Unique App Installed:** Total number of different apps that have been installed across your sub-accounts. The number represents unique apps which are installed as of now and doesn't depend on the time period selected.
   - **Active Installations:**Total count of current active app installations across all sub-accounts.The number represents total apps which are installed as of now and doesn't depend on the time period selected.
   - **Sub-accounts Active:**Number of sub-accounts that currently have at least one active app installation.
   - **Total Revenue - Cost = Profit:**Revenue is the total earnings generated from app installs. Cost represents app-related expenses. Profit is the net earnings after deducting costs. The data is calculated basis time period selected.

     **![](https://jumpshare.com/share/oImBTdGOoYOYbJfz3wys+/Screen+Shot+2026-03-25+at+17.49.49.png)**
5. Select your preferred **Time Period**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/4lt6CSz8mlzaihTFcNKJ+/Screen+Shot+2026-03-25+at+17.45.22.png)
6. Use the available filters such as **Mode**, **App**, and **Sub-Account** to refine the data.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/lGkVcfMeuyxqMncsCBAx+/Screen+Shot+2026-03-25+at+17.47.04.png)
7. Toggle between **App Analysis** and **Sub-Account Analysis** depending on the report you want to review.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/OpUSmes4fW8LJmvbonFM+/Screen+Shot+2026-03-25+at+17.48.28.png)
8. Review the **1.** summary cards, **2.** trend chart, and **3.** table data.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/urI5oOUgBcWLrXb5UBMf+/Screen+Shot+2026-03-25+at+17.55.25.png)
9. Click **Export** if you need to download the filtered report.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/SftYOsLA6ayWDrpudi7w+/Screen+Shot+2026-03-25+at+17.57.57.png)

---

## **Filters and Time Period**

Filters help you narrow the dashboard data so you can focus on the apps, sub-accounts, and timeframes that matter most. This makes the dashboard more useful for targeted reporting, trend analysis, and performance reviews.

```
Note: Chart visualizations and table results update based on the selected filters and time period.
```

The dashboard supports filtering by:

- **Time Period**: Use the date selector and presets like last week, month(s), Q1-4 to review a specific reporting range.  
    
  ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/W5MSpdeRPp9SvvC7UPOs+/GIF+Recording+2026-03-25+at+18.20.05.gif)
- **Mode**: Filter results based on the selected app mode (Free, Usage-based, One-time & Subscription).  
    
  ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/mMEaDF4dSpUFitp7donF+/Screenshot+2026-03-25+at+18.21.40.png)
- **App**: Narrow the dashboard to one or more specific apps.  
    
  ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/9PC0Okb7XZlrVXkBMKhf+/Screenshot+2026-03-25+at+18.23.55.png)
- **Sub-Account**: Review data for one or more selected sub-accounts.  
    
  ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/l2i82vPmTcETOsIqTr2A+/Screenshot+2026-03-25+at+18.25.30.png)
- **Search**: Use the search field to locate a specific app or sub-accounts quickly in App/Sub-account Analysis.  
    
  ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/FFf23YMzdal9sRKx3NmL+/Screen+Shot+2026-03-25+at+18.27.52.png)
- **Reset**: Clear applied filters and return to the broader view.  
    
  ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/KqlGsshnpCVu0iSw8IP4+/Screen+Shot+2026-03-25+at+18.29.06.png)

---

## **Revenue, Cost, and Profit Chart**

Trend reporting helps you understand how Marketplace performance changes over time. By reviewing revenue, cost, and profit together, you can spot spikes in activity, monitor margins, and evaluate how a selected date range impacts performance.

The Revenue, Cost and Profit chart displays performance over time based on your selected date range. The chart updates automatically when you change the time period and helps you compare all three financial metrics in a single view.

You can use this chart to:

- monitor earnings trends over time
- identify periods of higher app activity
- compare revenue against cost to understand margin performance
- review changes based on the selected reporting range

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/81tWiDXwY3a0yfS3febX+/GIF+Recording+2026-03-25+at+18.00.08.gif)

---

## **App Analysis**

App Analysis helps you evaluate performance by individual app so you can identify which Marketplace apps are installed most often, which ones generate revenue, and which ones contribute to profit. This view is useful when reviewing app adoption and comparing financial results across your installed apps.

The **App Analysis** tab displays app-level performance details, including:

- App Name
- Total Install
- Active Sub-Accounts
- Churn Rate
- Total Revenue
- Total Cost
- Profit

Use this view to compare apps side by side and understand which apps are driving the strongest business results.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/P5cUKVWScCSzlV63ejM2+/GIF+Recording+2026-03-25+at+18.03.50.gif)

---

## **Sub-Account Analysis**

Sub-account-level reporting helps agencies understand which clients are generating the most value from Marketplace apps. This makes it easier to identify adoption patterns, support upsell opportunities, and evaluate app performance across your client base.

The **Sub-Account Analysis** tab allows you to review performance by sub-account. Use this view to analyze revenue contribution, cost, and profit at the client level for the selected date range and filters.

This is especially helpful for:

- identifying high-value sub-accounts
- reviewing Marketplace adoption by client
- comparing app-related contribution across sub-accounts
- supporting internal reporting and account reviews

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/aFPFA2tsaC3i7NvtKIYQ+/GIF+Recording+2026-03-25+at+18.11.15.gif)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: What is the difference between revenue, cost, and profit in the Earnings dashboard?**

Revenue is the total amount generated from Marketplace apps, cost is the total amount paid for those apps, and profit is the difference between revenue and cost for the selected period.

**Q: Why do some apps show installs but no revenue?**  
An app can be installed and active without generating revenue in the selected date range. This may happen if the app is free, if no billable activity occurred, or if the selected timeframe does not include related charges.

**Q: Why is profit zero for some apps?**  
Profit may be zero when revenue and cost are equal. Based on the current feature behavior, this can happen for agency apps where no margin is created.

**Q: Why does revenue sometimes differ from cost?**  
Revenue can be greater than cost when a sub-account app is resold with markup enabled. This creates a margin that appears as profit in the dashboard.

**Q: Do filters affect the chart and table data?**  
Yes. The dashboard updates charts and table results based on the filters and date range you apply.

**Q: Does exported data include my selected filters?**  
Yes. Exported data respects the filters currently applied in the dashboard.

**Q: What is the App Analysis view used for?**  
App Analysis helps you review performance by individual app, including installs, active sub-accounts, revenue, cost, and profit.

**Q: What is the Sub-Account Analysis view used for?**  
Sub-Account Analysis helps you review Marketplace app contribution by client so you can understand which sub-accounts are generating the most value.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [How to resell Marketplace Apps](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001220)
