title_en: Workflow Action - If/Else
source_md:
The **If/Else** workflow action allows you to route contacts through different paths based on defined conditions. With the latest enhancement, you can now use **Dynamic Custom Values** in If/Else conditions to compare live values from earlier workflow steps or stored fields—eliminating the need to hard-type values and reducing duplicate logic.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What Is the If/Else Workflow Action?](#What-Is-the-If/Else-Workflow-Action?)
- [Key Benefits of the If/Else Action](#Key-Benefits-of-the-If/Else-Action%E2%80%8B)
- [How to Use the If/Else Action](#How-to-Use-the-If/Else-Action)
- [Step 1: Add the If/Else Action](#Step-1%3A%C2%A0Add-the-If/Else-Action%E2%80%8B)
- [Step 2: Choose a Logic Setup Method](#Step-2%3A%C2%A0Choose-a-Logic-Setup-Method%E2%80%8B)
- [Step 3: Configure the First Branch](#Step-3%3A%C2%A0Configure-the-First-Branch%E2%80%8B)
- [Step 4: Add Additional Branches (Optional)](#Step-4%3A%C2%A0Add-Additional-Branches-(Optional))
- [Step 5: Configure the “None” (Else) Branch](#Step-5%3A%C2%A0Configure-the-%E2%80%9CNone%E2%80%9D-(Else)-Branch%E2%80%8B)
- [Using Dynamic Values in If/Else Conditions](#Using-Dynamic-Values-in-If/Else-Conditions%C2%A0%E2%80%8B)
- [Supported Field Types](#Supported-Field-Types)
- [How to Use Dynamic Values](#How-to-Use-Dynamic-Values%E2%80%8B)
- [Important Note for Select / Dropdown Fields](#Important-Note-for-Select-/-Dropdown-Fields)
- [Example Use Case](#Example-Use-Case)
- [Action Details](#Action-Details)
- [Example: Follow-Up Based on Email Engagement](#Example%3A-Follow-Up-Based-on-Email-Engagement)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What Is the If/Else Workflow Action?**

The If/Else action evaluates contact-specific data and splits a workflow into multiple branches based on whether conditions are met. Each branch represents a logical path that a contact follows depending on the outcome of the condition check.

This makes it possible to create personalized, data-driven workflows that adapt dynamically to a contact’s behavior, attributes, or calculated values.

---

## **Key Benefits of the If/Else Action**

- **Conditional Logic:** Route contacts down different paths based on real-time data
- **Automation Efficiency:** Reduce manual sorting and duplicate workflow steps
- **Scalable Segmentation:** Handle complex branching logic as workflows grow
- **Visual Clarity:** Clearly see and manage decision points in the workflow builder

---

## **How to Use the If/Else Action**

### **Step 1:**Add the If/Else Action

1. Open your workflow.
2. Click the **+** icon to add a new action.
3. Select **If / Else** from the action list.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064138111/original/QHWzWp0cVu8mQcNsqQ1TRvlxEjAvSdSZVA.png?1770186397)

### **Step 2:**Choose a Logic Setup Method

You can either:

- Build logic manually using **Build My Own**, or
- Start from a prebuilt recipe with common conditions.

### **Step 3:**Configure the First Branch

1. Select the field you want to evaluate.
2. Choose the appropriate operator.
3. Set the comparison value.
4. Click **Add Segment** to add additional conditions.
5. Use **AND / OR** to control how conditions are grouped.

#### **Find Fields in If/Else Conditions**

Use the field picker to search for the field you want to use in an If/Else condition. Search results can include matching fields stored inside available folders and subfolders, so you do not need to open each folder before searching.

You can also browse the available field groups and use the breadcrumb path to move between folders and subfolders.

If a long field name is truncated, hover over it to view the full name in a tooltip.

```
Note: Search only displays fields and folders that are available and enabled for the current context.
```

  

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064138158/original/uBsuEu4NYpnkmlNxnWjDMlDv-IJU3EEDwg.png?1770186485)**

### **Step 4:**Add Additional Branches (Optional)

- Click **Add Branch** to define more condition groups.
- Each branch represents a separate path in the workflow.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064138205/original/VkxzPJfxHTDdkMNNRo9GLZ8bEIE7fBW4-g.png?1770186527)**

### **Step 5:**Configure the “None” (Else) Branch

- The **None** branch is created automatically.
- It runs when no defined conditions are met.
- This branch does not support conditions and cannot be removed.
- You can rename it and add fallback actions.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064138232/original/npnbPACEOdDdptOOZHUT5SqhUnQ1wOtwXw.png?1770186570)**

---

## **Using Dynamic Values in If/Else Conditions**

## 

You can now use **Dynamic Values** on the right-hand side of If/Else conditions. This allows you to compare live values—such as outputs from earlier workflow steps or stored fields—without hard-coding numbers or text.

This enhancement lets you branch directly on values that were calculated or captured upstream.

You can select **Company fields** in If/Else conditions when building a contact-based workflow. 

Company fields appear alongside contact fields in the field/variable picker.

Important: Company fields resolve only when the contact is associated with a company. If the contact has no associated company, the value is blank.

**Example Use Cases**

Route contacts based on Company Address (for example, by state or region).

Branch based on Company Name to apply different logic for specific accounts.

---

## **Supported Field Types**

Dynamic Values are supported for the following condition types in If/Else actions:

- **Numeric** – scores, counts, totals
- **Date** – appointment dates, renewal dates
- **Select / Dropdown** *(advanced – requires option IDs)*
- **Monetary** – invoice totals or amounts

---

## **How to Use Dynamic Values**

1. Add an **If/Else** action to your workflow.
2. Configure the left-hand field as usual.
3. In the right-hand input, switch the value type to **Dynamic Value**.
4. Select a value from:

   - An earlier workflow step output, or
   - A stored field.
5. Choose the appropriate operator (number, date, or value).
6. Save and publish the workflow.

### **Important Note for Select / Dropdown Fields**

> **Select / Dropdown fields require option IDs**, not display names, when used with Dynamic Values in If/Else conditions.

> In many cases, these IDs can be found in settings (for example, Pipeline IDs or Stage IDs).

### **New workflow fields available in If/Else**

If/Else conditions support more workflow fields, which gives you more precise branching without adding extra lookup steps. These fields appear in the field picker like other supported values, but some only appear when the workflow has the right context.

**Newly available fields include:**

- Contact Engagement Score
- Contact → Attribution Medium ID
- Note created by (Name)
- Task ID

Use these fields in If/Else when you want to branch based on attribution, engagement, note ownership, or task-specific workflow data.

**Field availability notes:**

1. **Contact Engagement Score** appears when Engagement Scoring is set up in the sub-account.
2. **Contact → Attribution Medium ID** can be used to branch based on first or latest attribution details.
3. **Note created by (Name)** appears in note-related workflow contexts.
4. **Task ID** appears in task-related workflows, such as task triggers or after an **Add Task** step.

**Examples:**

1. If **Contact Engagement Score** is greater than or equal to **20**, send the contact down a high-priority follow-up path.
2. If **Attribution Medium ID** matches your paid social source, route the contact to the correct reporting branch.
3. If **Note created by (Name)** includes **Success**, notify the Success team.
4. If **Task ID** is present, send it to an external tracking system for reference.

```
Note: If a value is unavailable for the current contact or workflow context, the field may be empty and the workflow will still continue to run.
```

---

## **Example Use Case**

When a proposal value is captured earlier in the workflow, you can compare that value dynamically.

If the amount is **$25,000 or more**, route the contact to a priority path; otherwise, continue with the standard process.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064138289/original/62n-GtQVJ-ot77skqfvb9KV8KVkYWqodmQ.png?1770186683)**

---

## **Action Details**

| **Field** | **Description** | **Required** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Action Name | Label used to identify the action in the workflow | Yes |
| Condition | The rule evaluated to determine the branch | Yes |
| Branches | Workflow paths created by the If/Else action | Yes |
| Segments | Groups of conditions combined using AND / OR logic | No |

---

## **Example: Follow-Up Based on Email Engagement**

**Scenario:**

You want to follow up differently based on whether a contact opened an email.

**Workflow Logic:**

- Trigger: Promotional email sent
- If/Else Condition: Email Event → Is Opened
- Yes Branch: Send thank-you email with an offer
- No Branch: Resend the email with a different subject line

This ensures follow-ups are relevant to each contact’s engagement.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: How can I control when the If/Else condition is evaluated?**

Insert a **Wait** action before the If/Else step. You can wait for an event or a timeout (for example, “Wait until email is opened OR 1 day passes”) before evaluating the condition.

**Q: Can I edit a branch after it’s created?**

Yes. You can update fields, operators, and values before or after publishing the workflow.

**Q: Is the None branch required?**

Yes. It is created automatically and cannot be removed.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Workflow Action – Update Contact Field](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000002688)
- [If/Else Workflow Action – Appointment Filter Options](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004050)

##

title_en: MCP Integration for Speech-to-Speech Voice AI Agents
source_md:
Model Context Protocol (MCP) allows HighLevel Voice AI agents to use tools from connected applications during live calls. Speech-to-speech (S2S) agents can access supported services such as Google Calendar, Notion, and other MCP applications to retrieve information or perform actions. You can reuse existing connections, choose an app from the MCP catalog, or connect a custom server. This article explains how to set up, test, and manage MCP Servers in Voice AI.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What are MCP Servers for Voice AI Agents?](#What-are-MCP-Servers-for-Voice-AI-Agents?)
- [Understanding MCP Connections in Voice AI](#Understanding-MCP-Connections-in-Voice-AI)
- [Connecting Catalog and Custom MCP Servers](#Connecting-Catalog-and-Custom-MCP-Servers)
- [Selecting MCP Tools and When to Use Instructions](#Selecting-MCP-Tools-and-When-to-Use-Instructions)
- [Using MCP Tools During Calls](#Using-MCP-Tools-During-Calls)
- [Managing MCP Connection Status](#Managing-MCP-Connection-Status)
- [How to Set Up MCP Servers for Voice AI](#How-to-Set-Up-MCP-Servers-for-Voice-AI)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What are MCP Servers for Voice AI Agents?**

MCP Servers connect speech-to-speech Voice AI agents to external applications. This allows an agent to access information or perform supported actions while speaking with a caller.

For example, a clinic's Voice AI assistant can check Google Calendar for available appointments and share the results during the call.

The agent can only use the tools you select and the permissions granted to the connected application.

---

## **Understanding MCP Connections in Voice AI**

The **MCP Servers** panel appears alongside **Actions** and **Knowledge Base** in the S2S Voice AI builder.

You can connect MCP applications in three ways:

- **Existing connection:** Reuse an eligible MCP app already connected to HighLevel.
- **Catalog app:** Select an available application and authorize your account.
- **Custom MCP:** Enter a compatible MCP server's name and URL.

Each connected server displays its connection status, tool count, and a **When to use** field.

*![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083764180/original/zRBY4u9qm7aUCcXG2eGA-UdhRsMD-0nB3A.png?1792501391)*

---

## **Connecting Catalog and Custom MCP Servers**

Catalog apps provide a guided connection process, while custom MCP servers let you connect compatible services outside the catalog.

**Catalog Apps**

Choose an application from the MCP catalog, sign in if required, and select the tools the agent can access.

**Custom MCP Servers**

Select **Add custom MCP** and provide:

- **Name:** A recognizable name for the server.
- **MCP server URL:** The server's connection address.
- **Advanced:** Additional authentication settings, including OAuth Client ID and Client Secret when required.

HighLevel discovers the available tools after connecting to the server.

*![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083766615/original/HbG2IuMJKUG1OIpl-1Ok_-SGI2L1_r1B6w.png?1792502521)*

**Security:** Connect only trusted MCP servers. Select the minimum tools needed and avoid granting unnecessary access to external accounts or data. Keep OAuth credentials private.

---

## **Selecting MCP Tools and When to Use Instructions**

Tool selection controls which actions your Voice AI agent can perform. **When to use** instructions help the agent choose the appropriate server during a conversation.

After connecting an MCP server:

1. Review its available tools.
2. Select only the tools the agent needs.
3. Save the selection.
4. Enter a clear instruction in **When to use**.

For example:

"Use Google Calendar MCP when callers want to check appointment availability or manage appointments."

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083765978/original/qTGFYcvLHAiNxNYm2F6fgsvIZG9ASQ2TOA.png?1792502241)

---

## **Using MCP Tools During Calls**

During a call, a speech-to-speech agent can use an MCP tool when the caller's request matches its instructions.

For example:

1. A caller asks about appointment availability.
2. The agent calls a connected calendar tool.
3. The tool returns the available times.
4. The agent shares the results with the caller.

If the selected tools and account permissions allow it, the agent can also perform supported actions, such as creating an appointment.

During test calls, MCP tool calls appear in the transcript with their status and timing.

---

## **Managing MCP Connection Status**

Connection statuses help you identify whether an MCP integration is available or needs attention.

| Status | Meaning | Action |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Connected | The connection is available | No action needed |
| Reconnect | The connection expired or was revoked | Reconnect the account |
| App removed | The application was uninstalled elsewhere | Restore the connection |

If a tool isn't working, check the connection status, selected tools, and **When to use** instruction. Then review a test-call transcript to determine whether the agent attempted the tool call.

---

## **How to Set Up MCP Servers for Voice AI**

MCP Servers are configured directly in the S2S Voice AI builder. Choosing the correct tools and providing clear instructions helps the agent use connected applications appropriately during calls.

### 

### **Step 1: Open an S2S Voice AI Agent**

1. Go to **AI Agents → Voice AI**.
2. Open or create a speech-to-speech agent.
3. Open the agent's **Build** view.

### 

### **Step 2: Open MCP Servers**

1. Expand **MCP Servers** in the right panel.
2. Click **+ Add MCP**.

***![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083766207/original/tkNPQoXAiDT6DzJtZQW94yhcKOkjurrujA.png?1792502342)***

### 

### **Step 3: Connect an MCP App**

Choose one of the following:

**Catalog App**

1. Search for or select the desired app.
2. Sign in or authorize the account if required.

**Custom MCP**

1. Click **Add custom MCP**.
2. Enter the server's **Name** and **MCP server URL**.
3. Open **Advanced** if additional authentication details are required.
4. Complete the connection.

Existing eligible connections can be reused without repeating authorization.

### 

### 

### **Step 4: Choose the Tools**

1. Review the tools provided by the connected server.
2. Select the tools the Voice AI agent needs.
3. Save your selections.

For example, enable calendar availability and appointment-management tools for an agent handling bookings.

### 

### **Step 5: Configure When to Use**

1. Return to the connected server's card.
2. Find **When to use**.
3. Enter a short instruction describing when the agent should call that server.

**Example:** "Use this server when callers ask about appointment availability or scheduling."

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083766367/original/DjKLzjAj-i4r-YNeNUTXAWSJUUqsnh1imw.png?1792502418)**

### 

### **Step 6: Save and Publish**

1. Review the server connections, selected tools, and instructions.
2. Save any pending changes.
3. Publish or deploy the agent using the available controls.

### 

### **Step 7: Test the Integration**

1. Start a test call with the Voice AI agent.
2. Ask a question that should use an MCP tool, such as "What appointments are available tomorrow?"
3. Review the agent's response.
4. Check the transcript for the MCP tool call, its status, and timing.
5. Adjust the tools or instructions if necessary.

*![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155083766864/original/Vie_SraVe-lYy5GNZkFv6LCSclOIuQuM-g.png?1792502623)*

```
Important: MCP tools can perform real actions during testing. Use test accounts or safe test data when checking tools that create, change, or delete information.
```

For additional guidance, see [How to Test Voice AI Agents](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004108).

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I use MCP apps already connected in HighLevel?**

A: Yes. Eligible connections from Managed Agents, Ask AI, and Conversation AI can be reused in Voice AI.

**Q: Can I connect an MCP server that isn't in the catalog?**

A: Yes. Use **Add custom MCP** and enter the server's name and URL.

**Q: What if my custom MCP server requires OAuth?**

A: Open **Advanced** and provide the required Client ID and Client Secret.

**Q: Can I choose which MCP tools the agent uses?**

A: Yes. Select only the tools needed for the agent's tasks.

**Q: Does every connected app work with every S2S model?**

A: MCP availability depends on the supported S2S model and feature access. Confirm compatibility before configuring the agent.

**Q: What happens if an MCP connection expires?**

A: The server shows **Reconnect**. Reauthorize the account to restore access.

**Q: What does App removed mean?**

A: The application was uninstalled elsewhere and needs to be restored.

**Q: How do I know whether the agent used an MCP tool?**

A: Run a test call and review the tool-call details in the transcript.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [How to Set Up Speech-to-Speech Voice AI Agents](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000009217-how-to-set-up-speech-to-speech-s2s-voice-ai-agents-in-highlevel)
- [How to Create Voice AI Agents](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004107-how-to-create-voice-ai-agents)
- [How to Test Voice AI Agents](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004108)
- [MCP Connectors for Managed Agents](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008304-mcp-connectors-for-managed-agents)
- [Custom MCP Connectors for Managed Agents](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008353-custom-mcp-connectors-for-superagents-agent-studio)

title_en: How to Set Up a Conversation AI Bot
source_md:
Conversation AI helps businesses automate customer conversations across supported communication channels in HighLevel. This guide walks you through creating, configuring, testing, and launching a Conversation AI bot using a streamlined setup flow. You can use Conversation AI to collect lead details, answer common questions, support appointment booking, and route conversations more efficiently.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Conversation AI?](#What-is-Conversation-AI?)
- [Key Benefits of Conversation AI](#Key-Benefits-of-Conversation-AI)
- [Setup Methods for Conversation AI Bots](#Setup-Methods-for-Conversation-AI-Bots)
  - [Guided Form Setup](#Guided-Form-Setup)
  - [Prompt Based Bot](#Prompt-Based-Bot)
  - [Flow Based Builder](#Flow-Based-Builder)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Conversation AI?**

Conversation AI is an AI-powered communication tool in HighLevel that helps automate conversations with contacts across supported channels. It can respond to inbound messages, collect information, answer questions, assist with appointment booking, and support workflows based on how the bot is configured.

Conversation AI bots can be created for different business needs, such as general Q&A, lead capture, appointment booking, or more advanced multi-step conversation flows. Proper setup ensures the bot responds on the correct channels, follows your business goals, and provides a consistent customer experience.

---

## **Key Benefits of Conversation AI**

- **Multi-Channel Communication:** Connect your bot to supported channels such as SMS, Email, Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Chat Widget/SMS Chat, and Live Chat.
- **Lead Capture:** Collect key contact details like name, email, phone number, address, and custom qualification answers.
- **Appointment Booking:** Allow the bot to help contacts book, reschedule, or cancel appointments based on your configuration.
- **Faster Response Handling:** Use wait time settings and response modes to control when and how the bot replies.
- **Primary Bot Control:** Assign one primary bot to handle general inbound messages on selected channels.
- **Testing Before Launch:** Test the bot from the setup panel before setting it live in Suggestive or Auto-Pilot mode.
- **Advanced Customization:** Use bot training, Brand Voice, advanced settings, response settings, and workflows to improve bot behavior.

---

## **Setup Methods for Conversation AI Bots**

Conversation AI offers multiple setup methods so you can choose the best option based on your use case and level of customization. Simple bots can be created with a guided form, while more advanced use cases can use prompt-based setup or a visual flow builder.

HighLevel currently provides three main setup methods:

### **Guided Form Setup**

Guided Form Setup is best for straightforward use cases such as lead capture, appointment booking, and general Q&A. This option is ideal when you want a structured setup experience without writing detailed prompts from scratch.

**Use Guided Form Setup when you need:**

- Simple lead capture
- Appointment booking
- General Q&A
- Basic objectives and information collection
- A beginner-friendly bot setup experience

**To create a Guided Form bot:**

```
Note: For a deeper walkthrough, refer to Guided Form Based Setup for Conversation AI.
```

1. Go to **AI Agents** > **Conversation AI** > **+ Create Bot**.
2. Select **Guided Form Setup**.
3. Click **Create New Bot**.
4. Choose the bot type, such as:  
     
   - **General Q&A**
   - **Appointment Booking**
5. Select or create a **Brand Voice**.
6. Configure **Bot Settings**.
7. Configure **Bot Goals**.
8. **Save** the bot.
9. Choose whether the bot should remain **Off**, use **Suggestive** mode, or use **Auto-Pilot**.
10. Or click **Go to Advanced Settings** to continue configuring the bot.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/7kduus0F7Obz5gXKPcNl+/GIF+Recording+2026-06-03+at+20.06.38.gif)

### **Prompt Based Bot**

Prompt Based Bot setup is best for users who are comfortable writing detailed prompts and want more control over the bot’s personality, goals, actions, and behavior.

```
IMPORTANT: Selecting a "Bot Template" when creating your bot will ONLY affect the "Prompts" for your conversation AI bot.  
  
You can always overwrite anything added from the template you selected, but if you select a template, HighLevel will populate the following areas for you to create foundational bot prompts.
```

**Use Prompt Based Bot when you need:**

- More personalized bot behavior
- Custom instructions and prompts
- LLM model selection
- Custom bot personality and goals
- Actions such as appointment booking, workflow triggers, human handover, stop bot, transfer bot, auto follow-up, and conversation summaries

**To create a Prompt Based Bot:**

```
Note: Prompt quality directly impacts the bot’s performance. For guidance on writing better prompts, refer to AI Prompting 101 and Customize your AI responses using Prompts.
```

1. Go to **AI Agents** > **Conversation AI** > **+ Create Bot**.
2. Select **Prompt Based Bot**.
3. Choose one of the available options, such as:  
     
   - **General Q&A**
   - **Appointment Booking**
   - **Marketplace Template**
   - **Start from Scratch**
4. Continue into the bot editor.
5. Configure **Bot Settings**.
6. Configure **[Bot Training](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004416)**.
7. Configure **Bot Goals** using prompts, model settings, and actions.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/oqJ6o7bnzYQSqoHRlYze+/GIF+Recording+2026-06-03+at+20.12.45.gif)

### **Flow Based Builder**

Flow Based Builder is best for advanced users who need visual logic, branching, and multi-step conversation paths. This setup method works well for more complex lead qualification, nurturing, and appointment flows.

```
Note: For detailed setup instructions, refer to Conversation AI Flow Builder.
```

**Use Flow Based Builder when you need:**

- Visual flow-based setup
- Advanced lead qualification
- Multi-step objectives
- Complex logic and branching
- Advanced appointment booking flows
- More control over how contacts move through the conversation

**To create a Flow Based Builder bot:**

1. Go to **AI Agents** > **Conversation AI** > **+ Create Bot**.
2. Select **Flow Based Builder**.
3. Click **Create New Bot**.
4. Continue into the bot editor.
5. Configure **Bot Settings**.
6. Configure **Bot Training**.
7. Open **Bot Goals**.
8. Click **Launch Flow Builder** to create the visual conversation flow.
9. Configure global bot behavior, including:  
   - Tone
   - Personality and style
   - Conversation intent
   - Additional business information
   - Business context
10. Configure available **actions** such as:  
    - Stop bot
    - [Human handover](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005615)
    - [Auto follow-up](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005500)
11. Configure [appointment-related options](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000000210), if needed.
12. Enable [conversation summaries](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006597), if needed.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/YeLzR1fazmgmTMIrSmAw+/GIF+Recording+2026-06-03+at+20.23.24.gif)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Do I need to create a new bot, or can I edit an existing one?**  
You can do either. To edit an existing bot, go to **AI Agents > Conversation AI > Agent List**, then click the bot name or use the three-dot menu and select **Edit**.

**Q: Which setup method should I choose?**  
Use **Guided Form Setup** for simple lead capture, appointment booking, or general Q&A. Use **Prompt Based Bot** if you are comfortable writing detailed prompts. Use **Flow Based Builder** if you need advanced logic, branching, and multi-step conversation paths.

**Q: Does the bot respond immediately after I save it?**  
Not necessarily. New bots may be set to **Off** by default. Review the bot status and switch it to **Suggestive** or **Auto-Pilot** when you are ready.

**Q: What is the difference between Suggestive and Auto-Pilot?**  
Suggestive mode creates reply suggestions for your team to review and send manually. Auto-Pilot sends replies automatically based on the bot’s configuration.

**Q: Should I test the bot before using Auto-Pilot?**  
Yes. Test lead capture, FAQs, appointment booking, unknown questions, and any workflow-related behavior before enabling Auto-Pilot.

**Q: Can the bot collect contact information?**  
Yes. The bot can collect details such as name, email, phone number, street address, city, and custom question 

responses depending on the setup.

**Q: Can Conversation AI book appointments?**  
Yes. If appointment booking is enabled, the bot can help contacts schedule appointments based on the calendar configuration available in your setup.

**Q: What happens if the bot does not know the answer?**  
You can configure email notifications so selected users are alerted when the bot cannot answer a question.

**Q: Can I customize how the bot sounds?**  
Yes. You can select or create a Brand Voice, add instructions, configure bot goals, and adjust response settings to 

align the bot with your business tone.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [Guided Form Based Setup for Conversation AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005382)
- [Conversation AI Flow Builder](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006515)
- [Training Your Conversation AI Bot](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004416)
- [Conversation AI - Primary vs Non-Primary Bots](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004414)
- [Conversation AI - Advanced Settings Overview](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004415)
- [Appointment Booking in Conversation AI](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000000210)

# **What is the Troubleshooting Tool for Calendar?**

The Troubleshooting Tool for Calendar is a diagnostic feature within HighLevel that helps users detect configuration issues that may prevent calendar appointments from being booked successfully. Misconfigured calendars can cause missed bookings, client frustration, and lost revenue. The Troubleshooting Tool for Calendar pinpoints exactly what’s wrong—like missing availability, user sync errors, or incorrect team settings—so users can fix the problem fast without needing to escalate support requests.

---

## **Key Benefits of the Troubleshooting Tool for Calendar**

This feature provides instant clarity into calendar configuration issues, reducing guesswork and support delays. It empowers users to take control of their scheduling experience by identifying and resolving common booking blockers.

- **Instant Visibility**: Detects common calendar setup issues in real-time, including availability gaps, unassigned users, or Google/Outlook sync failures.
- **Self-Service Diagnostics:**Enables users to identify problems without needing to contact support.
- **Faster Booking Recovery:**Quickly uncover the root cause of booking failures so calendars can resume normal function.
- **Multi-Calendar Support:**Works with team and round-robin calendars, ensuring broad diagnostic coverage.
- **User Sync Insights:**Highlights sync-related issues tied to individual users or their connected accounts.

---

## **How To Set Up and Use the Troubleshooting Tool for Calendar**

This built-in tool doesn’t require setup, but knowing where to access it in the latest interface is essential to diagnose booking issues quickly and accurately.

### **Accessing the Troubleshooting Tool**

**Step 1:** Navigate to **Settings → Calendars** in HighLevel. At the top of the page, click Calendar Settings.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155044569840/original/jRV5fRSzdppYjBCX-YmeOMFAH8TdiIEy6A.png?1743793447)

**Step 2:**Locate the calendar you want to troubleshoot. Click the **W****rench Icon**next to that calendar to open the tool.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155044569618/original/XfgdG81VrV3K9eF7vEsYeDfLzx9cP5yPzA.png?1743792864)

### **Quick Access from Calendar Header**

Launching diagnostics from the calendar you’re editing reduces clicks and speeds up fixes.

**Step 1**

Open **Settings → Calendars → [Your Calendar]**, then click **Troubleshoot Calendar** in the **top-right header**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064114658/original/x0y8DwUOBUMa422acn4u3rLWTnsF-8LU9w.png?1770137263)

Click **Troubleshoot Calendar** to open diagnostics without leaving the editor.

---

## **Using the Tool to Diagnose Issues**

**Step 1:**Select a date on the calendar grid.

**Step 2:**Hover over an unavailable time slot to view the reason in a tooltip.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155044569828/original/C7zoyuad_5Oc8Uq1bTLdkWUNoyRT9DDI6A.png?1743793431)

---

## **Additional Troubleshooting Tool Subtopics**

Beyond the basic tool overview, these additional subtopics dive into specific use cases and edge cases that frequently cause booking issues. Understanding how each of these scenarios works ensures you can proactively avoid disruptions and improve your scheduling reliability.

### **Checking Calendar Integration Status**

Proper calendar integration is the foundation for accurate syncing and availability. If your calendar isn’t connected correctly, appointments may fail to appear or sync incorrectly.

1. Go to **Calendar** **Settings > Connections**.
2. Confirm Google or Outlook is marked "Connected".
3. Reconnect if needed and select the correct calendar.

#### 

### **Resolve “Deleted Calendar” Connection Errors**

If a connected Google/Outlook calendar was deleted at the provider, HighLevel may show an error banner. You can now clean this up without contacting Support.

1. In **Settings**of your account, navigate to the **Calendars**section and click on **Connections**tab.
2. Click **Fix This**.  
     
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064653011/original/AnEe_xd9nqPt4K4v0blr-j-CTDg-vU9plg.jpeg?1770799201)
3. Review the modal list of deleted calendars:

   - Each item shows the deleted calendar and where it’s connected in HighLevel.
4. Click **Remove Deleted Calendars** to remove the broken calendar connections in one action.   
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064653223/original/NPvEVYdolJaLe1D31tv2IoIXQDIvI8wCug.png?1770799321)
5. Reconnect or reselect a valid calendar if needed.

```
Learn More: Google Calendar Integration Setup
```

---

## **Troubleshooting User Availability Settings**

Even if the calendar is integrated, missing or incorrect availability blocks bookings. The Troubleshooting Tool will flag users without defined working hours. To review and adjust availability:

1. Go to **Calendars > Calendar Settings**.
2. Find the calendar assigned to the user and click **Edit**.
3. Click the **Availability** tab inside that calendar.
4. Add or edit the available time blocks for relevant days.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155044573166/original/ribvANLujbwTUN1HVdKbI25UrcsxsLnGkA.png?1743802784)

```
Learn More: How to Set Up Availability for Calendar Users
```

---

## **Common Booking Issues and What They Mean**

Each status code shown in the Troubleshooting Tool tooltip reveals the reason a time slot is not bookable.

- **USER**: No available users at this time
- **COLLECTIVE**: One or more users are unavailable
- **CONFLICT**: Third-party calendar conflict
- **BOOKED**: Already booked via the system
- **BLOCKED**: Manually blocked time
- **NOTICE**: Violates minimum scheduling notice
- **TOOFAR**: Beyond allowed date range
- **DAYLIMIT**: Day's appointment limit reached
- **SLOTMAX**: Max bookings for the slot reached
- **BUFFER**: Buffer time blocks this slot
- **DURATION**: Appointment too long for gap
- **PAST**: Time is in the past
- **LOOKBUSY**: Hidden via Look Busy setting
- **NO SEATS**: Max seats reached
- **RESOURCE**: Required resource is unavailable

---

## **Diagnosing Double Booking Issues**

Double bookings can happen when multiple users are synced to the same calendar or if availability overlaps.

- Use the Troubleshooting Tool to identify which users are in conflict.
- Adjust user calendars or isolate calendars per user to avoid overlaps.

```
Learn More: Troubleshoot Double Bookings
```

---

## **Understanding Permission-Related Errors**

Sometimes booking issues occur due to revoked permissions or missing access scopes in Google/Outlook.

- Go to **Settings > My Staff**
- Find Staff Member then select **Edit****> Calendar Configuration**.
- Click **Calendar**on left ribbon then confirm all required permission scopes are granted.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155044572755/original/4_93tlzS1oo_Q6luaPtBUWy1X5r43svwHg.png?1743801520)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155044573243/original/lCnrMllEQ1B868LMYVi4VaZ5IvF6i8WhdQ.png?1743803063)

```
Learn More: User Permissions in Calendars
```

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Do I need to enable the Troubleshooting Tool separately?**No. The Troubleshooting Tool is built into the platform and automatically available under Calendar Settings.

**Q: Why is a time slot showing as “UNAVAILABLE”?**This means the user is outside their availability or the time is blocked by a conflict such as another event, sync issue, or booking restriction.

**Q: Why does my calendar show no available times at all?**This usually occurs when no user is assigned, no availability is set, or calendar sync is disconnected,

**Q: Can I use this tool to debug group or round-robin calendars?**  
Yes. It supports group calendars and shows which users are causing booking failures.

**Q: Does the Troubleshooting Tool show automation or workflow errors?**No. It only surfaces calendar-specific setup issues—not automation logic.

**Q: Can I view availability from the contact’s timezone in this tool?**No. The view is based on the logged-in user's timezone.

---

  - [Q. How do I transfer SaaS accounts to another agency?](#Q.-How-do-I-transfer-SaaS-accounts-to-another-agency?)
- [SaaS Configurator & Plans](#SaaS-Configurator-&-Plans)
  - [Q. Why is “Invalid price currency” shown?](#Q.-Why-is-%E2%80%9CInvalid-price-currency%E2%80%9D-shown?)
  - [Q. How do I disconnect Stripe Connect?](#Q.-How-do-I-disconnect-Stripe-Connect?)
  - [Q. Why can’t I disconnect Stripe (error about active clients)?](#Q.-Why-can%E2%80%99t-I-disconnect-Stripe-(error-about-active-clients)?)
  - [Q. Why are SaaS V1 or V2 plans not visible?](#Q.-Why-are-SaaS-V1-or-V2-plans-not-visible?)
  - [Q. What is the difference between SaaS V1 and V2?](#Q.-What-is-the-difference-between-SaaS-V1-and-V2?)
  - [Q. Can I use SaaS V1 and V2 together?](#Q.-Can-I-use-SaaS-V1-and-V2-together?)
- [Security & Verification](#Security-&-Verification)
  - [Q. Why is 2FA required even if turned off?](#Q.-Why-is-2FA-required-even-if-turned-off?)
  - [Q. Why is rebilling not enabled / not moved to LC?](#Q.-Why-is-rebilling-not-enabled-/-not-moved-to-LC?)
  - [Q. Why is the sub-account showing “Manual Verification Pending”?](#Q.-Why-is-the-sub-account-showing-%E2%80%9CManual-Verification-Pending%E2%80%9D?)
  - [Q. Why is the sub-account “Paused due to pending approval”?](#Q.-Why-is-the-sub-account-%E2%80%9CPaused-due-to-pending-approval%E2%80%9D?)
- [Dashboard & Visibility](#Dashboard-&-Visibility)
  - [Q. Why is the Agency Dashboard not visible?](#Q.-Why-is-the-Agency-Dashboard-not-visible?)

---

## **Billing & Wallet**

### **Q. How do I delete the last card from the billing page?**

If only one card is present, it cannot be removed from the sub-account billing page.

Workarounds:

- Delete the card directly from Stripe (if you have access to the customer)
- For SaaS V2, card management may only be available at the agency level

### **Q. Why do card changes reflect across multiple sub-accounts?**

This happens when multiple sub-accounts share the same Stripe Customer ID.

Solution: Assign different Stripe customers per sub-account:

- Disable SaaS for the sub-account
- Re-enable using:  
    
  - Share link
  - Request via SMS/email

### **Q. Why can’t the client add payment details?**

**Common errors:**

- No such customer
- stripe.confirmPayment()...

**Possible reasons:**

- Stripe customer was deleted
- Stripe account was changed
- Sub-account transferred between agencies

**Solution:**

- Disable and re-enable SaaS to recreate mapping

### **Q. Why can’t Indian clients add payment details?**

Due to RBI regulations, a billing address is required.

**Solution**: Add billing address in Stripe dashboard

### **Q. Why are auto-recharges failing?**

Auto-recharge does not support 3DS-only cards.

**Solution**:

- Use a card that supports 3DS but is not 3DS-only
- Alternatively, use manual recharge

### **Q. What happens when SaaS is disabled?**

- Subscription is cancelled
- Wallet is permanently deleted
- Agency must handle refunds manually

After disabling:

- Agency receives wallet balance via email
- Can refund or add credits manually

### ****Q: How do I delete the last card from the billing page?****

The last remaining card cannot be deleted. The current primary card also cannot be deleted. To remove a card, make sure another payment method remains on the account and that the card you want to delete is not set as the primary card.

## **Welcome Email**

### **Q. Why are custom values not populated?**

Custom values must be configured in:  
  
SaaS Configurator → Advanced Settings. Direct edits in sub-accounts are not supported.

### **Q. What is the default subject of the welcome email?**

"Activate your account"

### **Q. Why is the default email sent instead of my custom email?**

This happens if the template is missing from: [Do Not Edit] SaaS Configurator Templates

**Solution**:

- Reset Agency Welcome Email (via support)

### **Q. Who receives the welcome email?**

All newly created users in a sub-account.

### **Q. How do I fix the wrong sub-account for welcome email?**

Reset the Agency Welcome Email via support

---

## **Sub-Accounts & Subscriptions**

### **Q. Why are duplicate sub-accounts created?**

When purchases are made via:

- Stripe
- Funnels
- Sale links

A new sub-account is created automatically.

To avoid this: Use manage Client page for existing accounts.

### **Q. Why aren’t sub-accounts created via funnels?**

Check if the product is tagged as an Agency Plan.

Notes: Test mode purchases do not create sub-accounts

### **Q. How do I move a subscription between sub-accounts?**

1. Ensure both sub-accounts use the same Stripe customer
2. Disable SaaS (without cancelling subscription) on source account
3. Reload target account → subscription attaches automatically

### **Q. Why can’t I upgrade a plan?**

The sub-account may already be on the highest plan in its category.

Q. Why can’t I switch between monthly and annual SaaS plans?

For SaaS V2 subscriptions, billing interval changes are not currently supported on existing subscriptions.

Supported SaaS V2 plan changes:

Monthly → Monthly

Yearly → Yearly

Not supported for SaaS V2:

Monthly → Yearly

Yearly → Monthly

These options are hidden in the upgrade flow to prevent incorrect billing. This limitation applies only to SaaS V2 subscriptions. SaaS V1 subscriptions are unaffected because Stripe manages interval changes natively.

### **Q. How do I transfer SaaS accounts to another agency?**

1. Disable SaaS for all sub-accounts
2. Transfer sub-accounts
3. Handle wallet balances manually

---

## **SaaS Configurator & Plans**

### **Q. Why is “Invalid price currency” shown?**

**Occurs when:**

- Price currency ≠ category currency

**Fix**:

- Update price in SaaS Configurator
- Then update currency in Stripe

**Note**:

- Currency cannot be changed if:  
    
  - Sale links exist
  - Active subscriptions exist

### **Q. How do I disconnect Stripe Connect?**

Stripe cannot be disconnected if active SaaS billing depends on it.

**Steps**:

1. Go to Agency Settings → Stripe Connect
2. Identify blocked sub-accounts
3. Disable SaaS for those accounts
4. Retry disconnect

### 

### **Q. Why can’t I disconnect Stripe (error about active clients)?**

SaaS is still enabled on sub-accounts using that Stripe account

**Solution**: Disable SaaS for all affected sub-accounts first

### **Q. Why are SaaS V1 or V2 plans not visible?**

This depends on selection during SaaS setup:

- Stripe selected → SaaS V1
- Agency Sub-account selected → SaaS V2

**Fix**:

- Disable SaaS
- Re-enable with correct option

### **Q. What is the difference between SaaS V1 and V2?**

**SaaS V1:**

- Stripe only
- Configured at agency level

**SaaS V2:**

- Multiple providers (Stripe, NMI, Authorize.net, Square)
- Configured per sub-account

### **Q. Can I use SaaS V1 and V2 together?**

No. A sub-account can only use one mode at a time.

**Q. Why can’t I switch between monthly and annual plans?**

- SaaS V1: Allows switching
- SaaS V2: Only same billing interval allowed

---

## **Security & Verification**

### **Q. Why is 2FA required even if turned off?**

- Email verification is mandatory
- Only phone verification can be disabled

### **Q. Why is rebilling not enabled / not moved to LC?**

Because the account is in verification pending state.

**Fix**:

- Complete verification (email/phone)
- Or manually verify via Manage Client

### **Q. Why is the sub-account showing “Manual Verification Pending”?**

This is due to:

- Pending email/phone verification (not pause setting)

**Important**:

- Does NOT block access
- Required during first phone number purchase

### **Q. Why is the sub-account “Paused due to pending approval”?**

This is controlled by:SaaS Configurator → Security → Pause new sub-accounts

**Solution**:

- Approve or reject from:
  - Manage Client page
  - Requests section

---

## **Dashboard & Visibility**

### **Q. Why is the Agency Dashboard not visible?**

Controlled by visibility setting:

- Only Me → Only owner can see
- All Admins → All admins can see

**Fix**:

- Update in: Agency Settings → Stripe

---

**Need More Help?**If your issue isn’t listed: Contact Support

source_md:
[동영상](https://jumpshare.com/embed/6v3T2izCQMMvK4IeGcfS)

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What Are Ask AI Projects?](#What-Are-Ask-AI-Projects?)
  - [Project Instructions and Context](#Project-Instructions-and-Context)
  - [Project Files and Supported Formats](#Project-Files-and-Supported-Formats)
  - [Project Memory](#Project-Memory)
  - [Scheduled Tasks in Projects](#Scheduled-Tasks-in-Projects)
  - [Project Activity and Management](#Project-Activity-and-Management)
    - [Project Activity Tracking](#Project-Activity-Tracking)
    - [Organizing and Managing Projects](#Organizing-and-Managing-Projects)
  - [How to Create and Set Up an Ask AI Project](#How-to-Create-and-Set-Up-an-Ask-AI-Project)
  - [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
  - [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **What Are Ask AI Projects?**

Ask AI Projects in HighLevel let you organize related conversations, files, instructions, and memories in dedicated workspaces. Each project gives Ask AI the context it needs to provide relevant, consistent responses without requiring you to repeat the same information across conversations. You can also manage scheduled tasks, track project activity, and keep different workflows organized in one place.

---

## **Project Instructions and Context**

Project instructions define how Ask AI should approach work within a particular project. By setting expectations for tone, formatting, brand voice, and other requirements, you can maintain a consistent approach across multiple conversations without repeating instructions in every prompt.

Each project can include:

- **Project Name:** Identifies the workspace and helps distinguish it from other projects.
- **Description:** Explains the purpose of the project and provides background about the work.
- **Custom Instructions:** Defines the rules, guidelines, formatting preferences, or brand voice Ask AI should follow.
- **Related Conversations:** Keeps chats associated with the same project together.
- **Reference Content:** Provides additional information through uploaded files, Media Library items, and text documents.
- **Project Memory:** Retains useful information associated with the project.

**For example**, you could create a project named "Monthly Marketing Campaigns" and add instructions such as:

"Write marketing content in a professional, approachable tone. Use concise paragraphs, emphasize customer benefits, and include a clear call to action when appropriate."

These instructions apply to conversations within that project, helping maintain consistent communication.

---

## **Project Files and Supported Formats**

Adding reference materials gives Ask AI access to relevant project information, such as campaign details, content guidelines, or business documentation. Keeping this material within a project helps provide consistent context for conversations related to the same work.

### **Adding Project Context**

You can add reference material to a project using three methods:

- **Upload Files:** Add documents directly from your device.
- **Select From Media Library:** Choose existing files stored in your HighLevel Media Library.
- **Add Text Documents:** Create or add text-based reference content for the project.

### **Supported File Formats**

Ask AI Projects support the following document formats:

| File Type | Format |
| --- | --- |
| PDF documents | .pdf |
| Microsoft Word documents | .docx |
| Plain text documents | .txt |
| Markdown documents | .md |
| Comma-separated values | .csv |

**File Limit:** Each project supports up to 50 files.

For example, a marketing project could include a brand guidelines PDF, a campaign plan in Word format, and a CSV containing approved product information.

## **Project Memory**

Project-specific memory helps Ask AI retain useful information related to ongoing work. Instead of treating each project conversation as an isolated request, memory provides additional context that can make future responses more relevant.

Project memory supports the following actions:

- **Review Memories:** View information saved for the project.
- **Delete Memories:** Remove information that is outdated or no longer needed.
- **Import Memories:** Bring existing memories from another AI assistant into the project.

For example, a project dedicated to creating educational articles could retain relevant preferences about the audience, content style, and terminology.

Project memories are intended to support the work associated with that project. This makes it easier to maintain different working contexts for different objectives.

To learn more about general memory functionality, see [What is Ask AI Memory?](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007963).

---

## **Scheduled Tasks in Projects**

Scheduled tasks allow Ask AI to execute recurring prompts using the instructions and context associated with a project. This is useful for work that needs to happen regularly and should follow the same project-specific guidelines.

Project-based scheduled tasks can support recurring activities such as:

- Preparing periodic marketing summaries.
- Generating recurring content ideas using project brand guidelines.
- Reviewing relevant business information.
- Producing recurring updates based on the project's available context.

For example, a marketing project could include a weekly task asking Ask AI to generate campaign ideas using the project's brand voice and reference documents.

Using project instructions with scheduled tasks helps maintain a consistent approach across recurring executions.

For general scheduling instructions, see [How to Use Scheduled Tasks in Ask AI to Automate Prompts](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007966-how-to-use-scheduled-tasks-in-ask-ai-to-automate-prompts).

---

## **Project Activity and Management**

As your projects grow, management and activity-tracking tools help keep workspaces organized and make important changes easier to review. These capabilities are useful when managing multiple projects with different instructions, reference files, and scheduled tasks.

### **Project Activity Tracking**

Project activity provides visibility into changes involving:

- Project instructions.
- Project files.
- Scheduled tasks.
- Project status.

Reviewing activity helps you understand how a project's configuration has changed over time.

### **Organizing and Managing Projects**

Ask AI includes the following project management capabilities:

- **Search:** Find projects by their identifying information.
- **Sort:** Organize the project list using available sorting controls.
- **P****in:** Keep important projects easily accessible.
- **Archive:** Move projects that are no longer part of your active work out of the main project list.
- **Restore:** Return archived projects to your active workspace.

**For example**, you could pin frequently used projects and archive completed campaigns to reduce clutter while keeping those projects available for future reference.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can other HighLevel users access my Ask AI Projects?**

No. Projects and their associated chats are private to the individual user. The availability of Projects at the agency and sub-account levels does not mean projects are shared with other users.

**Q: Are projects shared between agency and sub-account views?**

No. Each agency and sub-account maintains its own projects, keeping project work organized within the relevant account context.

**Q: How many files can I add to a project?**

Each project supports up to 50 files. Supported document formats include PDF, Word (.docx), plain text, Markdown, and CSV.

**Q: Can I import memories from another AI assistant?**

Yes. Ask AI Projects include an option for importing memories from another AI assistant. This can help you bring existing context into a project instead of rebuilding that information manually.

**Q: Do I need to create a separate project for every conversation?**

No. Projects are designed to group related conversations together. You can use a single project for multiple conversations that share the same objectives, reference materials, or instructions.

**Q: What is the difference between project instructions and Ask AI Skills?**

Project instructions provide guidelines and context for conversations within a particular project. [Ask AI Skills](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000008434-ask-ai-skills-and-connectors) are reusable instruction sets that Ask AI can apply when a request matches a particular workflow or when a user invokes a Skill.

**Q: Can I restore an archived project?**

Yes. Ask AI Projects support archiving and restoring projects, allowing you to organize inactive work without permanently removing the project from your available workspaces.

**Q: Can scheduled tasks use my project's context?**

Yes. Scheduled tasks associated with a project run using its instructions and context. This helps recurring tasks follow the guidelines and reference information relevant to the project.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Ask AI Assistant](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005327)
- [What is Ask AI Memory?](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007963)

title_en: How to Schedule and Automate Performance Reports for Online Business Listings
source_md:
Listings Performance Recap Reports automatically send your clients a polished, data-rich summary of their online-listing visibility and engagement. Delivering clear proof of value every month or quarter keeps retention high while saving your agency hours of manual reporting.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Listings Performance Recap Reports?](#%E2%80%8B%E2%80%8BWhat-is-Listings-Performance-Recap-Reports?)
- [Key Benefits of Listings Performance Recap Reports](#Key-Benefits-of-Listings-Performance-Recap-Reports)
- [Automated Reports](#Automated-Reports)
- [Listings Score Calculation](#Listings-Score-Calculation)
- [Report Preferences](#Report-Preferences)
- [Dashboard Enhancements](#Dashboard-Enhancements)
- [How To Setup Listings Performance Recap Reports](#How-To-Setup-Listings-Performance-Recap-Reports)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)

---

# **What is Listings Performance Recap Reports?**

Listings Performance Recap Reports are branded, automated emails and in-app digests that grade each location’s online listings (score out of 100) and highlight key visibility, engagement, and action items.

By combining profile-completion health with live Analytics data, the report shows clients exactly where they shine and where to focus next without any manual work.

---

## **Key Benefits of Listings Performance Recap Reports**

- Hands-free proof of value scheduled summaries keep your agency top-of-mind

- Data-driven retention clients receive concrete visibility and engagement stats

- Action-oriented each report recommends the three quickest wins to boost scores

- Flexible cadence send monthly, quarterly, or half-yearly to match client needs

- Unified branding logo, colors, and sender domain carry your agency’s identity

- At-a-glance dashboard card shows last score + recent improvement for quick check-ins

---

## **Automated Reports**

Automated Reports generate on the schedule you set and reach clients by email and in-app notifications. Each recap includes:

- Listings Performance Score (0–100)

- Profile Completion %

- Views, clicks, CTR trends pulled from Listings Analytics

- Top 3 recommended actions e.g., “Add appointment URL” or “Sync to Apple Maps”

- White-labeled header and footer that match your agency branding

---

## **Listings Score Calculation**

The new scoring engine blends three pillars so clients see a single, easy-to-track grade.

- **Visibility:**directory sync status, profile completeness, Google Business Profile link

- **Engagement:** listing views, clicks, calls, and CTR trajectory

- **Actionability:**freshness of data, onboarding tasks completed, prior recap interactions

Scores update automatically each time a recap is generated, and the dashboard card compares the latest score to the previous period.

---

## **Report Preferences**

Report Preferences allow agency and location admins to choose exactly who gets what and when.

- **Frequency selector:** Monthly | Quarterly | Half-Yearly

- **Recipient management:**mix internal users, clients, and custom emails

- **Delivery channels:**Email (with custom “from” domain) and/or in-app bell notifications

- Preview mode to test branding before activating the schedule

- Unified recipient UI also powers other Listings notifications for streamlined control

---

## **Dashboard Enhancements**

Listings now features a “Performance Recap” card at the top of the Listings dashboard. The card displays:

- Current Listings Performance Score

- Change (+/-) versus last period

- Quick-link to open the full recap report

You’ll also notice a Profile Completion Progress Meter beside each location, showing exactly which attributes are still missing for maximum score.

---

## **How To Setup Listings Performance Recap Reports**

Set up once let HighLevel handle the rest.

### **Open Listings Analytics**

From the left navigation menu, click **Reputation**, then select **Listings** and open the **Analytics** tab. This is where you can view listings performance data and access reporting options for scheduling automated recap reports.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062938351/original/nK3hS3tTiiDLSOjEbL_fWyi-z-ykldH1WQ.png?1768813983)

### **Schedule Report**

In the **Analytics** view, click **Schedule Report** in the top-right corner to open the reporting options. From the dropdown, choose **Schedule New Report** to begin creating an automated listings performance recap.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062938441/original/QM2bjd7rDidCmOMmOj0hK7SfXsaHgJFeIw.png?1768814041)

### **Select Entity**

In the **Schedule Report** panel, use the **Select Entity for Scheduling** dropdown to choose the business location or entity for which the report will be generated. This ensures the performance recap pulls analytics and listings data for the correct business.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062939616/original/uldtFbatE3cEeezbJ6smesl9zF5zYe1gHA.png?1768814611)

### **Choose Analytics**

Under **Choose Analytics Graphs**, select the metrics you want to include in the performance recap report, such as impressions, actions, profile views, and device usage. These selections determine which charts and data points appear in the automated report sent to recipients.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062939823/original/TDTkTyXQ3wzArnBU1nyCw2vtQ1ZCq5fFEA.png?1768814689)

### **Customize Branding**

In the **Branding Guidelines** section, confirm or update the agency logo and enter a **Report Headline** and **Report Description**. These details control how the recap report appears to recipients and help ensure it aligns with your agency’s branding and messaging.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062940380/original/xBEMR0HLcu8I5drs_GIssuTNifIsJmwIKw.png?1768814962)

### **Set Frequency**

In the **Scheduling Details** section, choose how often the performance recap should be sent—**Monthly**, **Quarterly**, or **Half-Yearly**. The selected frequency controls the reporting period and determines when recipients receive updated listings performance summaries.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062940750/original/Ad53cfK8VAh3hYvEklqaYJ_sSkd1f7wDlQ.png?1768815143)

### **Set Schedule**

Use the **At** and **Starting On** fields to define the exact time and start date for the automated report delivery. This determines when the first recap is sent and establishes the timing for all future scheduled reports.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062940981/original/hwvZHiwUS9FcSybfKq8e_SjdLPQIQ_O7Jg.png?1768815222)

### **Select Language**

In the **Language** section, choose the language in which the performance recap report will be generated. This ensures the report content is localized appropriately for the recipients receiving the automated update.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062941282/original/SFgIn31WFbf_DmxQeQ93LNQPnHSpkROZ_w.png?1768815352)

### **Send Notifications**

In the **Send Notifications** section, choose whether the report should be delivered via **In-App**, **Email**, or both. Then select the users or email addresses that should receive the automated listings performance recap.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062943673/original/t-awpuGPX2c5L5DU3mAI3UMrbIPSOwKIpg.png?1768816337)

### **Configure Email**

In the **Email Settings** section, enter the **From Email**, customize the **Subject**, and review or edit the **Email Content** that recipients will see. These settings control how the listings performance recap email is branded and communicated when delivered via email.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062943892/original/sAgMnMcp9gXr1NReTiryktVHXMBDGj-X9w.png?1768816460)

### **Save Schedule**

Review all report settings, then click **Schedule Report** to activate the automated listings performance recap. Once saved, the schedule runs automatically based on the selected frequency, timing, and delivery preferences.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062944254/original/NU-fy3Pse6-DrcjajYFhfeyH1CVP18whFg.png?1768816608)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Who can create or edit a Recap Report schedule?**

Agency owners, agency admins, and location admins with Listings permission.

**Q: Can I send the recap only to my team and not the client?**

Yes simply leave client emails off the recipient list. You can add or remove recipients anytime.

**Q: How is the Performance Score weighted?**

Visibility, Engagement, and Actionability each contribute roughly one-third, but HighLevel dynamically weights sub-metrics (e.g., GBP sync) based on industry benchmarks.

**Q: What if a location’s listings aren’t fully synced yet?**

The Visibility pillar will reflect lower completeness, and the report’s action list will prioritize finishing the sync.

**Q: Can I change the report cadence later?**

Absolutely, edit the schedule and pick a new frequency; the next run will follow the updated cadence.

**Q: Do recipients need a HighLevel login to view the report?**

No. Email recipients receive a fully branded PDF and summary inline; in-app notification recipients open the report directly inside HighLevel.

**Q: Will the recap include analytics from Uberall integrations?**

At launch, scoring uses Yext-powered metrics. Uberall analytics integration is on the roadmap.

**Q: How far back does the report pull data?**

Each recap compares the selected period (30 / 90 / 180 days) to the immediately previous period so trends are clear.

[Eliza Agent Platform Introduction and FAQs](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001236572-eliza-agent-platform-introduction-and-faqs)  
[Eliza Agent Platform Settings within the CRM](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001236605-eliza-agent-platform-settings-within-the-crm)

[Eliza Agent Platform Settings](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001236575-eliza-agent-platform-settings)

[Eliza Agent Platform Search Tools](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001236599-eliza-agent-platform-search-tools)

[Eliza Agent Platform Dashboard](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001236604-eliza-agent-platform-dashboard)

---

## **Conversations Tab Overview**

[동영상](https://www.loom.com/embed/0e68e608020840ec98705da4bec7de38)

### **Filtering Options**

Messages can be filtered by Read/Unread/All, Priority Location, and contacts Sent to Eliza. There is also a way to sort the messages by High Priority First, Low Priority First, Latest First, and Oldest First.

We will elaborate on the Sent to Eliza messages in a different section.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48290394532/original/JU75eJsXUsFDnw93X0tmgqvZlTa-c1mWzw.png?1680254733)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48290391763/original/0JkIjf9gF3Xq1hqTbNuow3FmU2yYTME1Kg.png?1680254186)

When you click this icon, all the replied conversations will be closed in one click.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48290391760/original/xZpFrPJClfN6i59LS9zDC1EkgchK12lAXw.png?1680254185)  
 Here 30 represents the total number of conversations in the inbox and 12 conversations that need a response.

On the right side, the tabs give additional information necessary to nurture the lead.

### **Contact tab**

- The following information is available under the Contact tab:
- location,
- address
- location's current time with time zone
- Contact details
- DND toggle
- Tags - to add or remove tags from the contact
- Campaigns - Contact can be added to a campaign
- Opportunities - add a contact as an opportunity or change stage for a contact

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48290394450/original/yzI6G7dN_G_xUXeBZ0j4sCp2XVQdOlU_4g.png?1680254711)

### **General Info**

- It has all the information from the General Info tab of GHL.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48290394564/original/AGE3pH_KdFhdcoC7ZN-KU-KxJTy-c9yaNA.png?1680254751)

### **Additional Info**

- It has all the custom fields. You can click "**Hide Empty Field"**to hide the empty fields to avoid clutter.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48290397727/original/0xbmXbZxP0LfLMdSGlUKW0ZYJD5OeRhRlA.png?1680255622)

### **FAQs**

- Displays all the FAQs configured for the location. The agent can click the icon to the left of the FAQ answer and copy it directly to the reply box in the conversation. The agent can search on the FAQs section for faster results.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48290397669/original/-95OC6Oq_uy7Azj2rp-9eyqt020lZs-gKQ.png?1680255602)

### **Appt**

Lists all the appointments booked for the chosen contact. A meeting can be either rescheduled, canceled, or deleted.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48290399325/original/V13KkE7yfa_Ad93vn9E4foSa74f_yicaqA.png?1680256033)

### **Notes**

- Shows the notes added to this contact. An Eliza Agent can also add notes in this section.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48290399901/original/b_1rpEyM_k5gQszUQx16wHlOJtMdMhoK_g.png?1680256176)

### **Tasks**

- This tab lists tasks created on this contact. Eliza agent can also create tasks for users on the HighLevel account.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48290400295/original/s2R1TLVEtiKwrjlq8j8n6VFq-iOHsMFsug.png?1680256271)

### **Conversations in a single screen**

This Conversations screen will list all the conversations from the locations this agent is assigned to work on. 

Eliza Agent Platform supports seven channels - Email / Text / GMB / Facebook messenger / Instagram  / Reviews/calls.

The conversations box will list items from all these seven channels.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48290401666/original/Qe8DsuCDVsJIoQ9u28Ikq-RBPrB9ScqQgQ.png?1680256594)

### **Scheduling in Eliza**

For scheduling an appointment, the agent can directly choose the calendar, date, and time slot to book the appointment. 

These slots shown in the dropdown are those available within the scheduled dates. If you want to see all the available slots, check the box "Show all available slots." This way, agents can see and book those appointments that are not visible for leads in general.

The appointment can be automatically confirmed by choosing the "Confirmed" option in the appointment status. If you don't want to ensure, select "New" in this dropdown.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48290403899/original/Wr2DJa6WysWgakUQKVhmLsEaPszn6D-TZA.png?1680257143)

If the team calendar is chosen, booking it in the round-robin or for a particular team member will be available.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48290404110/original/rS_vf2KwGqPMhSeHezjz3bE8TPZQI9lZJQ.png?1680257201)

### **Search Appointments**

The agent can search for the available slots on this screen if the contact gives a broad range of options.

Clicking **"View more"** will allow more open slots for sending back to the lead.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48290404579/original/7H5IDLBWvZqXLh39ExRp_vVctycnVK6X3A.png?1680257297)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48290405057/original/cNhxT0TvKafJ6XJ1zM36FIepUIekN8QGBg.png?1680257405)

### **Ending the Chat**

When a chat is ended, the system will give the option to choose the disposition. The agent can select the "Close without disposition" option if the conversation has to be closed without a disposition.

For the chosen disposition, the agent will be forced to enter the comment if configured to require the comments. Also, if a tag is configured to be assigned upon adding the disposition, that tag will be assigned.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48290408677/original/LbgqwL8Icm-SxPAblXlIJpLaO3SDKoERUQ.png?1680258305)

### **Supported Channels**

- Text
- Email
- GMB
- Facebook Messenger
- Instagram
- Reviews
- Calls

#### **Outbound calling**

If the phone number is available on a contact, Eliza Agent can start the call by clicking the phone icon next to the contact's name at the top.

When the call is in progress, an option for Blind transfer and warm transfer is available at the top.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48290409256/original/ghsBTyXlspVIUbjWncIbQYoKsUeVRoeKRQ.png?1680258480)

#### **Send to Eliza Workflow setup on HL and Eliza Agent Platform.**

Contacts are sent to the Eliza Agent Platform when there is an inbound message from a contact. Instead, if you need to immediately send the contact into the Eliza Agent platform when it comes into CRM, you can use Send to Eliza action on the workflow.

*The difference between the Send to Eliza workflow action and the Send to Eliza tag is that the workflow action will immediately push the contact into the Eliza Agent Platform. The Send to Eliza tag will only push the contact when there is an inbound message.*

Login into the GHL location's workflow section.

Set up the trigger (for ex: Call status or CRM-Contact updated etc.) and select the action as "Add Send to Eliza Agent Platform."

When this workflow is executed, the contacts will get forwarded to the Eliza Agent Platform immediately.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48290408442/original/InBqBasjf6yLeYnwEom9RrCubmJ5uZrMVw.png?1680258240)

#### **Send to Eliza contacts on the Eliza Agent Platform.**

The contacts sent to Eliza by workflow will have a specific icon on the contact.

Alternatively, if the agent wants to see only these contacts, they can filter for "Send to Eliza" and respond immediately upon arrival.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/48290409487/original/PNDiXX9RoAiC5iWycbJZQ87j9G5gW7ZE9g.png?1680258546)

title_en: How to create an Embedded Voice AI Chat Widget
source_md:
Add a Voice AI Chat Widget directly inside your website or funnel content for a more natural, on-page conversation experience. HighLevel’s Embedded/Inline placement gives you more control over where the widget appears, making it easier to match your layout, branding, and conversion flow. This setup is ideal for businesses that want Voice AI to feel like part of the page instead of a floating element.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Embedded Voice AI Widget?](#What-is-the-Embedded-Voice-AI-Widget?)
  - [Key Benefits of Embedded Voice AI Chat Widgets](#Key-Benefits-of-Embedded-Voice-AI-Chat-Widgets)
  - [Where Embedded Voice AI Chat Works Best](#Where-Embedded-Voice-AI-Chat-Works-Best)
  - [How to Create an Embedded Voice AI Chat Widget](#How-to-Create-an-Embedded-Voice-AI-Chat-Widget)
  - [Important Behavior Notes](#Important-Behavior-Notes)
  - [Best Practices](#Best-Practices)
  - [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
  - [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is the Embedded Voice AI Widget?**

An Embedded Voice AI Chat Widget is a Voice AI widget that appears inline within your website or funnel content instead of floating in the corner of the screen. This gives you more flexibility in how you present Voice AI on key pages, such as landing pages, lead capture pages, service pages, or offer sections.

Unlike the default Sticky placement, Embedded/Inline placement lets the widget become part of the page layout. This can create a more seamless and immersive visitor experience while keeping the conversation flow aligned with the surrounding content.

---

## **Key Benefits of Embedded Voice AI Chat Widgets**

Embedded Voice AI Chat Widgets help you create a more intentional on-page experience by placing the conversation exactly where visitors are most likely to engage.

- **Inline placement flexibility:** Add the Voice AI widget directly inside page sections instead of relying on a floating chat bubble.
- **More natural user experience:** Make conversations feel like part of the website content rather than a separate overlay.
- **Cleaner page design control:** Align the widget with your funnel or website layout for a more branded experience.
- **Mobile-ready experience:** The embedded widget is responsive by default for mobile visitors.
- **Flexible deployment options:** Use multiple inline placements and combine embedded and sticky widget experiences on the same website or funnel.

---

## **Where Embedded Voice AI Chat Works Best**

Embedded Voice AI Chat can be used on:

- Funnels
- Websites
- Landing pages
- Custom HTML sites
- Other supported pages where Chat Widgets can be installed

The embedded widget is also **mobile responsive by default**, so it adjusts automatically for smaller screens while remaining part of the page content.

---

## **How to Create an Embedded Voice AI Chat Widget**

Proper setup ensures the widget appears exactly where you want it and behaves consistently across your website or funnel.

#### **Step 1:** Create a New Chat Widget

Go to **Sites → Chat Widget**then click **+ New** or open an existing widget.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155069727496/original/9bw1eW0iksbWHLRoSKoBswB3hp0xJ826tA.png?1776872089)

#### **Step 2:**Select Voice AI Chat

Choose the **Voice AI**chatoption.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155069727655/original/qXH-6HMXpq7qBhhDIuOeaqC1wHFeQWdTZQ.png?1776872176)

#### **Step 3:**Set Widget Placement to Embedded

1. Navigate to the **Style** tab
2. Under **Widget Placement**, choose: **Embedded / Inline (Renders inside content)**

This ensures the widget will appear **within your page layout** instead of floating on the screen.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155069727741/original/dj154NLfaKUa1PpzcyWzC93kWDQtWUakPQ.png?1776872225)

#### **Step 4: Customize Your Widget**

Use the available styling options to match the widget to your page design.

For embedded Voice AI widgets, configure the following options:

1. Under Widget placement, choose how the Voice AI widget appears on your website:

- **Sticky:**Keeps the widget fixed in a page corner.
- **Embedded/Inline:** Renders the widget inline within your page content.

2. For Embedded/Inline widgets, configure the Display Mode:

- **Avatar:** Shows a static visual representation.
