title_en: SEO: AI Recommendations - Infinite Scroll
source_md:
Save time reviewing SEO fixes—AI Recommendations now uses infinite scroll. Rows load continuously as you move through the table, respecting any active filters or sorting. This upgrade streamlines triage on large sites and improves data consistency across the table, filter chips, and the details drawer.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is AI Recommendations - Infinite Scroll?](#%E2%80%8B%E2%80%8BWhat-is-AI-Recommendations---Infinite-Scroll?)
- [Key Benefits of AI Recommendations - Infinite Scroll](#Key-Benefits-of-AI-Recommendations---Infinite-Scroll)
- [Issue Count Accuracy Improvements](#Issue-Count-Accuracy-Improvements)
- [Performance Tips for Large Sites](#Performance-Tips-for-Large-Sites)
- [Availability & Prerequisites](#Availability-&-Prerequisites)
- [How To Use AI Recommendations - Infinite Scroll](#How-To-Use-AI-Recommendations---Infinite-Scroll)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is AI Recommendations - Infinite Scroll?**

AI Recommendations identifies on-page issues (like title tags, meta descriptions, image alt text etc) and proposes one‑click fixes. The new infinite scroll enhancement replaces page-by-page navigation with lazy-loaded rows, so you can review more suggestions in a single, continuous view without breaking focus.

---

## **Key Benefits of AI Recommendations - Infinite Scroll**

Understanding the practical gains helps you decide whether to adopt this workflow immediately for day-to-day SEO triage or introduce it gradually to your team.

- **Effortless navigation**: Browse fixes without Next/Previous buttons using continuous scrolling.
- **Faster triage**: Scan and act on many recommendations with fewer clicks.
- **Accurate counts**: Issue totals align more reliably across the table, filter chips, and the details drawer.
- **Filter-aware loading**: Newly loaded rows automatically honor your current filters and sorting.
- **Smoother workflow**: Stay in context while opening and closing the details drawer.

---

## **Issue Count Accuracy Improvements**

Accurate totals prevent confusion when tracking progress across different parts of the UI.

- Counts shown in the table header, filter chips, and the details drawer now pull from a unified source of truth.
- As you filter, sort, and scroll, totals stay consistent to better reflect your current view.

---

## **Performance Tips for Large Sites**

Keep the interface responsive while reviewing thousands of potential fixes across big audits.

- Close the right-side preview/details drawer when not actively reviewing content.
- Limit other heavy browser tabs while working through long lists.
- Use filters to reduce the visible result set when you notice stutter.

---

## **Availability & Prerequisites**

Confirm eligibility and setup requirements so your team can access the feature without surprises.

- HighLevel**SEO must be enabled** for the sub-account.
- **A Site Project must be added** and an audit must be available to surface recommendations.
- **Compatibility:** AI Recommendations aren’t available for **WordPress sites** or **External Websites**.

---

## **How To Use AI Recommendations - Infinite Scroll**

Following these steps ensures you’re reviewing recommendations in the correct place, with filters and sorts applied for maximum efficiency.

1. In your sub-account, go to **Sites → SEO **→ Site projects**** and select the desired **Site Project**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055733741/original/F0iCFXopwmgyDrwTDCnedmjMx-TO-vj1AA.png?1760108260)
2. Open **AI Recommendations.**Begin scrolling; rows will load continuously. Use filters and sorting to focus your queue.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055734702/original/l4vNn2Dv5k1GP6f5EntVUDU4eCrrOOsOcA.gif?1760108829)
3. Click any row to open **Issue Details**. Review the suggested fix and choose **Apply** or **Dismiss**.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Do I need to enable anything to get infinite scroll?**  
No. Infinite scroll is part of the AI Recommendations experience and is available automatically when SEO is enabled for the sub-account.

**Q: How do credits work for AI Recommendations?**  
Each fix **suggestion** consumes **1 credit** (up to 500/month available). Viewing or scrolling through existing rows does not consume additional credits.

**Q: Can I jump to a specific page number?**  
Page numbers aren’t used with infinite scroll. Use filters or the search bar to find specific URLs or issue types.

**Q: Does infinite scroll affect performance on very large audits?**  
Rows load in small batches to help maintain responsiveness. If you experience slowness, reduce the visible list with filters and close the details drawer when not needed.

**Q: Is this available for WordPress sites or external websites?**  
No. AI Recommendations are not available for WordPress sites or External Websites.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [A Quick Walkthrough of SEO: A Guide to Boosting Your Search Rankings](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000004723-a-quick-walkthrough-of-seo-a-guide-to-boosting-your-search-rankings)
- [Site Audit: Monitor, Analyze, and Optimize Your Website’s Technical SEO](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005162-site-audit-monitor-analyze-and-optimize-your-website-s-technical-seo)
- [SEO Plan Comparison: HighLevel vs Ahrefs vs SEMrush (2025)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005054/)
- [Keyword Research and Rank Tracking in HighLevel SEO](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005852-keyword-research-and-rank-tracking-in-gohighlevel-seo)
- [Content Creation & SEO Assistance!](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005161-content-creation-seo-assistance-)
- [SEO Meta Data](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48000980312-seo-meta-data)

title_en: Selecting AI Employee Plan Tiers in SaaS Configurator
source_md:
SaaS Configuration

# Selecting AI Employee Plan Tiers in SaaS Configurator

Choose Growth or Unlimited AI Employee tiers when building SaaS plans, with clear pricing and feature comparison to ensure clients get the tier you intend.

What You'll Learn

The SaaS Configurator lets you pick a specific AI Employee tier (Growth or Unlimited) when bundling AI Employee into client plans, replacing the previous on/off toggle with tier-specific selection.

This article covers how the tier picker works, what agencies see when configuring plans, and how the selected tier carries through to client provisioning.

## What is AI Employee Tier Selection?

AI Employee Tier Selection allows agencies to choose which AI Employee plan tier — Growth or Unlimited — to include when bundling AI Employee into a SaaS plan. Instead of a simple on/off toggle, the SaaS Configurator provides a plan picker that displays each tier's pricing and features side by side.

Once you select a tier, that choice is saved with the plan and displayed in the Configurator's main view. When a client is provisioned on that plan, they receive the AI Employee tier you configured, ensuring alignment between your pricing strategy and what the client actually receives.

This tier-selection approach is built to extend to other multi-tier addons in the future, establishing a consistent pattern for configuring tiered services within SaaS plans.

## Key Benefits

Selecting a specific AI Employee tier when configuring SaaS plans provides clarity and control over pricing, provisioning, and client expectations.

**Accurate Margin Planning** — Build SaaS pricing with confidence by knowing exactly which AI Employee tier cost is included in your plan.

**Correct Client Provisioning** — Clients land on the AI Employee tier you configured, eliminating tier mismatches and billing confusion.

**Clear Pricing Visibility** — See the selected tier and its cost directly in the Configurator's main view without reopening the addon flow.

**Informed Tier Selection** — Compare Growth and Unlimited pricing and features side by side before committing to a tier.

**Reduced Support Escalations** — Fewer ambiguous addon configurations mean fewer tickets from tier-related billing issues.

## How the Plan Picker Works

When you add AI Employee to a SaaS plan, the Configurator displays a plan picker that presents Growth and Unlimited tiers using the same selection pattern familiar from marketplace app plans.

Component 1

Tier Comparison View

Each tier is displayed with its price and a feature list, allowing you to evaluate which tier fits your client's needs and your pricing strategy before making a selection.

Component 2

Persistent Tier Display

Once you select a tier, the Configurator's main screen shows the chosen tier and its cost at a glance, so you don't need to reopen the addon flow to confirm which tier is attached to a plan.

Component 3

Provisioning Integration

The selected tier is saved with the plan configuration and used during client provisioning, ensuring clients receive the exact AI Employee tier you configured rather than a default.

## How to Select an AI Employee Tier in Your SaaS Plan

Follow these steps to add AI Employee to a SaaS plan and choose the appropriate tier for your clients.

Step 1

Open the SaaS Configurator

Navigate to the SaaS Configurator in your agency account and select the plan you want to configure.

Step 2

Add AI Employee to the Plan

Click the option to add AI Employee as an addon. The plan picker will appear, displaying Growth and Unlimited tiers.  
  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077211037/original/s7Pl16uEuuBQ3xje3jwNZZEO59mBxbWd4Q.png?1785401584)

Step 3

Review Tier Pricing and Features

Compare the pricing and feature lists for Growth and Unlimited to determine which tier aligns with your client's needs and your pricing model.

Step 4

Select a Tier

Click on your chosen tier (Growth or Unlimited). The picker will save your selection and return you to the Configurator's main view.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077211165/original/it2Gbeo3q16ZBwFI6NCz7rEorrH4wEaluA.png?1785401647)

Step 5

Confirm Tier Display in Configurator

The main Configurator screen now displays the selected AI Employee tier and its price alongside the plan's other addons and features.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155077211185/original/u1sBgq7uLbgt0UhjfetSsqVFwomwXAMqVg.png?1785401665)

Step 6

Save and Publish the Plan

Save your plan configuration. When a client is provisioned on this plan, they will receive the AI Employee tier you selected.

Success

Your SaaS plan is configured with the correct AI Employee tier, and clients provisioned on this plan will receive the tier you chose.

## Important Notes and Limitations

Be aware of these considerations when working with AI Employee tier selection in SaaS plans.

Plans Created Before This Feature

If a plan had AI Employee enabled before this feature existed, it may not yet have an explicit tier attached. In some cases, the plan picker may show AI Employee as unselected or priced at $0 until you open the plan and confirm the tier. A default AI Employee tier is applied automatically for plans without one, but you should still verify the tier is correct for your pricing.

Support and Customer Success

Reports of "AI Employee shows as missing or $0 on an existing plan" should be treated as expected transition-period issues. The fix is to reopen the plan and reselect the correct tier.

Pricing Comparison Scope

The pricing and feature comparison displayed in the picker is specific to AI Employee. A more dynamic, backend-driven version for other future addons is a known follow-up, not available for other addons yet.

Current Scope

This release is scoped to AI Employee, though the picker pattern is designed for reuse if other multi-tier addons are introduced later.

title_en: Using Countdown Timers in Emails
source_md:
Countdown timers in emails are dynamic elements that create urgency by counting down to a specific deadline. They help convey the sense of exclusivity and prompt users to act quickly.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What are Countdown Timers in Emails?](#What-are-Countdown-Timers-in-Emails?)
- [Key Benefits of Using Countdown Timers in Emails](#Key-Benefits-of-Using-Countdown-Timers-in-Emails)
- [Countdown Timer Behavior in Emails](#Countdown-Timer-Behavior-in-Emails)
- [Dynamic Countdown Timers in Emails](#Dynamic-Countdown-Timers-in-Emails)
- [How to Use Countdown Timers in Emails](#How-to-Use-Countdown-Timers-in-Emails)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What are Countdown Timers in Emails?**

Countdown timers in emails display a live visual countdown inside an email campaign or template. They are commonly used to highlight deadlines, encourage faster action, and guide contacts toward a timely next step, such as registering for an event, claiming an offer, or completing a purchase.

A countdown timer can be added to an email using the Email Builder. After the timer is inserted, you can select an existing countdown timer, adjust its alignment, and connect buttons or calls-to-action to the timer’s destination link.

---

## **Key Benefits of Using Countdown Timers in Emails**

- **Enhances Aesthetics**: Adds a visually appealing and engaging element to your emails.
- **Creates Urgency**: Encourages users to make decisions faster and not delay their actions.
- **Higher engagement:** Make launches, promotions, events, and limited-time offers feel more time-sensitive.
- **Improved clarity:** Show contacts exactly how much time remains instead of relying only on written deadline reminders.

---

## **Countdown Timer Behavior in Emails**

Countdown timers in emails are designed to display a time-sensitive visual countdown when the recipient opens the message. Understanding how they render in different email clients helps set the right expectations before sending a campaign.

Countdown timers are displayed in emails as animated images. When a recipient opens the email, the timer generates based on the countdown configuration and the contact’s email experience. The timer can continue updating briefly while the email remains open, but email clients may cache images or limit how often animated content refreshes.

Important behavior to keep in mind:

- Countdown timers in emails are generated dynamically when the email is opened.
- Timer display can depend on the recipient’s email client.
- Some email clients may cache the timer image instead of refreshing it continuously.
- [Apple Mail](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005616) may show a cached version of the countdown timer, which can prevent the timer from updating as expected.

```
Note: Always preview and test your email before sending it to a larger audience.
```

---

## **Dynamic Countdown Timers in Emails**

Dynamic countdown timers allow the countdown experience to be personalized based on contact behavior, such as when an email is opened or sent. This is helpful when each recipient should receive their own deadline instead of sharing one fixed expiration date.

**Example**: If your timer is set to end at midnight on December 25th and a user opens the email on December 24th, the timer will show "24 hours left." It will then count down to "23 hours 59 minutes left" and stop updating as long as the email is open. If the email is opened again after closing, the timer refreshes the timer to take the latest time stamp and counts down to next 60 seconds.

**Use a Dynamic timer when:**

- Each contact should receive their own countdown window.
- The deadline should be based on when the email is opened or sent.
- The offer is evergreen rather than tied to one fixed calendar date.
- You want the email timer to stay aligned with a destination page timer.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/KfraWn16b8BCnAait3wy+/Screen+Shot+2026-09-22+at+16.40.19.png)

---

## **How to Use Countdown Timers in Emails**

1. **Create a Countdown Timer**: Go to **Marketing** from the left navigation > then **Countdown Timer**and create your timer.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/Ds2J8J91PjJfXe26HDbh+/Screen+Shot+2026-09-22+at+16.48.29.png)
2. Go to **Marketing** from the left navigation > then **Emails > Templates.**
3. **Create** a **New Template** or **edit** an **existing** one.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/RtpSpeaezcjYFqAq7rfL+/Screen+Shot+2026-09-22+at+17.00.21.png)
4. Make sure you are in **design editor or**switch to it**.**
5. **Add** the **countdown** **timer** **element** into your email.
6. **Choose** the **desired** **timer** by viewing its design and details.  
     
   Enable **Adapt to Contact Time Zone** so each recipient sees the correct local deadline. To learn more, see: [Timezone Adaptation in Countdown Timers](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000007171)
7. **Adjust Timer Settings**: Click on settings to align the timer within your email.
8. **[Customize Appearance](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003100)**: Set the background color and adjust padding as needed.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/DSFN94kzv0cxptDiEf11+/GIF+Recording+2026-09-22+at+17.36.05.gif)
9. **Configure Redirection**: Copy the redirection link and use it for your email buttons or calls-to-action.

   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155033075820/original/4vYu9m8W_cBmAdBBBKpi4QM4XMNTvp-Eew.png?1726653917)

---

title_en: How to integrate Razorpay within the CRM
source_md:
[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/MhUZJ2Z-j7Q?&wmode=opaque)

Business users are able to process payments via Razorpay, a payment provider popular in India. This integration is available as a marketplace application under App Marketplace menu inside a sub-account and also available upon clicking on the Search for More options inside Payments -> Integrations

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155026996886/original/cGM38lkSCd8himqlO0oJsISt_rPGSvI_eQ.png?1717409062)

The integration provides capabilities to accept one time, custom amounts as well as recurring payments across all channels like order forms, invoices, payment links, forms, contacts page among others. This also provides subscription management like cancellation, updating a card on file or refund related capabilities

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155026996913/original/24M_t65AjM_C10oGXduK3C897S57ED9Jvg.png?1717409084)

Sub-account users will be able to install the application from the App Marketplace, authenticate using the necessary API keys, and grant necessary permissions to start accepting payments using Razorpay.

### 

To successfully connect Razorpay with your system, please follow these four essential steps:

1. **Install the Razorpay App**  
   Navigate to the **App Marketplace** and install the Razorpay application.
2. **Authenticate Using API Keys**  
   Copy your Razorpay API keys from the Razorpay dashboard (`Accounts & Settings → API Keys`) and paste them into the app authentication page.
3. **Configure Webhooks**  
   In your Razorpay dashboard (`Accounts & Settings → Webhooks`), add the following Webhook URL:  
   `https://backend.leadconnectorhq.com/razorpay/webhook`  
   Be sure to enable **all payment-related events** for proper syncing.
4. **Register and Whitelist Your Domain**

   - In your GHL dashboard, go to `Settings → Business Profile → Branded Domain` and register the domain you're using. Make sure to verify and click on update information.
   - Next, log in to your Razorpay dashboard and go to `Accounts & Settings → Business Website Details → Add Additional Website/App Details`.  
     Add the same branded domain here. Razorpay will verify and enable it.

     > **Note**: Razorpay only allows payment acceptance from domains that have been whitelisted on their dashboard.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155026997128/original/t9TZ7tccQzpZRWN43mOia_7L36jxKsgjJA.png?1717409204)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155026997230/original/dPoQMqwLdRm-suaWk-lrOlU8iKKfIcRorw.png?1717409258)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050371865/original/0K6GPMGTrW4t-SZJsA4pnDxEnDfOMM9k5w.png?1753358687)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050371729/original/ZyWe2x3yglTf1I1OQZ4tpWw-MNA6oBHSqw.png?1753358576)

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155050371757/original/9iLBTndWU4xo2kimBb9BS1hPgxMToZjcfw.png?1753358602)

Once the app is installed, the Authentication page would be displayed which would require you to plug in your API keys from the Razorpay dashboard. Navigate to **Accounts & Settings -> API keys**to get the API keys from your Razorpay dashboard.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155026999032/original/3zOKWp0Fvr9avNgbDH-bVS_c2Mnt-LBe4Q.png?1717410595)

For smooth functioning of the integration in fetching the transaction statuses from Razorpay, it is required that you also paste the given link in your razorpay dashboard under Webhooks (**Accounts & Settings -> Webhooks**). Make sure that you select the following webhooks events to not lose out on any feature

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155027000787/original/4a6-JrR2U35cs14zYq_UoWzPW9ivayIGjQ.png?1717411942)

Also, add any branded domain that you are using inside the Razorpay dashboard (**Accounts & Settings -> Business website details**)

The application would in no way differ from the existing payment integrations like Stripe/NMI/[Authorize.net](http://authorize.net/) and would have full capabilities for payments including post purchase automations like automated sales receipts, refunds, payment received and order submitted triggers or giving discounts via coupon codes

**FAQs**  
  
**Q - I have done the integration, but while accepting payment I am getting an email from Razorpay saying - payment attempted on your merchant ID - XXXX from web domain - link.fastpaydirect.com has failed as it is not registered. Please contact risk-notification@razorpay.com for more details.**

**A:** This error occurs because Razorpay restricts payment processing from unregistered or unverified domains. Each merchant ID on Razorpay must be mapped to a whitelisted domain as part of their [website compliance policy](https://razorpay.com/docs/payments/dashboard/account-settings/business-website-details/).

By default, GHL uses **link.fastpaydirect.com** as its branded domain, which is whitelisted only for GHL’s own merchant account. It will not work with your Razorpay keys.

To resolve this, you need to **register your own branded domain** in GHL (as in step 4). Once your domain is connected, Razorpay recognizes it as part of your whitelisted setup, and payments will process successfully.

**Q - Will this Razorpay Integration also work for SaaS mode and Wallet recharges?**A: Although we support SaaS mode and Wallet recharges with Custom Payment Provider (one type if Razorpay) with specific to Razorpay, it will not work. This is because Razorpay doesn't support off-session charging on saved cards via our Integration. Only fixed-duration Subscprtions are supported.

title_en: Word Press Hosting — Search & Replace Tool
source_md:
Make quick, safe, database‑level text updates across your hosted WordPress sites—without third‑party plugins or scripts. HighLevel’s built‑in Search & Replace lets you preview matches, then confidently apply replacements in Live or Staging. Common uses include domain changes after migration, HTTP→HTTPS updates, and bulk URL or email fixes.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Search & Replace tool?](#What-is-the-Search-&-Replace-tool?)
  - [Key Benefits of Search & Replace](#Key-Benefits-of-Search-&-Replace)
  - [Preview Mode (Search‑Only)](#Preview-Mode-(Search%E2%80%91Only))
  - [Replacement Options & Matching Behavior](#Replacement-Options-&-Matching-Behavior)
  - [How To Set Up and Use Search & Replace](#How-To-Set-Up-and-Use-Search-&-Replace)
  - [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
  - [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is the Search & Replace tool?**

Search & Replace is a native WordPress hosting utility in HighLevel that scans your site’s database for a specific string and, optionally, replaces it across supported tables. It’s designed to streamline post‑migration cleanups, link corrections, and other bulk text updates while guiding you through safe, reversible practices such as taking backups and testing in Staging first.

---

## **Key Benefits of Search & Replace**

Understanding how this tool helps ensures you pick the fastest, safest path for wide‑ranging content edits. These benefits focus on reducing risk, saving time, and improving operational consistency across client sites.

- **Native & Secure:**No third‑party plugins or custom scripts required.
- **Preview First:** Run a Search‑only to confirm match counts before replacing.
- **Environment Aware:** Works in Live and Staging to support safe testing.
- **Guided Safety:**Backup reminders and confirmations minimize accidental edits.
- **Fewer Errors:**Consistent, centralized workflow for common maintenance tasks.
- **Time Savings:** Bulk updates beat manual page‑by‑page edits.

---

## **Preview Mode (Search‑Only)**

Previewing lets you validate exactly what will be changed before any data is modified, reducing risk and rework.

- Enter the Search string and choose Search (without Replace) to get a match count.
- Use the count to spot obvious issues (e.g., an unexpectedly high number for a broad string).
- Adjust your search for specificity before committing to a replacement.

---

## **Replacement Options & Matching Behavior**

Understanding matching rules helps you target the right content while avoiding unintended changes.

- Case Sensitivity: Matching respects case to prevent accidental replacements (e.g., HTTP vs http).
- Partial Matches: Standard string matching is supported. Use specific strings to avoid over‑broad changes.
- Tables & Data Safety: The tool is designed to work safely with common WordPress data, including post content and metadata. Extremely sensitive/system fields (like credentials) should not be targeted.
- Regex & Wildcards: Not supported. Aim for precise, literal strings.

---

## **How To Set Up and Use Search & Replace**

Following a consistent setup and execution flow reduces errors and accelerates safe deployments across client sites.

1. Open **Sites** → **WordPress** → Select Site.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062527968/original/gb_euDcpdYK22x4sU4P600F70WkNWOtC5A.png?1768298642)
2. In **Quick Actions**, select **Search & Replace.**  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062528227/original/OFRMMr37pIWa4Ylu6d5V3CrHmg2RiGaEUw.gif?1768298789)
3. Include Search Values, Tables and Replace Values. Click on **Next** to continue.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062540335/original/qaVyR3elk7bcm4HuTTWPhxos0oQ6yiI1PA.png?1768304143)
4. Wait for the completion confirmation. Review the summary and spot‑check several pages/posts.  
     

   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155062540634/original/MGW-bCjoZTm4ycJhYIX9can-EiWnC4OhTw.png?1768304270)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q:Can I undo a replacement?**

Use Backup & Restore to revert to the backup created before running the tool.

**Q: Does the tool support regex or wildcards?**No. Use precise, literal strings for predictable results.

**Q: Will this handle serialized data safely?**The tool is designed for common WordPress data patterns. For complex custom tables or plugins, validate in Staging first.

**Q: Can I limit replacements to specific tables?**Not at this time. Use specific search strings and preview counts to control scope.

**Q: Is matching case‑sensitive?**Yes—case sensitivity helps avoid unintended matches. Enter strings exactly as stored.

**Q: Will it work on Multisite?**Run per site. Network‑wide replacements are not supported in one pass.

**Q: Where can I see who ran a replacement?**  
Check your WordPress Access/Activity/Audit Logs for administrative actions relevant to your site.

**Q: How long does it take?**  
Duration depends on database size and server load. For large sites, run during low‑traffic windows and use Staging first.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [A Guide to Staging Environment Access in WordPress](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000000938)
- [How to Add Domains in the WordPress Dashboard (SSL)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000002547)
- [SSH access for WordPress (WP‑CLI)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005588)
- [Getting Started – Migrate a WordPress Site (LC Migrator)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005070)

title_en: Exporting Email Campaign Data
source_md:
Exporting Email Marketing Data allows users to download email performance metrics directly from the **Email Statistics** dashboard as a CSV file. This makes it easier to analyze campaign performance, share results with stakeholders, and maintain reporting records outside of the platform. Exports can include statistics from campaigns, workflows, and bulk email actions, and download links are securely delivered via email.

[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/afiCZHOkyTM?&wmode=opaque)

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Exporting Email Campaign Data?](#What-is-Exporting-Email-Campaign-Data?)
- [Email Data Export Types](#Email-Data-Export-Types)
- [Recent Exports](#Recent-Exports)
- [How To Export Email Campaign Data](#How-To-Export-Email-Campaign-Data)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Exporting Email Campaign Data?**

Export Email Campaign Data allows users to download email performance statistics from **Email Statistics**dashboard in CSV format. This capability simplifies reporting by letting teams extract campaign performance metrics and analyze them in spreadsheet tools or external reporting systems.

---

## **Email Data Export Types**

HighLevel supports multiple export scopes so users can download the exact set of email statistics needed for reporting or analysis. Each export type corresponds to email activity tracked in the **Email Statistics** dashboard.

| **Export Type** | **Explanation** |
| --- | --- |
| **All Campaigns** | Exports statistics for all email activity visible in Email Statistics, including campaigns, workflows, and bulk sends. |
| **Email Marketing Campaigns Only** | Exports performance metrics for email campaigns created in **Marketing → Emails → Campaigns**. |
| **Workflows Only (Individual Email Action Level)** | Exports performance data for individual email actions within workflows. |
| **Bulk Actions Only** | Exports statistics for emails sent through **Contacts → Bulk Actions**. |

---

## **Recent Exports**

The **Recent Exports** area provides a centralized place to track exported files generated from the Email Statistics dashboard. It helps teams verify that exports were successfully created and allows users to review reporting activity within their location.

Recent exports stores export records for **up to 30 days**, providing visibility into recent reporting requests and making it easier for teams to coordinate reporting tasks.

Information typically displayed in Recent Exports includes:

- Export file name or description
- Export type (Campaigns, Workflows, Bulk Actions, etc.)
- User who requested the export
- Date and time the export was created
- Export status (for example, Completed)

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/TilTTLUXXZMd2SaxHRYH+/Screen+Shot+2026-09-21+at+18.12.15.png)

---

## **How To Export Email Campaign Data**

Exporting email performance data requires no additional configuration once Email Statistics is available for your location. Users can generate exports directly from the Email Statistics dashboard and receive the download link via email.

1. Navigate to **Marketing → Emails** **→****Statistics.**  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/ikg2XdGlMBGS9IZPpIxA+/Screen+Shot+2026-09-21+at+18.16.14.png)
2. **Choose** the **Campaign** **type****, date range** Click the **Export**button**.**  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081456197/original/lB_uY3FcwfkcExU1ghljgrXgYqwFz7LK1A.png?1789996162)
3. Add the **email address(es)** where you want to receive the file and click on **Export**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/7QEmZCFRR428S03pWFcd+/Screen+Shot+2026-09-21+at+18.37.22.png)
4. **Check** your **email** **inbox** for the message containing the **download** link to the exported CSV file.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155066764415/original/-p17Iyb7uDYRkUEodE4ja3QtN769cfxHfQ.png?1773308310)
5. All exports include **key performance metrics** such as deliveries, opens, and clicks.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155066764456/original/UcaIiMcX_bweJhfuooXYqk6ndNo7VAx0Eg.png?1773308333)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: What metrics are included in the export?**

The export includes key email performance metrics available in Email Statistics, such as deliveries, opens, and clicks.

**Q: How do I receive the exported file?**  
As CSV download link to the email address provided when the export request is created.

**Q: How long is the export download link valid?**  
Download links remain valid for **30 days** after the export is generated.

**Q: Can I export workflow email performance?**  
Yes. Workflow exports provide performance data at the **individual email action level** within workflows.

**Q: Does exporting email data affect campaigns or contacts?**  
No. Exporting data is a reporting action only and does not modify campaigns, workflows, contacts, or statistics.

---

With minimal effort, you can deliver a more polished and motivating learning journey.

---

## **What is the Welcome Badge for Courses?**

Welcome Badges are automatically issued credentials that recognize learners as soon as they enroll in a course. This feature is built directly into new course creation in HighLevel, ensuring every learner receives immediate acknowledgment without requiring manual configuration.

Unlike completion certificates or workflow-based badges, Welcome Badges are triggered specifically at the **enrollment stage**, making them the earliest form of recognition in the learner journey. This helps establish engagement from the very beginning while integrating seamlessly with HighLevel’s broader Credentials system.

---

## **Key Benefits of the Welcome Badge for Courses**

Automatic Welcome Badges simplify credential adoption while enhancing the learner experience from the start.

- **Instant learner recognition:** Learners receive a badge immediately upon first enrollment, reinforcing engagement from day one.
- **Default credential adoption:** Every new course includes a Welcome Badge automatically, ensuring consistent usage across your course catalog.
- **Simplified setup experience:** No workflows or manual configuration are required, reducing setup time for course creators.
- **Focused template selection:** A curated set of Welcome Badge templates makes it easy to choose a professional design quickly.
- **Enhanced learner profiles:** Automatically issued badges enrich the learner’s credential history within the Client Portal.

---

## **Welcome Badge Defaults in New Courses**

Welcome Badges are built into the default behavior of newly created courses, allowing creators to deliver recognition without additional configuration.

- Automatically attached to all **newly created courses**
- Issued when a learner **enrolls for the first time**
- Not applied retroactively to **existing courses**
- Does not require workflows or automation setup

---

## **How Welcome Badges Compare to Other Credentials**

Different credential types serve different stages of the learner journey. Understanding these differences helps you design a more complete and engaging experience.

| Credential Type | When It Is Issued | How It Is Triggered | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Welcome Badge | At first enrollment | Automatic (default in new courses) | Recognize and engage learners immediately |
| Completion Certificate | After course completion | Course completion settings | Validate course completion |
| Workflow-issued Badge/Certificate | Based on custom actions | Workflow automation | Reward milestones, quizzes, or custom achievements |

---

## **How To Setup Welcome Badges for Courses**

Welcome Badges require minimal setup because they are automatically included in new courses. You can optionally customize or adjust them based on your needs.

1. Navigate to the Memberships → Courses → Products area and create a new course (a Welcome Badge is automatically added).  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155067088559/original/Dq_uxFDh7_KnMnKtgcTFQ2cb1sNp9y3E9g.png?1773736543)
2. Open the course settings and locate the Welcome Badge section.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155067088726/original/BaiLEj2nh2LnfnSew0zb0cQJesX6splz3A.png?1773736627)
3. Select a template from the five curated Welcome Badge options and save your selection.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155067088879/original/1d2jUfZI5GtmkVSbFv33evqPY2xXbdyU5g.png?1773736697)
4. Go to Memberships → Credentials and edit the badge using the Certificate Builder if you want to customize the design.
5. Set the badge status to Draft in Credentials if you want to disable automatic issuance.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Does the Welcome Badge apply to existing courses?**  
No. It is only automatically added to newly created courses.

**Q: Will learners receive the badge multiple times if they re-enroll?**  
No. The badge is issued only on the first enrollment.

**Q: Can I use other badge templates as Welcome Badges?**  
Yes. Select Badges from My Templates.

**Q: Can I still issue badges using workflows?**  
Yes. Workflow-based badge issuance remains available for advanced or custom scenarios.

**Q: Can I customize the design of Welcome Badges?**  
Yes. All design customization is done in the Credentials (Certificate Builder) area.

**Q: Can I turn the Welcome Badge back on after disabling it?**Yes. Simply change the badge status back to Published.

---

## **Related Articles**

- ## [How to Use Badges in HighLevel's Certificate Builder](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005539-how-to-use-badges-in-certificate-builder)
- [Automate Badge Issuance in Workflows (Using “Issue Certificate” Action)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005887-automate-badge-issuance-in-workflows-using-issue-certificate-action-)

source_md:
[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/DjG\_FBfw5II?&wmode=opaque)

Quickly uncover exactly where your visitors come from—right down to the state and city—so you can focus campaigns where they’ll have the greatest impact.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Geographic Analytics (State & City Drilldown)?](#What-is-Geographic-Analytics-(State-&-City-Drilldown)?)
  - [Key Benefits of Geographic Analytics](#Key-Benefits-of-Geographic-Analytics)
  - [Geographic Dropdown](#Geographic-Dropdown)
  - [Total Visitors and Ranked Lists](#Total-Visitors-and-Ranked-Lists)
  - [Dynamic Heatmap](#Dynamic-Heatmap)
  - [How To Access Geographic Analytics](#How-To-Access-Geographic-Analytics)
  - [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
  - [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Geographic Analytics (State & City Drilldown)?**

Geographic Analytics is an interactive heat-map that visualizes web traffic all the way from country to state to city level. By drilling down, you can identify high-interest pockets within a region, compare performance across different local markets, and fine-tune your marketing strategy in real time. Both map and ranked list update the moment you change the dropdown—no manual reload required. This live experience is ideal for meetings or screen shares where insights have to appear the second you need them.

---

## **Key Benefits of Geographic Analytics**

Use this feature to turn raw location data into actionable insights:

- **Hyper-Local Targeting:**Zero in on top-performing cities to run geo-focused ads and promotions.
- **Smarter Budget Allocation:**Shift ad spend toward states generating the most engaged visits.
- **Campaign****Comparison:**Measure regional lift after launching location-based offers.
- **Faster Decisions:**Live refresh keeps maps and ranked lists updated without page reloads.
- **Unified View:** All visitor counts, maps, and rankings live in one dashboard for easy reporting.

---

## **Geographic Dropdown**

Switch between Country, State, and City with a single selector to instantly change the heat-map and ranked list. This dropdown removes extra clicks and keeps your workflow focused on insight rather than navigation.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155054958863/original/4d5vm1E2Ikj3ekdrF4v0nqCphxTJGRF0_A.png?1759253656)

---

## **Total Visitors and Ranked Lists**

Each drill-down level includes a side-panel list that automatically ranks the top regions by visit count. The list updates in real time as you change levels, making it effortless to spot your highest-traffic areas at a glance.

A running total of all visits for the selected drill-down level stays visible above the map. As you move from state to city, the total refreshes automatically so you always know the full audience size you’re analyzing.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155054958904/original/zPTCcxaeoCRC-J9l0URJHsKBnFWHB8bSKQ.png?1759253710)

---

## **Dynamic Heatmap**

Colors on the map deepen as traffic increases, giving you a quick visual cue of hotspots without digging through spreadsheets. Move your cursor across the map to reveal precise visitor numbers for each state or city. Tooltips appear immediately, saving you from scrolling the side list when you need a quick figure.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155054959006/original/OeLi2nCmC6ltUsUXPyFAvVo4V2oT182VJA.png?1759253900)

---

## **How To Access Geographic Analytics**

Geographic Analytics works out of the box for any sub-account within the Sites Analytics page. Follow these steps to start exploring your data:

#### **Step 1:**Navigate to Analytics

- From your sub-account dashboard, use the left-side navigation bar to go to **Sites**
- Select the **Analytics** tab from the top navigation ribbon

#### **Step 2:** View Geographic Analytics card

Scroll down to the Geographic Analytics card (located beneath Page Views). From here you can:

- Use the drill-down dropdown (Country / State / City) above the map to choose your level.
- Hover any shaded region to see its visitor count.
- Review the ranked list on the right to compare top locations.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155054959809/original/vMOCFKs4B2t3vAyzGOn5R3FkNpjDKpAA-Q.png?1759254283)

#### **Step 3:**Use Data

Apply insights—such as shifting ad spend or creating localized landing pages—to maximize regional results.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Do I need to add any extra tracking scripts to see state and city data?**

No. If Sites Analytics is already capturing page views, Geographic Analytics will automatically populate.

**Q: Is the heat-map data available in real time?**

Visitor counts update as new sessions are recorded, so the map refreshes automatically without a full page reload.

**Q: Does this include both Funnels and Websites?**  
The view follows your Analytics context (e.g., Funnels, Websites, or Both) and date range, so results reflect the scope you select on the Analytics page.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Analytics for Top Countries in Funnel Analytics](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004967)
- [How to Use Site and Funnel Analytics in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003094)
- [Online Listings Analytics Dashboard](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005667)

title_en: Custom Values in WordPress
source_md:
[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/336\_cad\_TEc?&wmode=opaque)

The **Custom Values integration** in the LC WordPress Plugin lets you display live HighLevel data inside WordPress pages or posts using shortcodes. It brings the same personalization used in funnels, emails, and automations directly to WordPress—no coding or complex setup required.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What Are Custom Values in WordPress?](#What-Are-Custom-Values-in-WordPress?)
- [Key Benefits](#Key-Benefits%E2%80%8B)
- [Native Sync with HighLevel](#Native-Sync-with-HighLevel)
- [Using Shortcodes in WordPress](#Using-Shortcodes-in-WordPress)
- [Custom Value Manager (WP Admin)](#Custom-Value-Manager-(WP-Admin)%E2%80%8B)
- [Dynamic Rendering and Page Output](#Dynamic-Rendering-and-Page-Output)
- [Setup Steps](#Setup-Steps)
- [FAQ](#FAQ)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles%E2%80%8B)

---

## **What Are Custom Values in WordPress?**

Custom Values in WordPress sync the *key:value* pairs from your HighLevel sub-account (system and custom) and make them available as WordPress shortcodes.

When a visitor loads a page, the plugin automatically pulls the latest data—keeping your content current without manual edits.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055562835/original/IEUOx-L1w_JNUDMJSTd6AzdFhvfLTXBE0A.png?1759961095)

---

## **Key Benefits**

- **Omnichannel consistency:** Use the same data in automations, emails, and websites.
- **Real-time updates:** Change a value once in HighLevel—WordPress updates instantly.
- **No-code setup:** Paste a shortcode instead of editing code.
- **Reusable templates:** Build client sites with placeholders that auto-fill on sync.
- **Seamless integration:** WordPress becomes part of your HighLevel ecosystem.

---

## **Native Sync with HighLevel**

The LC Plugin connects your WordPress site to your HighLevel sub-account through secure OAuth. Once authorized, it:

- Fetches all system and user-defined Custom Values.
- Stores them locally for quick access.
- Resyncs automatically every 12 hours (manual **Sync Now** also available).

This ensures your WordPress data always mirrors your HighLevel account without manual syncing.

---

## **Using Shortcodes in WordPress**

Shortcodes let you dynamically display live data anywhere inside your WordPress content—page builders, blocks, or classic posts.

**Syntax:**

```
[hl_custom_value name="custom_values.your_key"]
```

**Example:**

```
Wish You a Very [hl_custom_value name="custom_values.festive_greeting"]
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055562839/original/N08SHblr1WdL7Yy4LhsF4AQ5bmm3xjOsaA.png?1759961130)

You can use shortcodes in **Elementor, Divi, Bricks, Beaver Builder, Gutenberg, or the Classic Editor**—any builder that supports native WordPress shortcodes.

---

## **Custom Value Manager (WP Admin)**

Inside WordPress, open the HighLevel Custom Values section to view and manage your synced keys.

Here you can:

- View each synced Custom Value and its current data.
- Copy shortcodes in one click.
- Trigger a manual resync or enable automatic syncing.
- Filter by folders matching your HighLevel structure.

This makes it easy to organize and access all synced data directly within your WordPress dashboard.

---

## **Dynamic Rendering and Page Output**

When a visitor opens a page, the LC Plugin renders the Custom Value in real time.

If caching plugins are used, stale data may appear unless proper cache rules are applied.

**Best Practices:**

- Enable **“Purge cache on resync”** if caching is active.
- Avoid caching pages that display contact-specific values.
- Always resync after updating values in HighLevel.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155055562869/original/WKGPdC6c-hXDD7rPHW9xvTsOChaDHjGJZw.png?1759961240)

---

## **Setup Steps**

To connect your WordPress site with HighLevel, make sure you’re using LC Plugin version 3.5.0 or higher. In your WordPress Admin, open the HighLevel settings and select Connect Account, then authorize your HighLevel login. Choose the appropriate sub-account and grant access. Once connected, the plugin will automatically sync and display a confirmation message stating Connected to LeadConnector.

After the sync completes, open the Custom Values section in HighLevel to confirm that your data has been imported. You can then copy a shortcode and place it within any page or post using your preferred builder. When published, your WordPress content will dynamically display the synced HighLevel data in real time.

---

## **FAQ**

**Does it support contact-level values?**

Yes—if the visitor is tracked via cookie or URL parameter.  
  
**Will it slow my site?**

No. Values are cached locally and refreshed only during sync operations.  
  
**Can I connect multiple sub-accounts?**

Each WordPress install can connect to one sub-account. Use multisite for multiple clients.

**What if a value is deleted in HighLevel?**

It appears blank until you resync or replace it.

**Who can authorize connections?**

Only HighLevel users with API access to the sub-account can connect WordPress.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [How to Use Custom Values](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001161575)
- [Overview of Merge Fields & Custom Variables](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004390)
- [Workflow Action – Update Custom Values](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003353)
- [LC WordPress Plugin Overview](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005560)
- [WordPress Plugin & Theme Management](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001231547)

---

title_en: Workflow Action - Send Invoice
source_md:
Automate invoice delivery directly from your HighLevel workflows. This action sends a one‑time invoice via email, SMS, or both using your selected invoice template and payment mode. This article shows how to setup and use the Send Invoice Action in HighLevel workflows

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Send Invoice workflow action?](#What-is-the-Send-Invoice-workflow-action?)
- [Key Benefits of Send Invoice Action](#Key-Benefits-of-Send-Invoice-Action)
- [Prerequisites](#Prerequisites)
- [How to Setup the Send Invoice Action in Workflows](#How-to-Setup-the-Send-Invoice-Action-in-Workflows)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is the Send Invoice workflow action?**

The Send Invoice action creates and delivers a one‑time invoice to the contact when a workflow reaches this step. This action connects your invoice templates with workflow automation so billing happens consistently and on time. Choose which template to send, who it comes from, and which channel(s) to use. Use Live mode for real payments and Test mode for non‑chargeable, sandbox validation.

---

## **Key Benefits of Send Invoice Action**

- **Faster collections**: trigger invoices at the exact stage (won deal, form submit, onboarding step) without manual work.
- **Consistency**: ensure every invoice uses the correct template, branding, and taxes.
- **Flexibility**: choose Email, SMS, or both, and select a specific template for each scenario.
- **Observability**: monitor workflow execution and payment status to keep teams aligned.
- **Testing safely**: validate flows using **Test** mode before charging customers.

---

## **Prerequisites**

Preparing the account avoids common setup errors and ensures invoices send successfully from day one.

- **Permissions**: Users configuring workflows should have sufficient sub‑account permissions to edit workflows and access Payments/Invoices. See **User Roles & Permissions (Sub‑Account)**.
- **At least one invoice template**: Create or confirm templates are available. See **Create Invoice Templates & Automatically Send via Workflow**.
- **Payments gateway connected**: Ensure your gateway is connected and ready for **Live** transactions (or supports **Test** if you are validating flows).
- **Contact data**: The contact must have the required delivery channel(s): a valid **Email** and/or **Phone** number depending on your selection.

---

## **How to Setup the Send Invoice Action in Workflows**

Follow these steps to add the action to a workflow and configure it for consistent, predictable outcomes.

1. Log in to your sub-account.
2. Go to **Automations > Workflows**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/Cnveqtr2TxPJeI2Wif1E+/Screen+Shot+2026-01-05+at+6.02.58+PM.png)
3. Create a **new** **workflow** or **open** an **existing** one.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/vy9UlWTok3ZfxkZZpVLC+/Screen+Shot+2026-01-05+at+6.04.41+PM.png)
4. Click on the **+ Add New Trigger** button to add a **trigger** that correlates to the Send Invoice Action (e.g., *Pipeline Stage Changed, Opportunity Status Changed etc.*)   
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/PtwtGdOv9hNooZgtS8dh+/GIF+Recording+2026-02-11+at+9.11.24+PM.gif)
5. Click **+** to **add** an **Action** and search for **Send Invoice**.   
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/WKwaE4BxXc1Kw72d0esU+/GIF+Recording+2026-02-11+at+9.14.35+PM.gif)
6. Select **From** **User** and **Invoice** **Template**.
7. Select **Payment** **Mode** - Use **Live** mode for real payments and **Test** mode for non‑chargeable, sandbox validation.
8. Select **Channel:**Choose how the invoice is delivered **Email**, **Text**, or Email & Text. **Default:** Email & Text.
9. Click on **Save Action**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/x0GWesk6cx2zpf7kJlf2+/Screenshot+2026-02-11+at+9.16.50%E2%80%AFPM.png)
10. **Test** the **workflow** to make sure everything is setup correctly. **Publish** and **Save** the workflow.  
      
    ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/acrY52YGL0xqo8pDiF3Z+/Screen+Shot+2026-02-11+at+9.24.32+PM.png)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: What’s the difference between Live and Test modes?**

Live creates a payable invoice using your connected gateway. Test is intended for dry‑runs and link validation without charging. Gateway test behavior can vary—validate before relying on results.

**Q: What happens if I choose Email & SMS but the contact only has email?**  
Only Email will be sent in this scenario. The message can only be delivered via available channels. Ensure the contact record has the needed fields (email and/or phone) before enabling both. 

**Q: Do I need to pick a template every time?**  
It’s best practice to explicitly select a template in the action. If you rely on a default, verify which template is set as default in the Invoices module to avoid surprises.

**Q: Where do I track whether the invoice was sent or paid?**  
Check the **Execution Logs** for the Send Invoice step and **Payments → Invoices** for invoice status (e.g., Sent, Viewed, Paid).

**Q: Can I trigger different templates based on conditions?**

Yes. Branch your workflow with conditions and add separate **Send Invoice** actions, each pointing to the appropriate template.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [Getting Started — Create & Send Invoices](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005075)
- [How to Create Invoices in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001208702)
- [Customizing Invoice Layouts](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006789)
- [How to Send Recurring Invoices Using Workflows](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005627)

title_en: Copy Workflow Actions Across Workflows
source_md:
Experience faster, more consistent workflow building with the ability to **Copy Workflow Actions Across Workflows** in HighLevel. Reuse single actions or entire action blocks across workflows in the same sub-account, paste with a click, and maintain standardized setups—no rebuilding required.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Copy Workflow Actions Across Workflows?](#What-is-Copy-Workflow-Actions-Across-Workflows?)
- [Key Benefits of Copy Workflow Actions Between Workflows](#Key-Benefits-of-Copy-Workflow-Actions-Between-Workflows)
- [How To Use Copy Workflow Actions Between Workflows](#How-To-Use-Copy%C2%A0Workflow%C2%A0Actions-Between-Workflows)
- [Clipboard & Retention Rules](#Clipboard-&-Retention-Rules)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Copy Workflow Actions Across Workflows?**

Copying actions between workflows lets you **duplicate existing steps**—either a single action or a sequence—into another workflow in the same sub-account. This accelerates building, reduces repetitive configuration, and helps maintain consistent automation standards across projects.

---

## **Key Benefits of Copy Workflow Actions Between Workflows**

- **Speed:** Paste preconfigured steps in seconds instead of rebuilding from scratch.
- **Multi-paste window:** Reuse copied actions across multiple workflows during the **15-minute** clipboard window.
- **Consistency:** Keep naming, settings, and logic uniform across workflows to reduce errors.
- **Cross-tab convenience:** Copy in one tab and paste in another without losing your place.
- **Same sub-account scope:** Ensure compatibility because assets exist in the same environment.
- **Lower error risk:** Start from proven steps and tweak only what’s unique.

---

## **How To Use Copy****Workflow****Actions Between Workflows**

These steps outline where to click and how to paste efficiently so you can reuse existing logic with minimal rework.

**Step 1:**Open **Automation → Workflows : to find the Copy Option Feature**

Select your source workflow, and locate the action you want to reuse. Click the action’s three-dot menu and choose Copy Action (single step) or Copy All Actions From Here (selects a block starting at that action).

***![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155052094641/original/fn5HsFGRNeAtjoG4W5R-med1BeXisJdtUw.png?1755785648)***

**Step 2:**Navigate to your **target workflow** (same tab or a different tab within the same sub-account).

To paste,**either:**

Click **Quick Paste** next to the **+** button where you add new actions

*![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155052094723/original/m54deH56wAwIcqEEVybb_sibNN9X8xxEpg.png?1755785705)*

**OR** Open any action’s **three-dot** menu and choose **Paste Below**.

*![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155052795534/original/CKIGsJ1Ic1ggf5D0RB629-ODjMzTzT7mXw.png?1756721355)*

**Step 3**: Review the pasted actions to confirm assets and logic are correct, then **Save** your workflow.

*****![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155052116340/original/jPTujJ_4cupbqbaoGsySSOEiCIAB5za8ng.png?1755796215)*****

---

## **Clipboard & Retention Rules**

- Copied actions remain available to paste for **15 minutes**.
- You can paste multiple times during the retention window—even into different workflows within the same sub-account.
- When the window expires, the paste options will no longer insert the copied content; copy again to continue working.
- Navigating between tabs is supported; just ensure you remain signed in and within the same sub-account.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I copy multiple actions at once?**  
Yes. Use **Copy All Actions From Here** to copy a block starting at the selected action.

**Q: Can I paste in another tab?**  
Yes. Copy in one tab and paste in another tab within the same sub-account during the **15-minute** window.

**Q: Are triggers copied?**  
No. Copying actions doesn’t include triggers. Use trigger duplication tools when you need to reuse triggers.

**Q: Will asset references (emails, forms, calendars) carry over?**  
If those assets exist in the same sub-account, the references persist. Always review after pasting.

**Q: How long are copied actions available?**  
**15 minutes.** You can paste multiple times during this window without copying again.

**Q: Can I undo a paste?**  
Before saving, you can delete or move the pasted actions. Confirm placement and settings, then save.

**Q: Does this work across sub-accounts?**  
No. Action copy works **within the same sub-account**. For cross-sub-account needs, see the related article on copying entire workflows.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Workflow Builder Walkthrough](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001254-workflow-builder-walkthrough)
- [Getting Started with Workflows](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002288-getting-started-with-workflows)
- [A List of Workflow Actions](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000002294-a-list-of-workflow-actions)
- [Copy or Delete Triggers in Workflows](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000005370-copy-or-delete-triggers-in-workflows)
