title_en: Internationalization For Client-Portal & Child Apps
source_md:
[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/sQyOFQKIVBg?&wmode=opaque)

This article explains how to change the display language in the Client Portal and Child App. With support for multiple languages on both web and mobile platforms, users can manage their experience in their preferred language.

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Language Internationalization?](#What-is-Language-Internationalization?)
- [Key Benefits of Language Internationalization](#Key-Benefits-of-Language-Internationalization)
- [Set a Default Language (Admin)](#Set-a-Default-Language-(Admin))
- [How to Change Language on the Web (Users/Clients)](#How-to-Change-Language-on-the-Web-(Users/Clients))
- [How to Change Language on Mobile App](#How-to-Change-Language-on-Mobile-App)
- [Supported Languages](#Supported-Languages)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)
- [Next Steps](#Next-Steps)

---

## **What is Language Internationalization?**

Language internationalization allows users to access the Client Portal and Child App in their preferred language. This functionality improves usability for non-English-speaking users and provides a localized experience across regions. Client Portal admins can also set a default language for all portal users. Users can still override the default from their own account settings on both web and mobile platforms. If no language is selected at the admin or user level, the portal uses English.

## **Key Benefits of Language Internationalization**

Language customization enhances usability and ensures a more accessible experience for users around the world.

- Available on both web and mobile versions of the Client Portal and Child App
- Supports 12 languages across multiple global regions
- Admins can set a default language for all Client Portal users
- Improves accessibility for non-English-speaking users
- Language changes are quick and user-specific
- Allows clients to manage settings in their native language
- Default fallback to English if no language is selected

---

## **Set a Default Language (Admin)**

Use this when you want all Client Portal users to see the same language on the login page and across the portal experience.

1. Go to Memberships → ClientPortal → Settings → Language Settings  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155063054806/original/Cjl9IIqShgK2vnsVVnQ78oBfkmTsBntyFw.png?1768910061)
2. Select a language.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155063054891/original/b-mfpa8o0_sv5y2frWoV--pI5_a9-p_Xew.png?1768910118)
3. Click Save. Now user can see language change on login page as well on web  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155063055411/original/phJzI_eEfjLuyanW5Yzs0XgA2nLb71zz8g.png?1768910380)  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155063055303/original/djhoE13fw6ZumYoD_76yOyffMnQXexC4mg.png?1768910326)

---

## **How to Change Language on the Web (Users/Clients)**

Language preferences can be changed after logging in the Client Portal.  
Navigate to **Memberships → Client Portal** to login into the Portal **OR** Login directly from the Client Portal URL.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155046796710/original/kG2AXbYNNnknefEyR0HqZ4ELcIXgx1kvqg.gif?1747483477)

**Steps to change language:**

1. Click on your logo on the top right side and click on**Manage your Account.**  
     
   **![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155046796853/original/tfJGTmozjpQ4SGxhxOQfSfIbWfQTX_PuiQ.png?1747483819)**
2. Under Manage Account, select **Language Settings**and choose your preferred language from the dropdown menu.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155046796976/original/gRSlkZmvSH6aD1Gnd8W8KvIufLTYJVFPIQ.gif?1747484034)

---

## **How to Change Language on Mobile App**

Users accessing the app through a mobile device can also update their language settings with just a few taps.

**Steps to change language on mobile:**

1. Tap **Profile** on the bottom navigation bar.
2. Go to **Settings**.
3. Tap **Language Settings**.
4. Select the desired language from the list.
5. Tap **Save** to apply the update.

---

## **Supported Languages**

The following languages are currently supported for both web and mobile platforms:

| Language | Region |
| --- | --- |
| German | DE |
| Spanish | ES |
| French (Canada) | CA |
| French (France) | FR |
| Dutch | NL |
| Portuguese (Portugal) | PT |
| Portuguese (Brazil) | BR |
| Italian | IT |
| Swedish | SE |
| Finnish | FI |
| Norwegian | NO |

**Note**: **English** is the default language and will be used if no other selection is made.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Does the language change apply instantly?**  
Yes, once saved, the new language is applied immediately.

**Q: Can I switch languages more than once?**  
Yes, you can change your language setting at any time.

**Q: What if a feature isn't fully translated?**  
In cases where translations are unavailable, the interface will default to English.

**Q: Is there a way to set a default language for all new users?**  
Go to Memberships → ClientPortal → Settings → Language Settings, select a language, and click Save. This default applies to the /login page and the Client Portal web experience for all users.

---

### **Related Article****s**

- How to Access the Client Portal
- Setting Up Your Client Portal
- Mobile App: Getting Started Guide
- Managing User Profiles

title_en: Understanding Default Phone Preferences for New Sub-Accounts
source_md:
[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/XDapesMlrjY?&wmode=opaque)

When creating new sub-accounts, certain settings are pre-applied to streamline the setup process. These settings ensure that sub-accounts are configured optimally from the start, reducing manual adjustments. However, users can modify them at any time to better suit their operations.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What are Default Phone Preferences for New Sub-Accounts?](#What-are-Default-Phone-Preferences-for-New-Sub-Accounts?)
  - [Key Benefits of Default Phone Preferences](#Key-Benefits-of-Default-Phone-Preferences)
  - [How to Modifying These Settings](#How-to-Modifying-These-Settings)
  - [Understanding Default Preferences](#Understanding-Default-Preferences%C2%A0)
    - [1. Automatically Link Phone System](#1.-Automatically-Link-Phone-System)
    - [2. Allow Sub-Account Users to Submit A2P Registration if Re-Billing is Disabled](#2.-Allow-Sub-Account-Users-to-Submit-A2P-Registration-if-Re-Billing-is-Disabled)
    - [3. Automatically Enable Number Intelligence](#3.-Automatically-Enable-Number-Intelligence)
    - [4. Messaging Limit](#4.-Messaging-Limit)
  - [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
  - [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What are Default Phone Preferences for New Sub-Accounts?**

Default phone preferences are agency-level settings that determine how specific LC Phone features are configured when a new sub-account is created. Setting these preferences in advance helps agencies establish a consistent starting configuration across new sub-accounts while reducing the need to configure the same phone settings individually after account creation.

Agency admins can manage these preferences from the **Account Creation** area under **Agency Settings > Phone Integration**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155079846492/original/_swJWbgsqccIVcbCb6LKeNFQ7xM-ZPpaWA.png?1788290204)

---

## **Key Benefits of Default Phone Preferences**

- **Consistent onboarding:** Apply standardized phone preferences when new sub-accounts are created instead of configuring the same defaults repeatedly.
- **Phone system provisioning:** Control whether the HighLevel phone system is automatically linked to newly created sub-accounts.
- **A2P registration access:** Determine whether sub-account users can submit A2P registration when phone re-billing is disabled.
- **Number Intelligence defaults:** Decide whether Number Intelligence is automatically enabled for new sub-accounts.
- **Messaging controls:** Establish the messaging model that newly created sub-accounts begin with based on the agency's available messaging configuration.

---

## **How to Modifying These Settings**

Users can adjust these preferences anytime based on their operational requirements. To make changes:

1. Login to your **Agency Account** and click on **Settings**.
2. Click on **Phone Integration.**
3. Click on the **Account Creation** tab.
4. Update the settings based on your needs.

![](https://jumpshare.com/v/Ud5qR0inohQFsF58Yto9+/GIF+Recording+2025-06-13+at+8.15.17+PM.gif)

---

## **Understanding Default Preferences**

### **1. Automatically Link Phone System**

Pre-enabled by default

This setting ensures that new sub-accounts are automatically connected to the phone system. It provides instant access to messaging and voice services, eliminating the need for manual setup.

### **2. Allow Sub-Account Users to Submit A2P Registration if Re-Billing is Disabled**

By default, sub-accounts can only submit A2P (Application-to-Person) registration if re-billing is enabled. Enabling this option allows users to submit A2P registration even when re-billing is disabled. (Optional setting)

### **3. Automatically Enable Number Intelligence**

This feature provides enhanced phone number intelligence by:

- Validating numbers before sending the first SMS
- Detecting incoming spam calls
- Looking up the names of unknown callers before answering

Enabling this setting improves the efficiency and reliability of phone communication. (Optional setting)

### **4. Messaging Limit**

The **Messaging Limit** applies to all newly created sub-accounts. The selected limit determines the messaging capacity for new sub-accounts, ensuring compliance with usage policies.

- **Current Limit:** Messaging Ramp (default setting)
- Users can modify this setting as needed.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Will changing these default phone preferences update my existing sub-accounts?**  
No. These preferences are intended to establish defaults during new sub-account creation.

**Q: Does enabling A2P registration access mean the sub-account is automatically registered?**  
No. Allowing submission gives eligible sub-account users access to initiate the registration process. A2P registration still requires the applicable business, Brand, and Campaign information and must complete the required registration process.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [What is LC - Phone System?](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001223546)
- [Moving US numbers from Twilio to LeadConnector(LC)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001240108)
- [Migrating International Numbers(Twilio to LC Phone)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005131)
- [Moving Phone Numbers from LC Phone to Twilio (US & International)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001240107)
- [How to Disable LC Phone System for Subaccount/Location (LC to Twilio)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/48001231698)

title_en: SMS Templates (Snippets) - Overview
source_md:
Conversations • SMS • Snippets

Create and Use SMS Snippets in HighLevel

SMS Snippets let you save frequently used text messages and reuse them instead of rewriting the same content. In HighLevel, reusable SMS content is created as a Text Snippet and can include supported personalization. This guide explains how to create, manage, and use SMS Snippets in Conversations and workflows.

What You'll Learn

Learn how to create a Text Snippet for SMS, organize saved messages, insert Snippets into Conversations, and reuse SMS content in a Send SMS workflow action.

Important

Reusable SMS content is created as a **Text Snippet**. The current HiRise Snippets experience is automatically enabled, and users accessing Snippets through Conversations need **View & Manage Conversations** access.

# What Are SMS Snippets?

SMS Snippets are reusable Text Snippets for messages you send frequently. They help teams reuse approved SMS content while still allowing the message to be reviewed or edited before sending.

Common uses include:

- Appointment reminders
- Lead follow-ups
- Support responses
- Business hours or contact information
- Promotional messages

## Key Benefits of SMS Snippets

SMS Snippets reduce repetitive typing and make commonly used messages easier for teams to find, personalize, and reuse.

- **Save Time:** Reuse frequently sent SMS content instead of rewriting it.
- **Improve Consistency:** Give team members standardized messaging for common situations.
- **Personalize Messages:** Add supported Custom Values for dynamic contact or account information.
- **Stay Organized:** Use folders, search, and management controls to maintain your Snippet library.
- **Support Automation:** Reuse saved content when configuring supported Send SMS workflow actions.

## Prerequisites and Limitations

Using the correct Snippet type and confirming user access helps ensure reusable SMS content is available where your team needs it.

- Create reusable SMS content as a **Text Snippet**.
- Snippets are managed within the relevant **Sub-Account**.
- Users accessing Snippets through Conversations need **View & Manage Conversations** access.
- The HiRise Snippets page is automatically enabled; no Labs setting is required.
- RCS Snippets and WhatsApp Templates use separate messaging experiences.
- SMS length can affect message segments and sending cost.

## How To Create and Manage an SMS Snippet

Create SMS content as a Text Snippet so it can be saved, organized, and quickly reused by your team.

1. From the **Sub-Account View**, go to **Conversations**.
2. Select **Snippets**.
3. Click **+ New Snippet**.
4. Select **Add Text Snippet**.
5. Enter a descriptive name and message.
6. Add supported **Custom Values** when personalization is needed.
7. Review the message, character count, and SMS segment information.
8. Click **Save**.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081372963/original/S_yOTsXrjsVgjrC3dxCM5gMTlhz5C7QOcQ.png?1789859142)

**Alternate Access:** Snippets can also be accessed from **Marketing → Snippets**.

### Organize and Update Snippets

Keeping your Snippet library organized makes approved messages easier to find and reduces the chance of outdated content being reused.

- Use **Search** to find Snippets by name or keyword.
- Use **New Folder** to group related messages.
- Use the **three-dot menu (⋮)** to move, edit, duplicate, or delete a Snippet.

## How To Use an SMS Snippet in Conversations

Inserting a Snippet into Conversations quickly populates prepared SMS content while still allowing you to review and edit the message before sending.

1. Go to **Conversations** and open the contact conversation.
2. Select the appropriate text messaging channel.
3. Click the **Snippets** icon in the message composer.
4. Search for or select the Text Snippet you want to use.
5. Review the populated message and dynamic information.
6. Make any necessary edits.
7. Send the message.

## How To Use SMS Content in Workflows

The Send SMS workflow action includes a Templates selector that can populate the message with saved reusable content, helping keep automated messages consistent.

1. Go to **Automation → Workflows**.
2. Open or create a workflow.
3. Add or open a **Send SMS** action.
4. Locate **Templates**.
5. Select the reusable message you want to use.
6. Review the populated message and personalization.
7. Use **Send test SMS** when you want to verify the message.
8. Save the action and test the workflow.
9. Publish the workflow when it is ready.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155081372940/original/7_14ogYLVNU8pgRfa866_s7_11DuknZLhA.png?1789859054)

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Are SMS Snippets and Text Snippets the same thing?

Reusable SMS content is created as a **Text Snippet**. Some areas may refer to saved reusable content as Templates.

Q: Can I personalize an SMS Snippet?

Yes. Text Snippets support Custom Values and other supported dynamic content for personalization.

Q: Can I edit a Snippet after inserting it into a Conversation?

Yes. Review and edit the populated message before sending it.

Q: Can I organize SMS Snippets into folders?

Yes. Use **New Folder** from the Snippets page and move related Snippets into the appropriate folder.

Q: Can I test an SMS before publishing a workflow?

Yes. The Send SMS action includes a Test Phone Number field and **Send test SMS** option.

Q: Are RCS Snippets the same as SMS Snippets?

No. RCS Snippets use a separate creation and sending experience designed for RCS-specific message formats and features.

title_en: Getting Started with Reviews AI Agents
source_md:
With Reviews AI Agents, you can create personalized AI personalities that automatically respond to reviews based on tone, sentiment, and style preferences. This guide will walk you through setting up your AI Agents, assigning them smartly, customizing their behavior, and ensuring brand consistency across all your customer interactions.

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [How To Configure Reviews AI Agent](#How-To-Configure-Reviews-AI-Agent)
  - [Step 1: Access the Reviews AI Settings](#Step-1%3A-Access-the-Reviews-AI-Settings)
  - [Step 2: Create or Select an AI Agent](#Step-2%3A-Create-or-Select-an-AI-Agent)
  - [Step 3: Set Assignment Rules for AI Agents](#Step-3%3A-Set-Assignment-Rules-for-AI-Agents)
  - [Step 4: Configure Language Detection](#Step-4%3A-Configure-Language-Detection)
  - [Step 5: Select Google Business Pages (Optional)](#Step-5%3A-Select-Google-Business-Pages-(Optional))
  - [Step 6: Manage and Test AI Agents](#Step-6%3A-Manage-and-Test-AI-Agents)
  - [Best Practices for Using Reviews AI Agents](#Best-Practices-for-Using-Reviews-AI-Agents)

---

[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/KaTV\_bvRTTU?&wmode=opaque)

---

## **How To Configure Reviews AI Agent**

### 

### **Step 1: Access the Reviews AI Settings**

- Go to the **Reputation Management** module inside your account.
- Click on **Settings**.
- Navigate to the **Reviews AI** tab.
- Here you will find the section to create and manage your AI Agents.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155045757887/original/BmMNwYY1jy0mBB4ci2MqwrZiRLiQzrTT5A.png?1745836397)

### **Step 2: Create or Select an AI Agent**

- Click **Create Agent**.
- You can either **create from scratch** by setting tone, style, and traits manually or **use a ready-made template**
- Available settings include:  
    
  - **Agent Name** - Keep a friendly name to your agent. Helps you track performance/ review quality.
  - **Tone** - Friendly, Professional, Empathetic, etc.
  - **Prompt**- Give a concise prompt to your Agent

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082843239/original/nUHQ1Yw4i_yjzTITQpm8rjIaa_ikhZw0Jg.png?1791459706)

```
You can quickly enable all pre-built AI Agents by selecting "Create Starter Agents", allowing you to start using templated personalities without building them individually.
```

### **Step 3: Set Assignment Rules for AI Agents**

- Assign AI Agents based on **Review Sentiment** (Positive, Neutral, Negative).
- Enable **Round Robin Assignment** if you want different agents to rotate automatically for variety.

### **Step 4: Configure Language Detection**

- AI automatically detects the review’s language.
- Set a **Fallback Language** in case the review language cannot be detected.

### **Step 5: Select Google Business Pages (Optional)**

- Assign AI Agents to specific **Google Business Pages**.
- Useful for managing responses across multiple brands or locations

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155045758725/original/c-q7EwNAHxXNq9C4LDDSZ9vF_yoRLgt43Q.png?1745837023)  
  

### **Step 6: Manage and Test AI Agents**

- You can **Edit**, **Clone**, or **Delete** AI Agents anytime.
- Preview AI-generated responses before publishing.
- Easily view which Agent crafted each review reply inside the Reputation Management view.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082844279/original/tG7K1MCok4Ce74UVAmRKGBk42hK9BSvCEQ.png?1791460175)

**Preview AI Responses Before Saving**

Use the live response preview to review how the AI Agent may respond before you save your configuration. Preview examples are available for:

- Positive reviews
- Neutral reviews
- Negative reviews

Regenerate the preview as you adjust the agent’s tone, prompt, Brand Voice, and other supported settings. This helps you review response style and consistency before using the configuration for customer review responses.

[Screenshot: Reviews AI Agent Live Response Preview showing positive, neutral, and negative review examples.]

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155082844014/original/44Ow8bbiUQlsh9fdw5bT0nyw354Gu8HEuA.png?1791460062)

---

## **Best Practices for Using Reviews AI Agents**

- **Set clear tone and style** to match your brand voice.
- **Differentiate sentiment handling** for positive, neutral, and negative reviews.
- **Keep response instructions simple** and specific.
- **Personalize responses** with business names or locations if applicable.
- **Preview responses** regularly to ensure tone and content match expectations.

- **Configure Brand Voice before publishing:** Set the response perspective, business name, tone, length, and sign-off preferences so generated replies stay consistent with your brand.

- **Use Quality Guardrails for safer responses:** Enable the available controls to reduce repeated openings and potentially risky language.

- **Preview different review sentiments:** Review positive, neutral, and negative response examples before saving the agent configuration.

- **Use human review for sensitive situations:** Enable sensitive-review holds when you want additional oversight before higher-risk responses are published.

You’re now ready to create and manage your Reviews AI Agents for more personalized, consistent, and automated review responses.

```
Note: Reviews AI Agents are available based on user permissions. If you don’t see options to create or edit agents, ask an admin to enable the Manage Reviews AI Agents permission for your role.
```

## Feature 1 - Configuring Searchable Fields for Your Organization

title_en: Locale-Based Currency Formatting in E-Commerce Stores
source_md:
Locale-Based Currency Formatting in HighLevel ensures that your store prices display in a format familiar to each visitor based on their region and language. This article explains how the feature works, how to enable it, and how it impacts price display across your store. By automatically adjusting separators, decimals, and currency symbol placement, your store delivers a more localized and intuitive shopping experience.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Locale-Based Currency Formatting?](#What-is-Locale-Based-Currency-Formatting?)
- [Key Benefits of Locale-Based Currency Formatting](#Key-Benefits-of-Locale-Based-Currency-Formatting)
- [How Locale Detection Works](#How-Locale-Detection-Works)
- [Where Currency Formatting Applies](#Where-Currency-Formatting-Applies)
- [How To Setup Locale-Based Currency Formatting](#How-To-Setup-Locale-Based-Currency-Formatting)
- [Key Considerations](#Key-Considerations)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Locale-Based Currency Formatting?**

Locale-Based Currency Formatting automatically adjusts how prices are displayed across your HighLevel store based on the visitor’s location and the page language. Instead of showing plain numeric values, prices follow region-specific formatting standards such as thousand separators, decimal styles, and currency symbol placement. This ensures that visitors instantly understand pricing in a way that feels natural to them, reducing friction during browsing and checkout.

---

## **Key Benefits of Locale-Based Currency Formatting**

- **Improved Readability**: Prices are displayed in familiar formats, making them easier to understand at a glance.
- **Better User Trust**: Regionally accurate formatting creates a more professional and localized experience.
- **Global Compatibility**: Supports international audiences without needing multiple store versions.
- **Automatic Formatting**: Handles separators, decimals, and symbol placement without manual input.
- **Consistent Experience**: Applies across product pages, cart, and checkout for uniformity.

---

## **How Locale Detection Works**

Locale detection determines how prices are formatted by combining multiple signals to deliver the most relevant display for each visitor.

- **Page Language Priority**: The selected page language (from SEO & AI Search Optimization settings) influences the base formatting.
- **Visitor Location**: The system refines formatting based on the visitor’s geographic location.
- **Fallback Behavior**: If locale data is unavailable, formatting defaults to en-US.
- **Formatting Only**: Currency values are not converted—only the display format changes.

---

## **Where Currency Formatting Applies**

Locale-based formatting is applied consistently across all major store components to ensure a seamless experience.

- Product List Page (PLP)
- Product Detail Page (PDP)
- Cart
- Checkout
- All store price elements

---

## **How To Setup Locale-Based Currency Formatting**

Proper setup ensures that your store displays prices correctly for global visitors and aligns with your localization strategy.

1. Navigate to **Sites > Stores** in your HighLevel account.
2. Open your store and go to **Store Settings**.
3. Locate the toggle **Locale-Based Currency Formatting**.
4. Enable the toggle.
5. Click **Save**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/hYwX7aChZzHGoPqxEHCK+/GIF+Recording+2026-05-04+at+21.23.12.gif)
6. Open your store in the **Builder**.
7. Navigate to **SEO & AI Search Optimization**.
8. Set the appropriate **Page Language**.
9. Save and **Publish** your changes.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/Hgy8aYLLGOynE8omQIJM+/GIF+Recording+2026-05-05+at+00.38.57.gif)

---

## **Key Considerations**

Understanding how this feature behaves helps avoid confusion and ensures accurate expectations when managing international stores.

- **No Currency Conversion**: Prices remain in the same currency; only formatting changes.
- **Visitor-Based Formatting**: Formatting is based on the visitor’s location, not the store’s location.
- **Language Matters**: Incorrect page language settings may lead to unexpected formatting.
- **Fallback to en-US**: If locale data is unavailable, default formatting is applied.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Does this feature convert currencies automatically?**  
No, it only changes how the currency is displayed, not the value.

**Q: Why do prices look different for different users?**Formatting adjusts based on visitor location and page language.

**Q: What happens if no locale is detected?**  
The system defaults to en-US formatting.

**Q: Do I need multiple stores for different regions?**  
No, this feature allows a single store to support multiple regions visually.

**Q: Where do I control the language setting?**  
In the Builder under SEO & AI Search Optimization.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [How to Set Up an E-Commerce Online Store (Websites)](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001157)
- [Ecommerce Store - Customizing Checkout Pages](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004467)
- [Custom Product Details Page for E-commerce Stores](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006238)
- [How to Add SEO Descriptions and Keywords to Boost Your Ecommerce Ranking](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000002910)
- [Customer Login for Ecommerce Stores](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005125)

title_en: How to Use AI to Build Conversation AI Agents
source_md:
Creating Conversation AI agents in HighLevel is faster and easier with AI-assisted setup. Simply describe what you want your agent to do, and HighLevel generates the instructions, settings, and actions for you. You can then customize your agent through chat, test its responses, and make adjustments before going live.

[동영상](https://jumpshare.com/embed/IxyYuq4CItuN8hCMWx6n?disableDownload=true)

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [Using AI to Create a Conversation AI Agent](#Using-AI-to-Create-a-Conversation-AI-Agent)
  - [How to Use AI to Create a Conversation AI Agent](#How-to-Use-AI-to-Create-a-Conversation-AI-Agent)
  - [Customize Your Agent Through Chat](#Customize-Your-Agent-Through-Chat)
  - [Switch Between Build with AI and the Manual Editor](#Switch-Between-Build-with-AI-and-the-Manual-Editor)
  - [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **Using AI to Create a Conversation AI Agent**

HighLevel's AI-powered agent builder lets you create and configure Conversation AI agents using plain-language instructions instead of manually setting up prompts and actions. You can describe your agent from scratch or select from nine templates across Booking, Lead Capture, Follow-up, and Support.

The AI builder can automatically configure:

- Inbound channels and outbound triggers
- Working hours and reply delays
- Appointment booking and human handoffs
- Knowledge Base connections
- Agent instructions and opening messages

If additional information is needed, such as which calendar to use or who should receive a handoff, the AI will ask you directly in the chat.

---

## **How to Use AI to Create a Conversation AI Agent**

Creating an agent with AI involves describing your requirements, reviewing the generated configuration, and testing its responses before activation.

1. Go to **Settings → Labs** and enable **Conversation AI: Build with AI**
2. Navigate to **AI Agents → Conversation AI → Create Agent**.
3. Select **Create with AI**, then click **Start with AI**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084254863/original/iQDgvw7RXVWL-vnGw2bDOxQw9PVua1vtsg.png?1793052894)
4. Describe what you want your agent to do, or choose a template, then click **Build agent**.

   **![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084254874/original/PTv33U8gC-ZDodd6znSgZqKBwgYHCV8HOg.png?1793052929)**
5. Answer any questions Build with AI asks, such as selecting a booking calendar or handoff recipient.

   **![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084254873/original/aIO8S5PHeu_dsyldD4cWc8D2cIeA8mg55w.png?1793052929)**
6. Review the generated agent's settings, instructions, channels, and actions.

   **![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084254895/original/WrHzkf684NpWNxDlt8XkHtVdh0DjwFaK-w.png?1793052966)**
7. Request any changes in the chat, such as adjusting working hours, reply delays, or handoff settings.

   **![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084254937/original/76vC1j2oHEE6M-P2dcvPoDM4aRxsZFqejg.png?1793053094)**
8. Click **Test agent** to test inbound or outbound conversations and preview responses on your selected channel. Then click **Save** and enable the appropriate agent mode when you're ready to go live.

   **![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084254943/original/6su-17JiHZFc8kWdC0yhvKmczMr7YME8lA.png?1793053105)**

---

## **Customize Your Agent Through Chat**

Build with AI lets you update agent settings and instructions without navigating through multiple configuration screens. Describe the changes you want, and the builder updates the supported settings automatically.

For example, you can ask:

- "Only reply Monday through Saturday, from 9 AM to 8 PM."
- "Add a missed-call trigger."
- "Send pricing questions to the sales manager."
- "Make the opening message friendlier."
- "Wait five seconds before replying."

You can also ask Build with AI to rewrite your agent's instructions, change its goals, or update its opening message.

**![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084254909/original/cfaLJ-PQKBWBH5n0EmQH_LjewGc-iJrbtQ.png?1793053005)**

---

## **Switch Between Build with AI and the Manual Editor**

You can switch between Build with AI and the manual editor whenever you need more control over your agent's configuration.

Click **Switch to manual editor** to edit settings and instructions directly. To return to conversational editing, click **Build with AI** in the manual editor.

```
Important: Creating or saving an agent does not automatically activate it. The agent must be enabled in the appropriate mode, and outbound messaging must be activated separately if needed.
```

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084254923/original/wq-hs0aTMtC10u2GhEv3r0wOX5gqFZ_QRw.png?1793053030)

---

## **Related Articles**

- [How to Set Up a Conversation AI Bot](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000004401)
- [Conversation AI Bot Explained](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000001335)
- [Customize Conversation AI Agent Responses with Prompts and Instructions](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000002255)

### **What makes it a good payment collection option?**

1. **Seamless Transactions** - Completing transactions via POS has never been smoother with ***Tap to Pay***. It works with compatible contactless payment options.

2. **Speed and Convenience** - Tap your customers' compatible card or smartphone using the App, and you're done! No swiping, no PINS, and no signatures. It's that easy!

title_en: Manage appointments for Companies
source_md:
Use the Appointments tab to review appointments linked to a Company. You can start a new booking from the Company or associate an appointment that already exists in the location.

For example, keep account meetings, quarterly reviews, and onboarding calls on the Company they belong to.

```
Note

This feature is available only through a private beta and applies only to locations where it has been enabled.
```

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [Use a Company as a hub for its meetings](#Use-a-Company-as-a-hub-for-its-meetings)
- [Open the Appointments tab](#Open-the-Appointments-tab)
- [Start a new booking](#Start-a-new-booking)
- [Review Associated objects](#Review-Associated-objects)
- [Link an existing appointment](#Link-an-existing-appointment)
- [Frequently asked questions](#Frequently-asked-questions)
- [Publication notes](#Publication-notes)

---

# **Use a Company as a hub for its meetings**

The Appointments tab gives you the Company's meeting history and lets you act on it from the same place.

- **Get context:** See every upcoming and past appointment linked to the Company before you call or meet.
- **Take action:** Book a meeting or service, or link an appointment that is already scheduled, without leaving the Company.
- **Use it as a hub:** Keep account reviews and onboarding calls on the Company, so anyone who opens the account sees its meetings.

---

## **Open the Appointments tab**

1. Go to **Contacts → Companies** and open a Company.
2. Select **Appointments** from the side panel's right-hand tab rail.
3. Switch between **Upcoming** and **Past** to review linked appointments.
4. Use **Search by Calendar Name** to filter the list.

The tab shows appointments associated with the selected Company. An empty tab does not establish that a Contact has no other bookings.

**Step 1:** Open a Company and select Appointments on the right.

![Step 1: Open a Company and select Appointments on the right.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084173653/original/Fdz8GNcWifukaO_3__hfr9J4kaL8-TvQbg.png?1793005321)

---

## **Start a new booking**

1. In the Appointments tab, click **Add**.
2. Choose **Meetings** or **Services**, depending on the booking you need.

**Step 2:** Click Add, then choose Meetings, Services, or Link existing appointment.

![Step 2: Click Add, then choose Meetings, Services, or Link existing appointment.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084173654/original/5qcnPfksjtsk9h29bkT3rX9coNHJNSfK3A.png?1793005321)

1. Complete the booking details in the form that opens.

For Meetings, choose the calendar, date, time, and Contact. Review the title, meeting location, status, and any other required details before selecting **Book appointment**.

**Step 3:** In Book appointment, choose the calendar, slot and Contact. Associated objects shows the linked Company.

![Step 3: In Book appointment, choose the calendar, slot and Contact. Associated objects shows the linked Company.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084173656/original/sSxaB2ut2OH7xASn6R1SnQKnMkHL6QCAgA.png?1793005321)

---

## **Review Associated objects**

In the meeting booking form, select **Associated objects** to review which records are linked to the appointment.

- The selector includes Companies and the Custom Objects available in the location, as well as Opportunities.
- Use the record-type tabs and search to find records.
- Review the selected records before saving the selection and confirming the appointment.

When starting a meeting from a Company, the current Company is preselected under **Associated objects**. Always check the selection before confirming the booking.

**Step 4:** Open Associated objects to review the linked records. The current Company is preselected.

![Step 4: Open Associated objects to review the linked records. The current Company is preselected.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084173658/original/2GgE1eqI0OYnXK7ENXmiukWltDHRzdOVnA.png?1793005322)

---

## **Link an existing appointment**

1. Open the Company's **Appointments** tab.
2. Select **Add → Link existing appointment**.
3. Search for the appointment in the current location.
4. Select **Link** beside the appointment you want associated with the Company.

Use this option when a meeting has already been booked and needs to be connected to the relevant Company.

**Step 5:** To use a booking that already exists, choose Link existing appointment, search, and click Link.

![Step 5: To use a booking that already exists, choose Link existing appointment, search, and click Link.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155084173655/original/Goa_EqmvOdY_zTtVnIxtqUgRiYR6v-H2xg.png?1793005321)

---

## **Frequently asked questions**

**Q: Do I need to create another appointment if it is already booked?**

No. Use **Add → Link existing appointment** to find the booking and associate it with the Company.

**Q: Can an appointment be associated with different record types?**

Yes. **Associated objects** supports Companies and Custom Object records alongside Opportunities. Review the selection in the booking form.

**Q: Why is the Appointments tab empty?**

Check both **Upcoming** and **Past**, and clear any calendar-name search. If the appointment has not been associated with this Company, use **Link existing appointment** to find it in the location.

##

title_en: Communities - Create and Manage Multiple Pricing Plans
source_md:
Now you create multiple pricing plans within a single community. You can offer different membership tiers, set flexible pricing, and give members access to exclusive channels, courses, and events based on their subscription.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What Can You Do with Multiple Pricing Plans?](#What-Can-You-Do-with-Multiple-Pricing-Plans?)
- [How to Create a Community Pricing Plan](#How-to-Create-a-Community-Pricing-Plan)
- [How to Manage Existing Pricing Plans](#How-to-Manage-Existing-Pricing-Plans)
- [How to Make Your Community Free](#How-to-Make-Your-Community-Free)
- [How Members Choose and Manage Plans](#How-Members-Choose-and-Manage-Plans)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

## **What Can You Do with Multiple Pricing Plans?**

- **Create multiple plans:** Offer tiers such as Basic, Pro, VIP, etc with different benefits.
- **Set flexible pricing:** Choose weekly, monthly, yearly, or one-time payments in different currencies, with optional free trials.
- **Bundle exclusive content:** Include private channels, paid events, and paid or private courses.
- **Customize plans:** Add descriptions and benefits, reorder plans, and highlight your most popular option.
- **Manage memberships:** Activate, deactivate, edit, or delete plans and view member counts.
- **Allow plan switching:** Members can upgrade, downgrade, or change their billing options.

---

## **How to Create a Community Pricing Plan**

1. Go to **Memberships > Communities > Groups**, open your community.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/rEEdXYwgyvXZg88lcb4b+/Screenshot+2026-10-15+at+20.40.46.png)
2. Open **Settings > Subscriptions > Add plan**.
3. Under **Access**, select the private channels, courses, and events included in the plan, or choose **Full access** to include everything.
4. Under **Details**, enter the **Plan name** and **Description**.
5. Under **Pricing**, select your currency, configure an optional **Free trial**, and enable your preferred billing frequencies:

   - **Weekly**
   - **Monthly**
   - **Yearly**
   - **One-time**
   - Enter the amount for each enabled option. You can also enable **Test Mode** to test payments.
6. Under **Benefits**, add, edit, or reorder the benefits displayed to members.
7. Review the plan preview and click **Create plan**. Activate the plan from the subscription list if needed.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/fIwmlClMDjPrr2Xwac0T+/GIF+Recording+2026-10-15+at+20.43.13.gif)

---

## **How to Manage Existing Pricing Plans**

Open your community and go to **Settings > Subscriptions**.

From here, you can:

- **Activate or deactivate:** Use the toggle beside a plan.
- **Edit:** Click **Edit** to update plan settings.
- **View details or delete:** Click the three-dot menu beside a plan.
- **Highlight a plan:** Select **Mark as most popular** from the three-dot menu.
- **Reorder plans:** Drag plans into your preferred order.
- **Track members:** View the number of members subscribed to each plan.
- **Preview:** Click **Preview member view** to see how plans appear to members.

![](https://jumpshare.com/share/KKYjSjpC2OVoUM3Z8rgR+/GIF+Recording+2026-10-15+at+20.48.05.gif)

---

## **How to Make Your Community Free**

Turn on **Make this community free** under **Settings > Subscriptions** to allow members to join for free.

```
Note: Paid plans are paused while this option is enabled.
```

title_en: Reputation Management- Adding Multiple Review Links to Emails
source_md:
Multiple Review Links feature lets you add multiple review platform links inside one email template in Reputation Management. Built-in auto-validation helps prevent broken or incorrect URLs, so you can increase review conversions across platforms while keeping setup simple. This update simplifies feedback collection and boosts review conversion by offering customizable, validated, and easily manageable review options.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is the Multiple Review Links Feature?](#What-is-the-Multiple-Review-Links-Feature?)
- [Key Benefits of Multiple Review Links Feature](#Key-Benefits-of-Multiple-Review-Links-Feature)
- [How To Use Multiple Review Links in Your Email Templates](#How-To-Use-Multiple-Review-Links-in-Your-Email-Templates)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is the Multiple Review Links Feature?**

This new Reputation Management feature lets you add multiple review links (like Google, Facebook, and others) directly into your email templates. It automatically pulls in all your connected review platforms and gives you easy options to customize the text, order, and visibility of each link.

By showing several review destinations in one email, customers can choose the platform they prefer—making it easier for them to leave a review and boosting your chances of getting more responses.

---

## **Key Benefits of Multiple Review Links Feature**

These benefits focus on driving more completed reviews with less manual effort while keeping your messaging on brand.

- **Brand choice:** Give customers multiple platforms to pick from, meeting them where they already are.
- **Higher conversions:** Reduce drop-off by removing the “wrong platform” dead end.
- **Flexible copy:** Customize the link text to match your brand voice and call to action.
- **Fewer mistakes:** Auto-validation helps catch malformed or incorrect URLs before sending.
- **Simple control:** Reorder, hide/unhide, or delete links without changing your integrations.

---

## **How To Use Multiple Review Links in Your Email Templates**

Follow these steps to add multiple platforms to a single review-request email:

1. Navigate to **Reputation** → **Settings** → **Email****Requests**  
     
   **![](https://jumpshare.com/share/HQC4Y61D9ftxhkfkrbch+/Screen+Shot+2025-08-27+at+8.27.02+PM.png)**
2. Click on + **Create New**or **Edit an Existing Template**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/pDuqjBNn8aSVZIO5Mh8k+/GIF+Recording+2025-08-27+at+8.29.00+PM.gif)
3. **Drag** and **Drop** the Review Links element in the builder. (pre-selects any connected review platforms)  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/RC29HzssyZnZWMb4rUvX+/GIF+Recording+2025-08-27+at+8.32.09+PM.gif)
4. **Add** or **Edit** or **Deselect** platform URLs as needed.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/HfjSNyAAk9MJC7UhJ3IT+/GIF+Recording+2025-08-27+at+8.34.52+PM.gif)
5. **Customize** link text (e.g., “Leave a review on Google”).
6. If you have multiple GBPs connected, select the specific GBP location.
7. Reorder links by dragging.   
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/SXQtvWeVlwAG1RN5EUCk+/GIF+Recording+2025-08-27+at+8.39.04+PM.gif)
8. Confirm there are no validation errors.
9. **Save** your template, **Preview**, and **Send** (or use it in recurring or workflow-driven review requests).  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/sqpVeTreV0fyqNerUKSo+/GIF+Recording+2025-08-27+at+8.40.30+PM.gif)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Do I need to enable anything to see Review Links?**No. Once your review platforms are connected, they’ll appear automatically in the Review Links component.

**Q: What if I don’t see any platforms listed?**Connect your review platforms in **Reputation** → **Settings** → **Integrations**, then return to the Email Builder and open Review Links.

**Q: Can I customize the call-to-action (CTA) text for each link?**Yes. You can edit the text for each platform so it matches your brand voice.

**Q: Is it possible to reorder or remove review links once added?**Yes. You can reorder, select/unselect, or delete each link directly in the email builder.

**Q: Is there a limit to how many links I can add?**You can add multiple links to one email. For best readability, keep the list concise.

**Q: How does auto-validation work for review links?**The component automatically checks each link to ensure it’s valid, reducing the chance of broken or incorrect URLs.

**Q: Do I need to disconnect a platform to hide it from an email?**No. Simply unselect the platform in the template to hide it without removing the integration.

**Q: Can I use these templates in automations or recurring sends?**Yes. Save your template and use it in recurring review emails or the Review Request workflow action.

---

title_en: How to Personalize Your Campaigns with Conditional Elements
source_md:
[동영상](https://www.youtube.com/embed/eXyXP2m9ObY?&wmode=opaque)

Use conditional element to effortlessly personalize your email campaigns! Conditional Elements let you show or hide specific content blocks in the Email Builder based on each contact’s data.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is a Conditional Element?](#What-is-a-Conditional-Element?)
- [Key Benefits of Conditional Elements](#Key-Benefits-of-Conditional-Elements)
- [How to Use Conditional Elements](#How-to-Use-Conditional-Elements)
- [New Conditional Visibility Operators](#New-Conditional-Visibility-Operators)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is a Conditional Element?**

A conditional element allows you to display content (such as images or text) within an email only if a contact meets certain criteria. This enables you to tailor your messaging to individual contacts automatically.

Conditional Elements are configured in the Email Builder at the element level (e.g., Text, Image, Button, Rows/Sections) and can be based on multiple types of criteria including:

- **Location-based content**: Display different images or offers depending on a contact’s geographic location.
- **Field-based text**: Change a text element based on specific contact fields, like their job title or interests.

---

## **Key Benefits of Conditional Elements**

- **Personalization**: Make your campaigns more relevant by showing customized content to each contact.
- **Time-Saving**: Avoid the need to create smart lists and separate campaigns. Use one campaign with conditional elements instead.
- **Increased Engagement**: Showing content that's personalized to each recipient increases the likelihood of higher click-through rates, responses, and conversions.
- **Simplified Campaign Management**: Instead of juggling various lists and campaigns, manage all variations of content in one place, reducing complexity and chances for error.

---

## **How to Use Conditional Elements**

1. Open your email in the Email Builder. (**Marketing**> **Emails**> **Campaigns** or **Templates**)  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064214065/original/0_VFLp06V9FNJdGyL9MwqrOUOdB0ozPEWg.png?1770235093)
2. Select an element (e.g., Text, Image, Button) and open the **Visibility** tab in its settings panel.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064214124/original/8an3-B_coLa2a2ovUe8sqpVcVEUcv6ZfYQ.png?1770235228)  
   Alternatively, click on the **Conditional Element** icon in the element overlay action to access conditional elements easily.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064214302/original/DxWB3jHLbF1CH1POX4wNzBqWkqRKJRhW7Q.png?1770235626)
3. Toggle on **Conditional****Sending**.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064214135/original/gO7lepdZAkHWsLCSSGOPSO56uvJIxocvyQ.png?1770235265)
4. Choose a **F****ield**, set a **Condition**(is/is not), and enter a **V****alue**.  
     
   Leave the value blank to set the conditional element's value to null. When set to null, the element will only render when the specified field is empty.  
     
   ![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155064214196/original/09Aj5eafLj8sNjKxee8GPgQ6KPSOjnxXSg.png?1770235408)

## ``` Conditional elements now evaluate reliably when a contact’s custom field is not set. ```

---

## **New Conditional Visibility Operators**

Conditional visibility now supports more flexible rule logic so you can handle missing or empty values more cleanly when personalizing emails.

You can now use these operators when configuring visibility rules:

- Is
- Is Not
- Is Empty
- Is Present

These operators work with custom fields in the visibility dropdown, including attachment fields.

**Example use cases**

Show a **Download Invoice** button only when an attachment field **Is Present**

Hide a personalized greeting when **First Name Is Empty**

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Can I type “NULL” as the value to target empty fields?**  
No. Typing “NULL” will not match an empty field. Leave the contact’s field blank and set the condition to Is empty. Also ensure there are no spaces or placeholder text in the field.

**Q: Which field types are supported for Conditional Elements?**

Supported types are single-line text, number, radio select, and single-select dropdown. For numbers, use plain numeric values (no symbols). For radio/single-select fields, match the exact stored option value.

---

## **Related Articles**

- [Different elements in email builder](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000006657)

title_en: Save and Reuse Items in the Email Builder
source_md:
Creating consistent email designs is easier when you can reuse elements and layouts you've already built. HighLevel's Saved Items feature lets you save frequently used content and quickly add it to other email templates in the Design Editor. This article explains how to save, find, reuse, rename, and manage saved items without recreating them each time.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What Are Saved Items in the Email Builder?](#What-Are-Saved-Items-in-the-Email-Builder?)
- [How to Save and Reuse Items in the Email Builder](#How-to-Save-and-Reuse-Items-in-the-Email-Builder)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What Are Saved Items in the Email Builder?**

Saved Items are reusable design components that you can store and access directly within HighLevel's Email Design Editor. Instead of rebuilding common email content, such as branded headers, footers, or promotional sections, you can save an existing design and insert it into another email template.

Saved items are available across email templates created in the Design Editor within the same HighLevel location. This makes it easier to maintain consistent branding and reduce repetitive design work.

**Supported Editors:**

- **Design Editor:** Supports saving and reusing email design items.
- **AI Editor:** Does not currently support Saved Items.

For more information about email components, refer to [Different Elements in Email Builder](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006657).

---

## **How to Save and Reuse Items in the Email Builder**

Saving frequently used design components makes creating new email templates faster and more consistent. The following steps explain how to save an existing element or layout, access saved content, reuse it in another template, and organize your saved items for quick access.

```
Note: Saved Items are not available in the AI Editor. Switch to or use the Design Editor to use this feature.
```

### **Step 1:**Open the Email Design Editor

1. Log in to your HighLevel account.
2. Navigate to **Marketing → Emails → Templates**.
3. [Create a new email template](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000005059) or open an existing one.
4. Make sure you're using the **Design Editor**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/sXEzQdcB3a2ae3BKzL7Q+/GIF+Recording+2026-10-08+at+21.55.15.gif)

### **Step 2:**Save an Element or Layout

1. Locate the element, section, or layout you want to reuse.
2. Hover over the item to display its editing toolbar.
3. Click the **Save** icon in the toolbar.
4. A confirmation message appears when the item has been saved successfully.

   **Tip:** Save frequently used components such as branded footers, headers, and promotional sections to reduce repetitive formatting.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/8Y2EmcNdPhuzHjuZAIL5+/GIF+Recording+2026-10-08+at+22.04.30.gif)

### **Step 3:**Access and Reuse Saved Items

1. Open the **Saved Items** panel from the left-side toolbar in the Design Editor.
2. Locate the previously saved element, section, or layout.
3. Drag the saved item from the panel into the desired position in your email template.
4. Adjust the inserted item's content or styling as needed.

   **Important:** Saved items can be reused across email templates in the Design Editor within the same location.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/QaCYFX8yG32KJweHS8Dq+/GIF+Recording+2026-10-08+at+22.12.04.gif)

### **Step 4:**SearchRename, Delete Saved Items

Descriptive names make saved content easier to recognize, especially when your library contains multiple similar elements or layouts.

1. Open the **Saved Items** panel.
2. Use the **Search** bar to enter the name or keyword associated with a saved item.
3. Click the **three-dot menu (⋯)** associated with that item.
4. Select **Rename or Delete**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/10yGJlR3KjKKCAk73mnw+/GIF+Recording+2026-10-08+at+22.15.36.gif)

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

#### **Q: Can I use saved items in the AI Editor?**

No. Saved Items are currently supported only in the Design Editor.

#### **Q: Can I access saved items from a different HighLevel location?**

Saved items are available within the location where they were created. They are not shared automatically with other locations.

#### **Q: Do I need to save an entire email template to reuse part of its design?**

No. You can save individual supported elements, sections, or layouts without saving the entire email as a reusable template.

#### **Q: Can I reuse the same saved item multiple times?**

Yes. You can drag the same saved item into different email templates within the same HighLevel location.

#### **Q: Why can't I find an item that was previously saved?**

Check that you're using the Design Editor and are in the same HighLevel location where the item was saved. You can also search for the item's name in the Saved Items panel.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [How to Use the Email Builder and Its Inline Editor](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000000087)
- [Different Elements in Email Builder](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006657)
- [How to Edit an Email Template](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000007606-how-to-edit-an-email-template)

title_en: Understanding the Conversion Rate in the Prospecting Tool
source_md:
At GHL, we are committed to revolutionising the prospecting process for agencies. With this goal in mind, we are excited to introduce the "Prospect Conversion Rate," a powerful feature designed to transform the way agencies prioritise and target prospects. The Conversion Likelihood Rate is now a key component of our platform, accessible within the Prospect Dashboard and the Prospect Marketing Audit Report.

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [How is the Conversion Rate Calculated?](#How-is-the-Conversion-Rate-Calculated?)
- [How to Use the Conversion Rate?](#How-to-Use-the-Conversion-Rate?)
- [Key Features of the Conversion Rate](#Key-Features-of-the-Conversion-Rate)

## **How is the Conversion Rate Calculated?**

The Conversion Rate is calculated on the basis of several key factors:  
  
**1. Google Business Profile Claim Status:**If the GBP is already claimed by the prospect, their chance for becoming a client is considerably lower and had an impact on our conversion Rate.  
**2. Online Reviews:**Prospects who have a considerably lesser reviews left by customers along with their recent reviews having negative reviews implies that they could really use help from Marketing Agencies to improve their reputation game. On the other hand,Prospects who have more reviews left by customer and if the recent reviews are all positive, it is highly unlikely for them to look for an Agency to manage their business/sales.  
**3.Business Website:**If the Prospect already has a website for their business, it implies that they already are aware of online strategies to win clients or increase sales and this could negatively impact the conversion Rate. Likewise, No business website, indicates that the prospect is yet to explore the digital realm.  
**4. Chat Widget in Website:**Prospects who have a chat widget on their website are more likely to actively connect with their clients and resolve queries thereby increasing their sales/services. If the Prospect has no chatWidget, the agency can then offer their services to set up a website and/or other marketing initiatives to empower these prospects in the online space. Hence theseProspects will have a higher conversion rate

> ***In a Nutshell, Conversion Rate takes into account various factors to help you identify which business benefits the most from you that has a higher chance of becoming your customer in future.***

## **How to Use the Conversion Rate?**

The Conversion Rate is designed to simplify the prospecting process and ensure you focus your efforts where they matter most. Here's how you can make the most of it:

1. **Prospect Searches:** When you perform prospect searches, pay attention to the Conversion Rate. This Rate is a reliable indicator of a prospect's likelihood to convert, helping you make efficient and data-driven decisions.  
![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155011564688/original/PAWaGTviR5eo-Gq1iy-zGrBIBmKjSTvP8w.png?1698813761)

2. **Prospect Dashboard:** Within the Prospect Dashboard, use the Conversion Rate to identify high-potential prospects. By understanding their conversion likelihood, you can tailor your approach to engage them effectively.![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155011564698/original/f3alFVJxhxY8WlwKAUh_jnNd-CbzaYvU3g.png?1698813796)

3. **Marketing Audit Report:** The Conversion Rate is also accessible in the Prospect Marketing Audit Report. This report provides an in-depth analysis of each prospect's conversion potential, offering valuable insights for your prospecting strategy.

![](https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/155011564715/original/tQBOqmIsg5cvZE0Z37cA7maveUXobLOwsA.png?1698813835)

## 

## Key Features of the Conversion Rate

1. **Sophisticated Scoring Model:** Our state-of-the-art scoring model takes into account a wide range of prospect data points. This includes factors such as GBP Claim status, average reviews, demographics, and historical conversion data. By analysing these factors, we provide you with a robust and precise prospect rate.

2. **Thresholds for Quick Insights:** We've established specific thresholds for prospect rate, categorising them as "high," "moderate," or "low" conversion likelihood. This categorisation allows agencies to quickly identify the most promising prospects, ensuring you focus your efforts where they are most likely to yield results.

3. **Enhanced Searching:** When you search for prospects on our platform, the Conversion Likelihood rate provides you with instant insights into each prospect's potential to convert. title_en: Your Website Should Look as Good as Your Clients : The Beauty Salon Website & SEO Blueprint
source_md:
## **The Beauty Salon Website & SEO Blueprint**

### Why Your Website Matters

Your website is your digital storefront. It should reflect the same beauty, professionalism, and care your clients experience in your salon. If your site is slow, hard to navigate, or missing key information, potential clients will bounce before booking.

More importantly, if you don’t rank on Google when someone searches for “facial near me” or “best hair salon in [city],” you’re invisible to the very people trying to find you.

This guide helps you:

- Launch a stunning, branded website fast
- Rank higher on Google with the right keywords
- Get more bookings directly from your site

For full website setup using GoHighLevel, see: [How to Build a Website in HighLevel](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001633-sites-overview)

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [The Beauty Salon Website & SEO Blueprint](#The-Beauty-Salon-Website-&-SEO-Blueprint)
  - [Why Your Website Matters](#Why-Your-Website-Matters)
- [Building a Booking-Optimized Salon Website](#Building-a-Booking-Optimized-Salon-Website)
  - [1. Choose the Right Pages to Include](#1.-Choose-the-Right-Pages-to-Include)
  - [2. What to Say on Each Page (Copywriting Tips)](#2.-What-to-Say-on-Each-Page-(Copywriting-Tips))
  - [3. Design Matters (Even for Google)](#3.-Design-Matters-(Even-for-Google))
  - [4. Deep-Dive: The SEO Boost for Beauty Salons](#4.-Deep-Dive%3A-The-SEO-Boost-for-Beauty-Salons)
  - [5. Link It All Together](#5.-Link-It-All-Together)
- [Final Takeaway](#Final-Takeaway)

---

## **Building a Booking-Optimized Salon Website**

### **1. Choose the Right Pages to Include**

A beauty salon website needs only 4-6 high-impact pages:

**Essential Pages:**

- **Home** – Strong headline, service summary, CTA to book
- **About Us** – Your story, team, trust-building photos
- **Services** – List of offerings, with pricing and details
- **Booking/Contact** – Calendar or form linked to your GHL setup
- **Reviews/Testimonials** – Social proof from happy clients
- **Gallery (Optional)** – High-quality photos of your work

To set up different website for desktop and phone inside GoHighLevel, use this [GUIDE](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001161151-how-to-have-different-websites-for-desktop-and-phone)

### **2. What to Say on Each Page (Copywriting Tips)**

Use language your ideal client would say or Google.

**Examples:**

- Instead of “We offer facial treatments,” say “Get glowing skin with our signature deep-cleanse facial.”
- Use keywords like “bridal makeup artist in [city]” instead of just “makeup services.”

**Copy Tips:**

- Speak directly to the client
- Use short, confident sentences
- Always include a clear call-to-action (“Book Now” or “Schedule a Free Consult”)

### **3. Design Matters (Even for Google)**

Google rewards mobile-friendly, fast websites with good user experience.

**Design Checklist:**

- Use a clean, modern layout
- Highlight service categories with visual cards
- Include high-res images
- Keep your brand colors consistent
- Add your booking CTA to every page

### **4. Deep-Dive: The SEO Boost for Beauty Salons**

A beautiful website still needs Google to find it. Here’s how to SEO-optimize it effectively:

**On-Page SEO Essentials:**

- Use  tags only once on each page, with target keywords like “Luxury Hair Salon in [City]”
- Add / subheadings for scannability, using secondary keywords
- Include keywords in the first 100 words of content
- Compress images and add keyword-rich "alt-text"
- Link to other internal pages (e.g., Services → Booking)

**Technical SEO Tips:**

- Mobile responsiveness is non-negotiable
- Keep page load time under 3 seconds
- Use SSL (https)
- Submit your sitemap to Google Search Console

**Off-Page SEO Suggestions:**

- Get listed on other directories (Yelp, Justdial, Sulekha)
- Get backlinks from local wedding blogs, vendor directories, or collab partners
- Encourage satisfied clients to mention and link to your site in social posts/reviews

**Local SEO Tips:**

- Add your city and neighborhood names throughout the site
- Embed a Google Map of your location on the Contact page
- Include opening hours using schema markup (GHL supports custom code blocks for this)

Want to configure SEO metadata in GHL? See: [SEO Metadata for Website Pages](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48000980312-seo-meta-data)

Want to embed maps or custom code? See: [How to Add Custom Meta Tags to Your Site](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001073924-custom-meta-tags)

### **5. Link It All Together**

Connect your website to:

- Google Business Profile (so your site shows in search)
- Instagram bio link
- Facebook page CTA
- Email signature
- Booking automations in GHL

---

## **Final Takeaway**

Your website isn’t just a portfolio — it’s a 24/7 stylist, front desk, and sales rep. If it looks great, loads fast, ranks well, and invites people to book, it will become one of your most powerful tools.

Don’t just aim for “pretty.” Build a site that performs, ranks, and converts.

---

Ready to grow? **[Sign up with HighLevel](https://www.gohighlevel.com/?utm_source=seo&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=beautysalon&utm_term=beautysalon&utm_content=playbook)**

title_en: How to Mark a Conversation as Read
source_md:
Unread conversations help your team identify messages that still need attention. In HighLevel, opening a conversation does not automatically mark it as read. This prevents leads or customer messages from being missed before a reply or intentional action is completed. Use this guide to manually mark conversations as read or automate the process with workflows.

---

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Conversation Read Status?](#What-is-Conversation-Read-Status?)
- [Key Benefits of Conversation Read Status](#Key-Benefits-of-Conversation-Read-Status)
- [How Read and Unread Conversations Work](#How-Read-and-Unread-Conversations-Work)
- [How To Manually Mark Conversations as Read](#How-To-Manually-Mark-Conversations-as-Read)
- [Automating Mark as Read with Workflows](#Automating-Mark-as-Read-with-Workflows)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)
- [Related Articles](#Related-Articles)

---

# **What is Conversation Read Status?**

Conversation read status helps teams track which messages still need attention in the Conversations area. A conversation remains unread until a user replies to it or manually marks it as read. This gives your team more control over when a message is considered handled.

---

## **Key Benefits of Conversation Read Status**

- **Prevents missed leads:** Opening a conversation does not automatically mark it as read, helping teams avoid accidentally overlooking messages.
- **Keeps inboxes organized:** Unread conversations stay visible until a user replies or marks them as read.
- **Supports team accountability:** Team members can quickly identify which conversations still need action.
- **Allows automation:** Workflows can be used to automatically update conversation read status when needed.

---

## **How Read and Unread Conversations Work**

Unread conversations stay marked as unread until a clear action is taken. Simply clicking into a message or viewing the conversation does not change the read status.

When you open an unread conversation, it will remain unread. This is intentional so your team does not accidentally mark a lead or customer message as handled before responding.

A conversation is marked as read when:

- You **reply to the conversation manually**.
- You click the **Mark as Read** icon in the conversation view.
- A workflow updates the conversation status using the **Edit Conversation** workflow action.

---

## **How To Manually Mark Conversations as Read**

Properly marking conversations as read keeps your unread list accurate and helps your team focus on messages that still need attention.

1. Click **Conversations** from your HighLevel account.
2. Open **Team Inbox**.
3. Select an **unread conversation**.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/b9j1AQDv1sb2fnpUo9gv+/Screen+Shot+2026-06-05+at+15.16.42.png)
4. Choose one of the following options:  
     
   - **Reply** to the conversation.
   - Click the **Mark as Read** icon in the top-right area of the conversation view.
5. Confirm the conversation is removed from the unread list.  
     
   ![](https://jumpshare.com/share/o0xewlaGRe6LaH2hJ5DP+/Screen+Shot+2026-06-05+at+15.18.26.png)

---

## **Automating Mark as Read with Workflows**

Workflow automation is useful when conversations should be marked as read based on specific scenarios or workflow activity. Instead of manually updating each conversation, you can use workflow actions or workflow settings to control how conversations appear in the inbox.

To automate this behavior, check out the article on [**Workflow Action - Edit Conversation**](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001214153-workflow-action-edit-conversation?utm_source=chatgpt.com). This action can mark conversations as read or unread and can also archive or unarchive conversations.

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: Does opening a conversation mark it as read?**

No. Opening or clicking into a conversation does not automatically mark it as read.

**Q: Why does a conversation stay unread after I open it?**  
This helps prevent messages from being marked as handled before your team replies or intentionally marks them as read.

**Q: Does replying to a conversation mark it as read?**

Yes. When you reply to an unread conversation, it is automatically marked as read.

**Q: Can I mark a conversation as read without replying?**  
Yes. Open the conversation and click the **Mark as Read** icon in the top-right area.

**Q: Can I automate marking conversations as read?**  
Yes. Use the **Edit Conversation** workflow action to automate conversation read status.

---

### **Related Articles**

- [Workflow Action - Edit Conversation](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001214153-workflow-action-edit-conversation?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [Getting Started with the Conversations Tab](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000006610-getting-started-with-the-conversations-tab?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [Overview of Conversation Filters](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/48001222121-overview-of-conversation-filters?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- [Conversations - How to Add Internal Comments & Mention Users](https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003877)

title_en: Adding Closed Captions and Subtitles to your video courses
source_md:
This article shows you how to upload and edit closed captions and subtitles in your video courses using HighLevel's Course Builder. With support for multiple languages and an advanced subtitle editor, your courses can now be more inclusive, accessible, and globally effective.

**TABLE OF CONTENTS**

- [What is Closed Captions & Subtitle Support?](#What-is-Closed-Captions-&-Subtitle-Support?)
- [Key Benefits of Closed Captions & Subtitle Support](#Key-Benefits-of-Closed-Captions-&-Subtitle-Support)
- [How to Upload Subtitles in HighLevel](#How-to-Upload-Subtitles-in-HighLevel)
- [Using the Advanced Subtitle Editor](#Using-the-Advanced-Subtitle-Editor)
- [Raw Mode Editing](#Raw-Mode-Editing)
- [Frequently Asked Questions](#Frequently-Asked-Questions)

---

## What is Closed Captions & Subtitle Support?

Closed Captions & Subtitle Support is a feature within the HighLevel Course Builder that allows you to upload subtitle files to your course videos. These subtitles can be provided in multiple languages, and you can edit them directly within the platform. With both a visual and raw editor available, this feature enables you to enhance accessibility, ensure legal compliance, and cater to a wider audience of learners who benefit from text-based reinforcement.

## Key Benefits of Closed Captions & Subtitle Support

Subtitle support enhances course accessibility and learning by including captions for various languages, improving comprehension for all audiences.

- **Reach a global audience by supporting multiple subtitle languages.**
- **Improve content accessibility for users with hearing impairments.**
- **Increase retention and comprehension through visual reinforcement.**
- **Identify and correct errors with real-time subtitle issue detection.**
- **Edit subtitles manually or visually to ensure clarity and accuracy.**
- **Ensure subtitles are properly synced with your video content.**

## **How to Upload Subtitles in HighLevel**

Upload subtitles to your video lessons using standard .srt files to quickly enable captions across different languages.

**To upload subtitles to your course videos:**

1. **Navigate to Sites > Courses and open the course you want to edit.**
2. **Click on a Lesson that contains a video.**
3. **Locate the Upload Subtitles option next to the video player.**
4. **Click Upload Subtitle and choose a .srt file from your device.**
5. **Select the appropriate language from the dropdown list.**
6. **Click Save to attach the subtitle file to the video.**

## **Using the Advanced Subtitle Editor**

Edit and improve your subtitles with HighLevel’s advanced editor, featuring real-time error detection and visual timestamp navigation.

**After uploading a subtitle file, you can use the built-in editor to refine it:**

- **Click on the Edit Subtitles button next to the uploaded file.**
- **View subtitles in a structured list with timestamps and text content.**
- **Navigate easily by clicking timestamps to jump to specific video moments.**
- **If there are issues (e.g., overlapping lines or gaps), warning icons will appear.**
- **Hover over the warning icon to view the issue description.**
- **Click directly into the text to make corrections, then select Save Changes.**

## **Raw Mode Editing**

**Raw Mode lets you manually adjust subtitles for full control over text and timing when precision is essential.**

**Raw Mode is useful when you want direct access to the subtitle file’s structure:**

- **In the Subtitle Editor, click the Switch to Raw Mode button.**
- **Edit the file using standard .srt formatting (e.g., timestamps followed by subtitle text).**
- **Carefully review the syntax to avoid formatting errors.**
- **Once complete, click Save to update the video with your changes.**

---

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

**Q: What subtitle formats are supported?  
 Currently, HighLevel supports .srt files only.**

**Q: Can I upload subtitles in more than one language?  
 Yes. You can upload multiple .srt files, each assigned to a different language, allowing viewers to select their preferred option.**

**Q: Will subtitles automatically align with the video?  
 Subtitles will sync based on the timestamps provided in the .srt file. You can adjust timing in the subtitle editor if needed.**

**Q: Is Raw Mode required for subtitle editing?  
 No. Raw Mode is optional and intended for users who prefer manual editing. The visual editor offers a user-friendly alternative.**

**Q: Can learners choose subtitle languages while watching the video?  
 Yes. Viewers can switch between available subtitle languages using the player controls.**

**Q: What happens if my subtitle file contains errors?  
 The system will display warning icons for overlapping lines or missing timestamps. You can fix these in the editor before saving.**

### 

### **Next Steps**

- **Review your existing video lessons and prepare .srt files for each.**
- **Upload subtitles in at least one additional language to improve global accessibility.**
- **Use the Advanced Subtitle Editor to fine-tune content and timing.**
- **Monitor learner engagement to assess the impact of subtitle availability.**
- **Stay tuned for upcoming features such as enhanced course analytics and video embedding via links.**
